original: Player: Tavern
Tyrion: So...[p/] Is it just me,[p/] or does this hallway look similar to the one in your family's tavern?
translation: Tyrion: 所以……[p/]是我眼花吗，[p/]还是说这条走廊跟你家酒馆里的那条很像？

original: Celeste: Well,[p/] most taverns use the same architecture.[p/] So, I don't think it's [i]that[/i] strange.
translation: Celeste: 嗯，[p/]大部分酒馆的建筑风格都差不多，[p/]所以我觉得这没有[i]那么[/]i奇怪。

original: Tyrion: No,[p/] but it looks [i]exactly[/i] like the McCoy Tavern.[p/] It's uncanny.
translation: Tyrion: 不，[p/]但这跟麦考伊酒馆看起来[i]一模一样[/]i。[p/]有点不可思议了。

original: Tyrion: It's as if whoever made this tavern decided to just reuse the same design.
translation: Tyrion: 就好像建这酒馆的人直接套用了同样的设计。

original: Celeste: Hey,[p/] making unique designs is difficult, Tyrion.[p/] [i]And[/i] it costs money.
translation: Celeste: 喂，[p/]做出独特设计很困难的，提利昂，[p/][i]而且[/]i得花钱。

original: Celeste: Do you really think developers should be spending resources on a location that you'll only see once?
translation: Celeste: 你真觉得开发人员应该把资源花在一个只会来一次的地方吗？

original: Tyrion: I don't know...[p/] It just seems kind of lazy.
translation: Tyrion: 我不知道……[p/]这样看起来有点懒。

original: Celeste: Well, if it bothers you so much,[p/][s/] why don't [i]you[/i] pay for the assets required to make a new one?
translation: Celeste: 要是你这么在意，[p/][s/]那[i]你[/]i出钱做新的不就行了？

original: I decided to drop the matter.
translation: 我决定不管这件事了。

original: Player: End Door
Tyrion: Is this your room, Aster?
translation: Tyrion: 这是你的房间吗，阿斯特？

original: Aster: Yes,[p/] it's quite cozy.
translation: Aster: 对啊，[p/]里面挺舒适的。

original: Aster: I'm very pleased with how much personality the craftsmanship has.
translation: Aster: 我对其展现的个性与工匠精神非常满意。

original: Aster: It's nothing like any of the resorts I've stayed at.[p/] It's far more rustic.
translation: Aster: 它并不像我待过的任何一座度假酒店，[p/]而是更具乡村风格。

original: Tyrion: Hm...
translation: Tyrion: 嗯……

original: Player: Back
Player: Aster de Wyverngarde
translation: Player: 阿斯特·维文加德

original: Tyrion: So, Your Highness—
translation: Tyrion: 那么，王子殿下——

original: Aster: Please, there's no need for that.[p/] Just call me "Aster".
translation: Aster: 别这样，没有必要。[p/]叫我“阿斯特”就好了。

original: He couldn't be serious, could he?
translation: 他不是认真的吧？

original: After I got a good look at him,[p/] he looked sincere—[p/]a little [i]too[/i] sincere.
translation: 我看了他一眼，[p/]他看起来十分真诚——[p/]甚至有点真诚[i]过头[/i]了。

original: He carried himself with the poise of a royal,[p/] but there was also a warm kindness and humility in his eyes.
translation: 他举手投足之间自有一股王室风范，[p/]但他眼神中也流露出温暖的善意与谦逊。

original: He sounded too good to be true,[p/] but maybe I was just too jaded by the other aristocrats I'd met.
translation: 他听起来好得让人难以置信，[p/]但也许我只是对遇到的其他贵族感到厌倦了。

original: Tyrion: What is the Crown Prince doing in a tavern like this, anyway?
translation: Tyrion: 但你身为王储，在这样的酒馆里是为什么呢？

original: Aster: Ah,[p/] the Kingsguard were being far too overbearing.
translation: Aster: 啊，[p/]国王卫队有点太担心我了。

original: Aster: They were insistent that I return to the capital,[p/] but I'd been planning this trip to Aurinax for days.
translation: Aster: 他们坚持要我返回首都，[p/]但我早早就计划好了来欧奥耐克斯的这次旅行。

original: Aster: I found an opportunity to sneak away from them and hired a guide to show me around the city.
translation: Aster: 我找到了一个从他们那里溜出来的机会，然后雇佣了一位向导为我导览全城。

original: Tyrion: Are you talking about Noah Morrison?
translation: Tyrion: 你说的是诺亚·莫里森？

original: Aster: Ah, yes.[p/] Mr. Morrison.
translation: Aster: 啊，是的。[p/]就是莫里森先生。

original: Aster: He told me quite a lot about the industrial complexities of Aurinax[p/] and even more about the workers' unions.
translation: Aster: 他向我介绍了欧奥耐克斯工业发展的复杂处境，[p/]还有关于工会的事情。

original: Celeste: ...Is it really okay for you to disappear like that?
translation: Celeste: ……你就这么消失不见，真的没问题？

original: Celeste: The Kingsguard are probably freaking out over losing track of you.
translation: Celeste: 国王卫队找不到你的行踪，多半已经抓狂了。

original: Aster: Ah,[p/] they worry far too much.[p/] I can take care of myself.
translation: Aster: 啊，[p/]他们就是太操心了。[p/]我能照顾好自己的。

original: Aster: I may not look it,[p/] but I'm one of the most powerful mages in this kingdom.
translation: Aster: 虽然看不太出来，[p/]我其实也是王国最强大的法师之一。

original: Tyrion: That sounds awfully cocky,[p/] don't you think?
translation: Tyrion: 这说法听起来还有点自大，[p/你不这么认为吗？

original: Aster: Hm...[p/] You think so?
translation: Aster: 嗯……[p/]你是这么想的？

original: There was so much optimism behind those eyes.[p/] How sheltered was this guy?
translation: 他的眼神中充满了自信。[p/]这家伙真是被保护得太周全了吧？

original: Player: What did you see?
translation: Player: 你看到了什么？

original: Tyrion: Anyways,[p/] Mr. Morrison told us you were present when the accident occurred.
translation: Tyrion: 总而言之，[p/]莫里森先生提到，那起事故发生时你在现场。

original: Aster: Ah, it was quite dreadful what happened.
translation: Aster: 啊，那件事情太可怕了。

original: Tyrion: We only have one witness who actually saw Justin fall into that vat.
translation: Tyrion: 我们之前只知道一位目击到贾斯汀落入精炼容器的证人。

original: Tyrion: I was wondering if you saw anything she didn't.
translation: Tyrion: 我想知道你是否有见到她没看到的内容。

original: Aster: I didn't see much, I'm afraid.[p/] It all happened very quickly.
translation: Aster: 但恐怕我也没看得很清楚。[p/]发生得太快了。

original: Aster: If he weren't yelling at that animal,[p/] I might not have even noticed him.
translation: Aster: 要不是他向那个动物吼叫，[p/]我可能都不会注意到他。

original: Tyrion: ...There was an animal up on the catwalk, too?
translation: Tyrion: ……也就是说，当时步道上有一只动物？

original: Aster: It looked to be some kind of hairless rodent,[p/] but it was abnormally large.
translation: Aster: 看着像某种无毛的老鼠，[p/]但体型大得不寻常。

original: Aster: I think he may have been trying to catch it.[p/] He even grabbed it at one point.
translation: Aster: 我认为他当时是想抓住它，[p/]而且在某个瞬间甚至碰到它了。

original: Tyrion: ...Was he facing towards Dracogen's office when he was yelling at this rodent?
translation: Tyrion: 他向那只“老鼠”吼叫的时候是面对着德拉科根的办公室吗？

original: Aster: I think so.[p/] Noah pointed out the office window earlier.[p/] It allowed Stefanic to oversee the refinery.
translation: Aster: 我想是的。[p/]诺亚早些时候有向我介绍过那间办公室。[p/]斯蒂芬尼克可以在那里俯瞰整座精炼厂的运行情况。

original: Tyrion: Did you see anyone else up on the catwalk?
translation: Tyrion: 你当时看到步道上还有其他人吗？

original: Aster: No,[p/] my view of the catwalk was limited by my position.
translation: Aster: 看不到。[p/]从我的位置只能看到步道的一部分。

original: Ugh...[p/] This whole time,[p/] I thought Justin had been yelling at the Phantom,[p/] but it turned out he was just yelling at a rat.
translation: 唉……[p/]我一直以为，[p/]贾斯汀是在向那个“魅影”吼叫。[p/]但结果只是一只老鼠。

original: It seemed that the only person who spotted the thief that day was Justin.
translation: 看起来当天唯一目击到窃贼的人就只有贾斯汀了。

original: Player: The Accident
translation: Player: 事故

original: Tyrion: Did you see the moment that Justin fell in?[p/] Was he pushed off the catwalk by a spell?
translation: Tyrion: 你当时有看到贾斯汀掉下去的瞬间吗？[p/]他是被某个法术推下步道的？

original: Aster: I'm not quite sure,[p/] but I definitely saw something magical.
translation: Aster: 我并不确定，[p/]但我肯定看到了某种魔法的效应。

original: Aster: There was a flash of magical light centered on his position.
translation: Aster: 正在他所在的位置发出了一道魔力的闪光。

original: Aster: The magical energy took the shape of a prism before blowing apart the guardrail.
translation: Aster: 那魔力在吹飞护栏前呈现棱柱一样的形状。

original: Aster: Justin lost his balance afterward and fell into the vat.
translation: Aster: 贾斯汀失去了平衡，然后掉进了容器。

original: Tyrion: Did you see what the spell looked like?[p/] Do you think you could identify it for us?
translation: Tyrion: 你有看到那个法术具体是什么样子吗？[p/]能否辨认出具体是哪一种？

original: Aster: The problem is that I'm almost sure that it [i]wasn't[/i] a spell.
translation: Aster: 问题是，我几乎可以肯定，那[i]并非[/i]法术。

original: Aster: It was the effect of some sort of artificery.
translation: Aster: 那是奥术能源的效应。

original: Tyrion: ...How can you be so sure?
translation: Tyrion: ……为什么这么确定呢？

original: Aster: It's difficult for someone who's not a mage to understand.
translation: Aster: 对于并非身为法师的人，或许很难理解。

original: Aster: When a mage casts a spell,[p/] they draw and harness the aether from within their own body.
translation: Aster: 法师在释放法术的时候，[p/]他们需要从自身体内提取并运用以太。

original: Aster: Artificery, on the other hand,[p/] draws aether from the natural ley lines that run through the ground.
translation: Aster: 但如果是奥术能源装置，[p/]是从大地中沿着自然的地脉汲取以太来运作的。

original: Aster: I am someone who has practiced arcane magic for my entire life.
translation: Aster: 而我正是毕生都在练习奥术魔法的那类人。

original: Aster: I've slowly learned how to sense how aether moves around me.
translation: Aster: 我也慢慢学会如何感知身边以太的动向。

original: Celeste: You can do that, too?[p/] I thought I was the only one.
translation: Celeste: 你也会吗？[p/]我还以为只有我会呢。

original: Aster: Oh,[p/] that talent is quite a rarity—[p/]even among the royal family.
translation: Aster: 噢，[p/]这种才能可是相当罕有——[p/]即使在王室中也是如此。

original: Aster: I suppose I shouldn't expect anything less from the Crimson Demon.
translation: Aster: 但我想对于“绯红恶魔”而言，本来就不该在任何领域小瞧她嘛。

original: Celeste: Stop calling me that.
translation: Celeste: 别再那么叫我。

original: Player: What spell was cast on Justin?
translation: Player: 贾斯汀身上被施放了什么法术？

original: Tyrion: So you could feel the aether was moving towards the source of that spell.
translation: Tyrion: 也就是说你有感知到以太向那个魔法的源头汇聚。

original: Aster: Yes,[p/] it was quite distinct because of how high up he was.
translation: Aster: 是的，[p/]因为他当时位置那么高，这一点显得尤为奇异。

original: Aster: I could sense the aether rising out of the ground to his position on the catwalk.
translation: Aster: 我当时能感到以太从地面升起，向他所在的步道位置流去。

original: Celeste: So the guardrail was broken apart by this artificery.
translation: Celeste: 所以说护栏是被这个奥术能源装置破坏的。

original: Celeste: Is that why there weren't any traces of magic up there?
translation: Celeste: 这就是上面没有任何魔法痕迹的原因吗？

original: Tyrion: No...[p/] Artificery simply replicates the effects of an arcane spell.
translation: Tyrion: 不太对……[p/]奥术装置只是单纯复制某个法术的效应。

original: Tyrion: They leave traces of magic,[p/] just like spells cast by a mage do.
translation: Tyrion: 它们和被法师施放的法术一样，[p/]也会留下痕迹。

original: Tyrion: That also means our culprit wasn't necessarily a mage.[p/] [i]Anyone[/i] could have used a device like that.
translation: Tyrion: 这也意味着真凶不一定是法师。[p/][i]任何人[/i]都能利用奥术装置达成目的。

original: Aster: ...Not necessarily.
translation: Aster: ……并非如此。

original: Tyrion: What do you mean?
translation: Tyrion:这又是为什么？

original: Aster: The amount of aether being drawn was considerable.[p/] It was of a much a higher quantity than what most artificery devices are capable of.
translation: Aster: 当时的以太用量相当可观。[p/]已经远超出通常的奥术装置需求的水准。

original: Aster: Whatever that device was,[p/] it was quite advanced and dangerous.[p/] Something like that wouldn't be commonly available to the public.
translation: Aster: 不论那个装置具体是什么，[p/]它必然相当先进而且危险。[p/]那样的物品是不会向公众大面积供给的。

original: The military would definitely have access to a weapon like that, too...
translation: 但军方显然也有权使用那种武器的……

original: It pointed to Lucio Steelwind,[p/] but that just made his actions during the trial all the more bizarre.
translation: 那就指向了卢西奥·斯蒂尔文德，[p/]可这只会使他在庭审时的表现更为奇异。

original: Player: Lucio Steelwind
translation: Player: 卢西奥·斯蒂尔文德

original: Tyrion: ...What can you tell me about Grand General Steelwind?
translation: Tyrion: ……你能否跟我们谈一谈斯蒂尔文德大将军的事情呢？

original: Aster: The Grand General is a difficult man to speak of.
translation: Aster: 我们的大将军可是难以评说啊。

original: Aster: In recent days,[p/] his name alone carries the weight of thousands of slaughtered innocents.
translation: Aster: 近些日子，[p/]仅仅是他的名字，就重如千钧，碾过成千上万被屠戮的无辜者的性命。

original: Tyrion: I take it you don't care much for him?
translation: Tyrion: 我还以为您不太在乎他？

original: Aster: Not many do.[p/] Even the most heartless monster would see little sense in his bloody conquest in the countryside.
translation: Aster: 没多少人会这样。[p/]即使是最无情的怪物，也会为他在乡村的血腥征服行动感到一点惧意吧。

original: Aster: I was surprised when he took the stand at the trial yesterday,[p/] but I'm sure it's just another plot to undermine the other pillar families.
translation: Aster: 昨日他会出庭发言，我很惊讶。[p/]但我确信那只是他意图打压其他支柱家族而作出的又一个阴谋。

original: Aster: I had really hoped my arranged marriage to Lady Steelwind would sate his thirst for power,[p/] but it seems to have just made it worse.
translation: Aster: 我曾希望自己与斯蒂尔文德女士的婚约可以满足他对权力的渴望，[p/]但看起来只是让他变得更疯狂了。

original: Celeste: Wait...[p/] What did you just say?
translation: Celeste: 慢着……[p/]你刚刚说了什么？

original: Aster: Ah,[p/] of course.[p/] I suppose most outside of the nobility wouldn't be aware of it.
translation: Aster: 啊，[p/]当然了。[p/]我想除了贵族们，外面绝大多数人还没有注意到。

original: Aster: My father and the Grand General have arranged for me to marry Lady Steelwind.
translation: Aster: 父王和大将军安排了我和斯蒂尔文德女士的婚约。

original: Celeste: What?![p/][s/] She never told me she was engaged to the [i]Crown Prince[/i].
translation: Celeste: 真的？！[p/][s/]她可从来没跟我说过，她有和[i]王储殿下[/i]订婚啊。

original: Aster: I wouldn't blame her.[p/] She's not exactly pleased with our arrangement.
translation: Aster: 我不会因此责怪她。[p/]实际上她一点都不因我们的婚约感到喜悦。

original: Aster: That woman despises me.
translation: Aster: 那位女士轻蔑于我。

original: Tyrion: ...What?
translation: Tyrion: ……怎么会？

original: Aster: Our marriage is purely political—[p/]a way to unify the royal family with the upper brass of the military.
translation: Aster: 我们纯粹是政治联姻——[p/]是将王室与军方高层结成同盟的手段。

original: Aster: I admire her desire to bring prosperity to the commonfolk,[p/] but I unfortunately seem to represent everything she hates about this kingdom.
translation: Aster: 我尊敬她为平民带去繁荣发展的愿望，[p/]但不幸的是，我恰恰代表着她在这个王国憎恨的一切。

original: Aster: She can't even stand speaking to me.[p/] Every time I'm around her,[p/] she can barely contain her contempt.
translation: Aster: 她甚至无法忍受与我交谈。[p/]每当我出现在她附近，[p/]她几乎无法保持镇定。

original: Celeste: Oh no...
translation: Celeste: 不是吧……

original: Aster: But I've made my peace with that.[p/] She's always cared more about her duty than anything else.
translation: Aster: 但我能平和地看待这个问题。[p/]她总是将自身的职责看得比什么都重要。

original: Aster: When I take the throne,[p/] I will build her a compassionate kingdom that she can take pride in.
translation: Aster: 到我继承王位的时候，[p/]我将为她建设一个能让她为之骄傲的仁爱国家。

original: ...I really wanted to believe him,[p/] but I knew better than to trust empty promises like that.
translation: ……我真的很想相信他。[p/]但我知道这样的空头承诺是最不能相信的。

original: I guess only time would tell what kind of ruler he would be.
translation: 我想，只有时间能证明他会实行怎样的统治。

original: Player: The Stolen Item
translation: Player: 被盗的货物

original: Player: BACK
Tyrion: Aster, I've been hearing an awful lot about how the serial robber stole that item from your ship.
translation: Tyrion: 阿斯特，我有听到许多传闻，那个作下连环盗窃案的劫匪从你的船上也盗走了货物。

original: Aster: Ah, that.[p/] The Kingsguard have been scrambling around trying to find it.
translation: Aster: 啊，那个啊。[p/]国王卫队正四处奔波，想找它回来。

original: Tyrion: Would you be able to tell me what they stole?
translation: Tyrion: 你能否告诉我吗，被偷走的是什么呢？

original: Aster: Hm...[p/] I don't know.
translation: Aster: 嗯……[p/]我并不知道。

original: Tyrion: I've been having a lot of trouble pinning down what the thief was after.
translation: Tyrion: 我很难确定小偷到底在找什么。

original: Tyrion: If they infiltrated your ship,[p/] they were taking a gigantic risk.[p/] They wouldn't have done that without a good reason.
translation: Tyrion: 他们潜入你的船，[p/]可以说是冒着巨大的风险。[p/]没有充分理由的话他们不会这么做的。

original: Aster: ...
translation: Aster: ……

original: Aster: They stole several high-capacity arcane crystals attuned to the school of [b]evocation[/b].
translation: Aster: 他们偷走的是一些已充满[b]塑能术[b]魔力的高容量奥术水晶。

original: Tyrion: Arcane crystals are pretty common, aren't they?[p/][s/] They're what draw and provide power to artificery devices.
translation: Tyrion: 但奥术水晶不是很常见的吗？[p/][s/]毕竟奥术能源装置都要靠它们供给魔力。

original: Aster: The problem is that they're attuned to [b]evocation[/b]:[p/] the most raw and destructive school of magic.
translation: Aster: 问题是这一批已经充满了[b]塑能术[/b]的魔力，[p/]而那正是法术学派中最为粗暴、破坏力最大的一种。

original: Aster: Artificery that uses [b]evocation[/b] is heavily supervised by the kingdom,[p/] and most devices that use them are extremely weak.
translation: Aster: 在王国，使用[b]塑能术[/b]的奥术装置受到重度管控，[p/]而使用这类法术的装置也都相当脆弱。

original: Aster: Those crystals were a shipment addressed to Von Sanctus Industries.[p/] They were meant to be received at port and used to construct weapons for use by the military.
translation: Aster: 这些水晶是预定发往冯·桑克图斯实业的货物。[p/]它们原定在港口被接收，用于组装军队配备的武器。

original: Tyrion: Are these crystals really that valuable?
translation: Tyrion: 那批水晶这么重要吗？

original: Aster: They have a large capacity to channel [b]evocation[/b] magic.[p/] They're extremely potent at unleashing energy,
translation: Aster: 它们已经储存了巨量的[b]塑能术[/b]魔力，[p/]而且可以非常高效地释放。

original: Aster: In the wrong hands,[p/] they could produce an explosion with the power to level an entire block of this city.
translation: Aster: 一旦操作不当，[p/]它们就能造成一次足以将一整个城区夷为平地的爆炸。

original: Tyrion: ...And there have been mass reports of insurrection here, too.
translation: Tyrion: ……而且这里也出现了大量叛乱活动的报告。

original: Whether those reports were true or not,[p/] my teeth clenched at the thought of what someone might do with those crystals.
translation: 无论那些报告是真是假，[p/] 一想到有人可能会用那些水晶做些什么，我便不自觉地牙关紧咬。

original: It was even worse to think about what the Grand General might do to stop that from happening.
translation: 而一想到大将军可能会采取什么措施来阻止这种情况发生，就更让人感到不安。

original: Player: Runestone
Aster: That's—!
translation: Aster: 那就是——！

original: Tyrion: It’s an Attorney’s Runestone.[p/] It's—
translation: Tyrion: 这是个律师符石。[p/]它——

original: Aster: It's proof that you're a certified attorney!
translation: Aster: 它证明你是一位持证律师！

original: Aster: I've never seen one of these up close before!
translation: Aster: 我还从没这么近地看过这个东西！

original: Celeste: Really?[p/] I thought the Crown Prince would be the first person to have a Runestone like this.
translation: Celeste: 真的？[p/]我还以为王储殿下应该是最优先拥有这种符石的呢。

original: Aster: I have a Runestone,[p/][s/] but it's not an [i]Attorney's[/i] Runestone!
translation: Aster: 我确实拥有符石，[p/][s/]但那可不是[i]律师专属[/i]的符石！

original: Tyrion: Finally![p/][s/] Someone that understands the difference!
translation: Tyrion: 终于啊！[p/][s/]终于有人明白其间的差异了！

original: Celeste: ...
translation: Celeste: ……

original: Player: Tyrion
Aster: I can't believe I'm meeting Tyrion Cuthbert!
translation: Aster: 难以置信，我竟然与那位提利昂·卡斯伯特会面了！

original: Tyrion: I appreciate the admiration,[p/] but I don't see what's so special about me.
translation: Tyrion: 我感激你的喜爱，[p/]但我不知道自己有什么特别的。

original: Aster: Well, I've been an admirer of Ruby Tymora for a while,[p/] but your story is far more inspiring!
translation: Aster: 这个嘛，我有段时间曾是鲁比·泰摩拉的粉丝，[p/]但你的故事可是更加的振奋人心！

original: Aster: ...You rose above the tragedy that befell your mother,[p/] and became a force against the nobility.
translation: Aster: ……你从母亲遭遇的不幸悲剧中振作起来，[p/]成长为反对贵族的力量。

original: Tyrion: ...How do you know about that?
translation: Tyrion: ……你怎么知道这个的？

original: Aster: I read about your story in the paper—[p/]a grieving child,[p/] who walked into the woods in despair.
translation: Aster: 我在报纸上读到了你的故事——[p/]一个身怀悲痛的孩子，[p/]走入森林然后就此消失。

original: Aster: That story made quite an impression on me.
translation: Aster: 那个故事给我造成了很深的印象。

original: Aster: When I saw the story of Ms. McCoy's trial,[p/] I recognized you immediately.
translation: Aster: 而当我读到麦考伊女士的庭审报道时，[p/]我马上就认出了你。

original: Aster: I'm so glad that you survived.
translation: Aster: 你能存活下来，我太高兴了。

original: Tyrion: ...
translation: Tyrion: ……

original: Celeste: ...?
translation: Celeste: ……？

original: Player: Celeste
Aster: I never imagined that I'd meet the Crimson Demon of the Eastern Kingdoms.
translation: Aster: 我从未想象过自己会遇见东方古国的那位“绯红恶魔”啊。

original: Celeste: Okay,[p/] how the hell did you find out about that nickname?
translation: Celeste: 好啦，[p/]你到底怎么知道那个该死的绰号的？

original: Aster: O-[p/][s/]Oh,[p/] uh—
translation: Aster: 呃、[p/][s/]哦，[p/]这个——

original: Aster: My position as the Crown Prince makes me privy to stories like that.
translation: Aster: 作为王储，我是有权知晓这类情报的。

original: Tyrion: ...What is the "Crimson Demon", anyways?
translation: Tyrion: 说到底，“绯红恶魔”到底是个什么东西？

original: Celeste: ...I don't want to talk about it.
translation: Celeste: ……我才不想谈论这个。

original: I decided to drop the subject.
translation: 我决定中止这个话题。

original: Player: Aria
Aster: Ah,[p/] Lady Steelwind.[p/] I'm glad to see my fiancée is growing into her role.
translation: Aster: 啊，[p/]斯蒂尔文德女士。[p/]看到自己的未婚妻正逐渐适应她的事业，我很欣慰。

original: Player: Ruby
Aster: Is Ruby Tymora here as well?
translation: Aster: 鲁比·泰摩拉是不是也在这里呢？

original: Aster: I was wondering if you could put in a good word for me.[p/] I've been wanting her autograph.
translation: Aster: 我在想你们能否为我说点好话。[p/]我一直想要她的签名。

original: Tyrion: [i]You're[/i] the Crown Prince.[p/] Couldn't you just ask her yourself?
translation: Tyrion: [i]你可是[/i]王储殿下啊。[p/]就不能直接问她本人要吗？

original: Aster: I-[p/][s/]I've tried,[p/] but the last time I saw her,[p/] she had very[p/] [i]strong[/i] words for me.
translation: Aster: 我、[p/][s/]我其实有试过。[p/]但我上次遇到她的时候，[p/]她对我的言辞十分[p/][i]强硬[/i]。

original: That [i]did[/i] make sense.[p/] She had more animosity towards the aristocracy than [i]I[/i] did.
translation: 那[i]倒是[/i]很有可能。[p/]她对贵族的敌意更胜于[i]我[/i]。

original: Player: Lloyd
Aster: I heard about your chess match with the Duke of Commerce.
translation: Aster: 我听说你和商业公爵的那场棋赛了。

original: Aster: I wish I could have seen it myself!
translation: Aster: 真希望自己能亲眼观赛啊！

original: Tyrion: There wasn't much to see.[p/] For all his arrogance,[p/] The Duke was a pushover.
translation: Tyrion: 没什么好看的。[p/]尽管公爵相当傲慢，[p/]但他太好对付了。

original: Aster: [i]*sigh*[/i][p/] That just makes me regret it more.[p/] I would've loved to see that weasel put in his place.
translation: Aster: [i]*叹气*[/i][p/]这可让我更为后悔了。[p/]我是很想要看那个鼠辈自取其辱的模样。

original: Tyrion: ...Isn't he one of the kingdom's dukes?[p/] I'd thought you two would be more amicable.
translation: Tyrion: ……他不是王国下的一位公爵吗？[p/]我还以为你们两位会更和睦一点。

original: Aster: No one knows more about the oppression of the Four Pillars than I do.
translation: Aster: 没有人比我更清楚四大支柱家族造成了多少压迫。

original: ...What?
translation: ……什么？

original: Player: Coraline
Aster: [i]*sigh*[/i][p/] Coraline Sibyl:[p/] the Minister of Justice.
translation: Aster: [i]*叹气*[/i][p/]卡洛琳·希比尔：[p/]我们的司法部长。

original: Tyrion: ...It doesn't sound like you have a high opinion of her.
translation: Tyrion: ……听起来你对她的评价不怎么高啊。

original: Aster: She's the most powerful of the Four Pillar Lords,[p/] but she's also the most apathetic.
translation: Aster: 她明明是四大支柱家族里最有实力的一位，[p/]但也是最冷漠的那个。

original: Aster: Our system of governance is broken.[p/] She has the power to change it,[p/] yet she and her House of Lords do nothing.
translation: Aster: 我们的统治机制已然失效了。[p/]她明明有力量改变这点，[p/]但她和她的贵族议院却什么都不做。

original: Tyrion: ...If you care so much,[p/] [i]you[/i] have the ability to change it.
translation: Tyrion: ……你如果这么担忧，[p/]那[i]你[/i]同样有能力去改变啊。

original: Tyrion: You're a part of the royal family, for crying out loud.
translation: Tyrion: 老天，你毕竟是王室成员啊。

original: Aster: One [i]would[/i] think that, wouldn't they?
translation: Aster: 人们[i]大概[/i]都是这么想的，对吧？

original: Player: Lucio
Aster: ...I would appreciate it if you didn't speak of the Grand General unless necessary.
translation: Aster: ……如果没有必要，请你不要提起大将军，我会为此感激的。

original: Tyrion: ...I take it you don't care for him?
translation: Tyrion: ……我还以为你没那么在乎他？

original: Aster: ...How could I?[p/] My heart aches for the innocent people he's slaughtered.
translation: Aster: ……怎么可能呢？[p/]他屠戮那些无辜的民众，让我十分心痛。

original: Aster: All because of these supposed "insurrections".
translation: Aster: 而那些人只因他假定的“叛乱”就惨遭杀害。

original: Tyrion: ...If you really feel that strongly about it,[p/] why hasn't the royal family done anything to stop him?
translation: Tyrion: ……如果你对此有这么强烈的反应，[p/]王室为什么不做些什么来组织他？

original: Aster: House Steelwind controls the only military force equipped to maintain order in Wyverngarde.
translation: Aster: 斯蒂尔文德家控制着唯一一支能够维持维文加德王国秩序的军队。

original: Aster: I can't say more,[p/] but their mages are also the only thing standing between us and war with the other kingdoms.
translation: Aster: 虽然不能多说，[p/]不过他们的法师是我们面对其他国家时仅有的保障。

original: Aster: They are our greatest asset,[p/] while also being our greatest failure.
translation: Aster: 他们既是王国最重要的财富，[p/]也是我们最大的失败。

original: Player: Aster
Tyrion: I've read a lot of stories about the Crown Prince in the paper,[p/] but they never mention you by name.
translation: Tyrion: 我从报纸上读到了大量关于王储殿下的报道，[p/]但上面从不用名字来称呼你。

original: Aster: ...That's intentional.[p/] I prefer not to have my name associated with my title.
translation: Aster: ……那是有意为之。[p/]我希望不要让自己的名字和头衔联系在一起。

original: Celeste: You've done a lot of charity work for the less fortunate, haven't you?
translation: Celeste: 你不是有向贫困人群做了很多慈善工作吗？

original: Aster: Yes,[p/] we've hosted so [i]many[/i] fundraisers for them.
translation: Aster: 是的。[p/]我们为这些人组织了[i]很多[/i]筹款会。

original: Tyrion: ...You're not a fan of fundraisers.
translation: Tyrion: ……但你并不热爱筹款活动。

original: Aster: I'm not a fan of aristocrats who think they can alleviate their guilt by giving me their spare gold.
translation: Aster: 我并不喜欢那些认为向我捐出有余的财物就能减轻自己罪愆的贵族。

original: Player: UnionTensions
Aster: Hm...[p/] I'm sad to say that tensions such as these are rampant throughout the kingdom.
translation: Aster: 嗯……[p/]很遗憾的是，这种冲突在王国各地都十分普遍。

original: Aster: It's just the same conflict between the commoners and the aristocrats that I've always seen.
translation: Aster: 这与我们常见的平民与贵族的冲突是一样的。

original: Tyrion: Dracogen isn't exactly an aristocrat.[p/] He's just a merchant.
translation: Tyrion: 德拉科根并不是贵族。[p/]他只是商人。

original: Aster: In the eyes of the commonfolk,[p/] there's very little difference.[p/] He has wealth and power,[p/] while they do not.
translation: Aster: 在平民们的眼中，[p/]两者并没有太大区别。[p/]他拥有财富与权力，[p/]而平民没有。

original: Tyrion: But I think he [i]is[/i] trying to help them.[p/] I'm fairly certain these "tensions" are just fabricated stories.
translation: Tyrion: 但我认为他[i]确实[/i]试图帮助平民。[p/]我比较确定，所谓的“冲突”只是编造的故事。

original: Aster: ...Is that so?
translation: Aster: ……真的是这样吗？

original: Aster: Even so,[p/] I think the damage is already done.
translation: Aster: 即便如此，[p/]我认为也实际上造成了伤害。

original: Aster: I can only hope Mr. Dracogen's intentions are as noble as you claim they are.
translation: Aster: 我只能期望德拉科根的意图如你宣称的一般高尚。

original: Player: ShipRep|Blockade
Player: Treason
Aster: ...I can certainly sympathize with the insurrectionists' displeasure with the kingdom.
translation: Aster: ……我当然能理解起义群众对王国的不满。

original: Aster: With what the Grand General has been doing in the countryside,[p/] this was inevitable.
translation: Aster: 考虑到大将军在乡村的行径，[p/]这种反应本就无可避免。

original: Tyrion: ...If you sympathize with them so much,[p/] why hasn't anything been done?
translation: Tyrion: ……你如果这么同情他们，[p/]为何什么都不做？

original: Aster: I won't blame you for saying that,[p/] but there's only so much I can do.
translation: Aster: 我不责怪你的言语，[p/]但我也只能做这么多了。

original: Aster: I hate to say it,[p/] but the royal family has a lot less influence than you'd think,[p/] especially when it comes to the Four Pillars.
translation: Aster: 虽然不愿这么说，[p/]但王室的影响力远比你想得要小，[p/]特别是与四大支柱家族相比。

original: Aster: My family holds the crown,[p/] but the dukes and duchesses hold everything else.
translation: Aster: 我的家族持有王冠，[p/]但公爵们持有其他的一切。

original: ...Was that really true?
translation: ……真的是这样吗？

original: Player: RikaTest2
Aster: A mysterious, magical explosion pushed Mr. Waye off that catwalk...
translation: Aster: 一个神秘的魔法爆炸将维耶先生从步道上推了下去……

original: Tyrion: There aren't any magical traces there either.
translation: Tyrion: 也没有残留任何魔法痕迹。

original: Aster: It's quite the mystery, isn't it?
translation: Aster: 这挺神秘的，不是吗？

original: Aster: Although,[p/] I have no doubts that you'll be able to solve it, Mr. Cuthbert.
translation: Aster: 即便如此，[p/]我毫不怀疑你能够解明这个问题，卡斯伯特先生。

original: Hopefully,[p/] I could live up to his expectations.
translation: 但愿如此吧，[p/]我不能辜负他的期望。

original: Player: Default
Tyrion: Aster, what can you tell me about this?
translation: Tyrion: 阿斯特，关于这个你能告诉我什么吗？

original: Aster: My apologies...[p/] I don't think I can help you with that.
translation: Aster: 容我致歉……[p/]我不认为能在这个问题上帮到你。

original: Tyrion: Okay, I think that answers all of my questions.[p/] Thank you, Aster.
translation: Tyrion: 好的，我想这已经解答了我所有的问题。[p/]谢谢你，阿斯特。

original: Aster: Of course![p/][s/] I'm just happy to help.
translation: Aster: 没问题！[p/][s/]能帮上你我很高兴。

original: I was hoping that the Crown Prince had spotted the thief,[p/] but all he saw was some hairless rodent.
translation: 我本希望王储殿下有看到那个窃贼，[p/]但他只看到了某种无毛的鼠类。

original: I would just need to look into my other leads and hope that would lead somewhere.
translation: 我现在得查看一下其他线索，并希望它们能够通过它们取得进展。

original: Either way,[p/] it was time to MOVE somewhere else.
translation: 无论是哪一条，[p/]都到了向其他地方<size=1.5em>移动</size>的时候了。

original: Player: Card
Tyrion: It's some kind of tarot card.
translation: Tyrion: 这是某种塔罗牌。

original: Mosourika: A customer must have accidentally left it here.
translation: Mosourika: 应该是某个顾客不经意留在这的。

original: Tyrion: "The Magician..."
translation: Tyrion: “魔术师……”

original: Mosourika: The Magician is associated with the power of transformation and manifestation.
translation: Mosourika: 魔术师与转变和显现的力量相关联。

original: Mosourika: And it's in its upright position,[p/] which is associated with the resourcefulness to harness one's inner potential.
translation: Mosourika: 如果是正位的话，[p/]意味着一个人的内在具有发展的潜力。

original: Mosourika: It often symbolizes a person who possesses great skill,[p/] creativity,[p/] and mastery over their craft.
translation: Mosourika: 这张牌通常代表技艺精湛、[p/]创造力出色的人。

original: Tyrion: …I never knew you knew about these things.
translation: Tyrion:  ……没想到你还懂塔罗牌。

original: Mosourika: Ha![p/][s/] Of course, I do!
translation: Mosourika: 哈！[p/][s/]我当然懂！

original: Mosourika: The power of the magician is the power to shape reality through the power of will!
translation: Mosourika: 魔术师的力量是通过意志力来改变现实事物！

original: Mosourika: Doesn't [i]that[/i] remind you of someone?
translation: Mosourika: 你不觉得<u>这点</u>让你想到某人吗？

original: Tyrion: No...[p/] Not really.
translation: Tyrion: 没……[p/]没想到谁。

original: Mosourika: Hey!
translation: Mosourika: 嘿！

original: Player: Barrels
Tyrion: There are some barrels stacked in the corner here.
translation: Tyrion: 角落里有些木桶叠在一起。

original: Celeste: I wonder what's inside.
translation: Celeste: 我很好奇里面是什么。

original: Celeste: Wait...[p/] Rika.[p/] You wouldn't happen to have Lotus Juice, do you?
translation: Celeste: 等等……[p/]里卡，[p/]你该不会有莲之水吧？

original: Mosourika: "Lotus Juice"? [p/] What's that?
translation: Mosourika: “莲之水”？[p/]那是什么东西？

original: Celeste: [i]*sigh*[/i][p/] Never mind.
translation: Celeste: [i]*叹气*[/i][p/]当我没说。

original: Tyrion: What happened to the Lotus Juice that you "received" from Miriam?
translation: Tyrion: 你从米莉亚姆那“收到”的莲之水怎么样了？

original: Celeste: I drank all of it…
translation: Celeste: 我全部喝掉了……

original: Already...?[p/] She'd only had it for a month.
translation: 就喝完了……？[p/]她上个月才获赠的啊。

original: Player: Table
Tyrion: This table looks [i]really[/i] well-made.
translation: Tyrion: 这张桌子做得<u>很</u>不错。

original: Mosourika: You like it?[p/] I commissioned a local carpenter to have my tables custom-made.
translation: Mosourika: 你喜欢它吗？[p/]我从当地的一个木匠那里订制了这张桌子。

original: Celeste: It was probably worth it.
translation: Celeste: 还是物有所值的。

original: Celeste: They fit with the rustic vibe you've got going on here.
translation: Celeste: 它们与这里质朴的氛围很搭。

original: Player: Plant
Rika seemed to have decorated the entire café with several plants and flowers.
translation: 里卡在咖啡馆里各处都装饰了花花草草。

original: The green added a fresh and earthy look to the restaurant.
translation: 绿意为这家餐厅增加了清新而质朴的氛围。

original: Player: Lantern
There were artificery lights hanging from the ceiling.
translation: 天花板上吊下奥术能源驱动的灯具。

original: Tyrion: Your business must be doing pretty well if you can afford artificery like this.
translation: Tyrion: 能用得起这样的奥术灯，你的生意看来挺不错的。

original: Mosourika: That's just one of the benefits I get from working with the Dracogen Trading Company.
translation: Mosourika: 这只是我和德拉科根贸易公司合作的好处之一。

original: Mosourika: Most of the merchants connect to the artificery ley line.
translation: Mosourika: 绝大多数商人都接上了奥术地脉。

original: Player: Shelf
There was a shelf full of drinks,[p/] mugs,[p/] and sugar behind the restaurant counter.
translation: 在餐厅柜台后面有一个架子，上面放满了饮料、[p/]杯子、[p/]奶油[p/]和糖。

original: It must've been where Rika's employees prepared coffee to be served.
translation: 这里一定是里卡的员工准备咖啡的地方。

original: Player: The Court Case
translation: Player: 庭审的情况

original: Tyrion: Alright,[p/] let's get to work.
translation: Tyrion: 好吧， [p/]该谈正事了。

original: Tyrion: You said that you saw someone cast a spell that pushed Justin into the vats.
translation: Tyrion: 你有说过，你看到了有人施放法术，把贾斯汀推进了精炼容器中。

original: Tyrion: Can you tell me exactly what you saw?[p/] I need every detail you can remember.
translation: Tyrion: 能告诉我你到底看到了什么吗？[p/]我需要你能记起来的每一个细节。

original: Mosourika: It was kind of hard to see.[p/] I was on the ground level,[p/] and he was up on the catwalk.
translation: Mosourika: 其实很难看得清楚，[p/]毕竟我是站在地上，[p/]而他是在高高的步道上。

original: Mosourika: I think I saw him yelling at someone from up there.
translation: Mosourika: 我应该有看到他在上面向某个人大吼大叫。

original: Mosourika: ...That's when I saw a flash of light.
translation: Mosourika: ……就在那时我看到一道闪光。

original: Mosourika: There was a short burst of magical energy that ripped the guardrail apart.
translation: Mosourika: 当时有一股魔力短暂爆发，将护栏撕碎。

original: Mosourika: Justin happened to be standing right next to the top of a nearby vat.[p/] He fell right into it.
translation: Mosourika: 贾斯汀刚好就站在一尊精炼容器的上空附近。[p/]他就那么掉落进去。

original: Mosourika: I told one of the workers what I saw,[p/] and they went to try to pull him out.
translation: Mosourika: 我向一名工人告诉了看到的情况，[p/]他们赶过去想将他救出来。

original: Mosourika: But I guess it was too late.[p/] Those chemicals must have been really toxic.
translation: Mosourika: 但我想已经太晚了。[p/]那里面的化学物质肯定毒性很强。

original: They weren't just toxic.[p/] They were strong enough to completely melt down his body.
translation: 不只是有毒。[p/]它强力到足以融化他的躯体。

original: Mosourika: ...There's actually something else.
translation: Mosourika: ……还有一点。

original: Mosourika: I saw Justin drop something from his hands before he fell into that vat.
translation: Mosourika: 我看到贾斯汀掉下去前，他把什么东西从手里丢了出来。

original: Mosourika: After they pulled him out,[p/] I tried looking for it and cast [b]Detect Magic[/b].
translation: Mosourika: 工人们将他的遗体打捞出来后，[p/]我为了寻找那个东西施放了[b]法术探测[/b]。

original: Mosourika: That's when I found [i]this[/i] on the ground below the walkway.
translation: Mosourika: 然后我就在步道下方的地面发现了[i]这个[/i]。

original: Tyrion: A leather strap?
translation: Tyrion: 是一条皮带？

original: I looked at the strap more closely.
translation: 我仔细观察那条皮带。

original: It had a buckle on it,[p/] but nothing to connect it with.
translation: 上面有个搭扣，[p/]但并没有连接什么东西。

original: :The numerals: "VI",[p/] were engraved on it.[p/] I was really confused as to what the purpose of this was.
translation: :上面刻有“VI”的字样。[p/]我对这个东西的用法感到非常疑惑。

original: Mosourika: I saw a blue glow when I looked at it.
translation: Mosourika: 我看到这个东西的时候上面有一层蓝光。

original: Celeste: It was cyan?[p/] That's the color of [b]conjuration[b/] traces.
translation: Celeste: 是青色吗？[p/]那是[b]召唤术[b/]的痕迹啊。

original: Mosourika: I tried to give it to the investigators,[p/] but they didn't think it was important.
translation: Mosourika: 我有试过将它提交调查，[p/]但他们认为这个东西不重要。

original: I guess that made sense.[p/] They were considering this an accident,[p/] not a murder.
translation: 也有道理。[p/]他们大概只认为这起案件是个意外，[p/]而非谋杀案。

original: Player: Why were you there?
translation: Player: 你为什么在场？

original: Tyrion: Why [i]were[/i] you at the refinery anyway?
translation: Tyrion: 话说回来，你为什么[i]在[/i]精炼厂呢？

original: Tyrion: You don't work there, do you?
translation: Tyrion: 你又不在那里工作，对吧？

original: Mosourika: ...I was delivering Justin's breakfast.
translation: Mosourika: ……我是去给贾斯汀送早餐的。

original: Mosourika: He always skips it.[p/] It really annoys me,[p/] so I started bringing some of my pastries over every morning.
translation: Mosourika: 他老是不吃早餐。[p/]我因此很生气，[p/]所以开始每天早上带点自己家的糕点过去。

original: Celeste: What?[p/] Breakfast is the most important meal of the day!
translation: Celeste: 怎么能这样？[p/]早餐可是一日里最重要的那一餐啊！

original: Tyrion: ...So important that you ate it multiple times yesterday.
translation: Tyrion: ……重要到你昨天吃了好几顿。

original: Celeste: I have a high metabolism, okay?
translation: Celeste: 我的代谢量很大，好吧？

original: Tyrion: ...Anyways,[p/] isn't it kind of dangerous to let a civilian walk around a factory like that?
translation: Tyrion: ……扯远了，[p/]但让一个普通人在工厂里随意走动不是有点危险吗？

original: Mosourika: Ha![p/][s/] I am no ordinary civilian!
translation: Mosourika: 哈！[p/][s/]我才不是什么普通人！

original: Mosourika: No one there would dare to bar my visit to the refinery.
translation: Mosourika: 没有人敢禁止我访问精炼厂。

original: Tyrion: ...Which means that you don't usually visit the Refinery.
translation: Tyrion: ……也就是说你平常并不会到精炼厂去。

original: Mosourika: ...Yeah,[p/] I usually just meet Justin in the freight area.
translation: Mosourika: ……是的，[p/]我平常是在货运区和贾斯汀碰头。

original: Mosourika: But he didn't show up that day,[p/] so I got worried and went looking around.
translation: Mosourika: 但那天他不在，[p/]所以我有点担心，到处去找他。

original: Mosourika: The people who work there recognized me and let me in.
translation: Mosourika: 在那里的工人认出了我，让我进去了。

original: Mosourika: ...That's when I saw him fall into the vat.
translation: Mosourika: ……然后我就目睹了他坠入容器的那一幕。

original: Player: The Spell
Tyrion: Did you recognize the spell Justin was hit with?
translation: Tyrion: 你有认出击中贾斯汀的法术是什么吗？

original: Mosourika: I [i]am[/i] a mage,[p/] but I've never seen a spell like that before.
translation: Mosourika: 我[i]虽然是[/i]法师，[p/]但也从没见过那样的法术。

original: Mosourika: It happened instantly,[p/] and it didn't look like an explosion or anything.
translation: Mosourika: 它是瞬间发动的，[p/]看起来并不像爆炸或者类似的什么东西。

original: Mosourika: It kind of looked more like...[p/] an expanding prism.
translation: Mosourika: 它看起来更像是……[p/]一个迅速长大的棱柱。

original: Celeste: ...A prism?
translation: Celeste: ……棱柱？

original: Tyrion: Does that match with any spells that [i]you're[/i] familiar with?
translation: Tyrion: 那有与[i]你[/i]熟悉的法术吻合吗？

original: Celeste: I specialize in [b]transmutation[/b] spells,[p/] but any of the spells I know that could create a cube wouldn't expand instantly like that.
translation: Celeste: 我是专精于[b]形变术[/b]的，[p/]但我知道的所有能够创造一个立方体的法术都不会像那样急速膨胀。

original: Tyrion: The problem is that the Inquisition didn't find [i]any[/i] traces of magic on the walkway...
translation: Tyrion: 而且归根结底，问题就是裁判所没有在步道上发现[i]任何[/i]法术痕迹……

original: Tyrion: It couldn't have been an [b]evocation[/b] spell or a [b]transmutation[/b] spell.
translation: Tyrion: 那既不可能是[b]塑能术[/b] ，也不可能是[b]形变术[/b]。

original: Celeste: I actually wanted to ask you about that.[p/] Why would an explosive [b]evocation[/b] spell leave traces of magic?
translation: Celeste: 我正好想问你这个。[p/]为什么[b]塑能术[/b]造成爆炸的时候也会留下法术痕迹？

original: Celeste: Magical traces are only left on the objects they are targeting.[p/] Something like a [b]fireball[/b] spell isn't technically targeting anything.
translation: Celeste: 法术痕迹只留存在法术的施放对象上。[p/]像[b]火球术[/b]那样的法术实际上不需要任何目标就能施放。

original: Tyrion: That's correct,[p/] but every [b]evocation[/b] spell produces some kind of residue.
translation: Tyrion: 你说的没错，[p/]但所有[b]塑能术[/b]都会产生一些残留物。

original: Tyrion: In the case of [b]fireball[/b],[p/] its magical traces would be left on whatever it had burned or melted.
translation: Tyrion: 以[b]火球术[/b]为例，[p/]它的痕迹会留在法术灼烧或者熔化的东西上。

original: Tyrion: If someone used an [b]evocation[/b] spell powerful enough to rip the guardrail apart,[p/] they would've found traces of [b]evocation[/b] there.
translation: Tyrion: 如果有人用了足够强劲的[b]塑能术[/b]破坏了护栏，[p/]那个位置就会发现[b]塑能术[/b]的痕迹。

original: Mosourika: Wow,[p/] I never knew how technical these things were.
translation: Mosourika: 哇哦，[p/]我还从不知道这里面有这么多门道呢。

original: Tyrion: We're lucky they are.[p/] Otherwise,[p/] I'd have a lot less evidence to work with.
translation: Tyrion: 我们还是挺走运的。[p/]否则，[p/]我就没有那么多证据用以参考了。

original: Mosourika: ...If what you're saying is true,[p/] was I wrong about what I saw?
translation: Mosourika: ……如果你说的是真的，[p/]那是我看错了吗？

original: Tyrion: I wouldn't say that.
translation: Tyrion: 我不这么认为。

original: Tyrion: I've been doing this long enough to know that there's always an explanation for oddities like this.
translation: Tyrion: 我做这行的时间也不短了，知道像这样奇异的现象总是有解释的。

original: Mosourika: A gem with strange carvings?[p/] Is it cursed?
translation: Mosourika: 一块刻着奇异纹路的宝石？[p/]上面附有诅咒吗？

original: Tyrion: It’s an Attorney’s Runestone.[p/] It proves that I’m a certified attorney.
translation: Tyrion: 这是个律师符石。[p/]它证明我持证律师的身份。

original: Tyrion: It’s fitted with artificery.[p/][s/] I can use it to take pictures of evidence and crime scenes.
translation: Tyrion: 这个里面适配了奥术能源，[p/][s/]我就能用它拍下证据和案发现场的照片。

original: Mosourika: ...Really?
translation: Mosourika: ……真的吗？

original: Mosourika: Do you know where I can get one of those?
translation: Mosourika: 你知道我在哪里能得到吗？

original: Tyrion: You have to be an attorney to have one.
translation: Tyrion: 你得成为律师才能拥有它。

original: Celeste: Tyrion...[p/] People use Runestones for things other than practicing law.
translation: Celeste: 提利昂……[p/]大家可以用符石做很多无关法律的事情。

original: Mosourika: I'm sorry I had to drag you into this.[p/] I didn't know who else to turn to.
translation: Mosourika: 真对不起，把你卷进这个烂摊子。[p/]我真不知道该找谁帮忙了。

original: Tyrion: Don't worry about it.[p/] You've saved me more times than I can count.
translation: Tyrion: 别担心这个。[p/]你拯救我的次数都数不清了。

original: Mosourika: Wait...[p/] When did I save you?
translation: Mosourika: 等等啊……[p/]我什么时候救过你了？

original: Tyrion: ...Did you forget?[p/] It's how we met.
translation: Tyrion: ……你不记得了吗？[p/]我们就是那时候相遇的啊。

original: Celeste: What happened?
translation: Celeste: 发生什么了？

original: Tyrion: I was always getting harassed by some of the older kids by the harbor.
translation: Tyrion: 我那时经常被港口那些大一点的孩子骚扰。

original: Tyrion: One day,[p/] they tried to steal the allowance my mother gave me.
translation: Tyrion: 有一天，[p/]他们想把母亲给我的零花钱偷走。

original: Tyrion: You stepped in and stopped them.
translation: Tyrion: 那时候你介入进来阻止了他们。

original: Mosourika: Ah,[p/] I remember those cretins now.
translation: Mosourika: 啊，[p/]我记起那些白痴了。

original: Mosourika: They had no choice but to flee from the weight of my majesty.
translation: Mosourika: 他们除了从本大人的重压下逃走之外，别无选择。

original: Tyrion: She basically knew how to scream in the most alarming way.
translation: Tyrion: 其实就是她知道怎么用尖叫让人惊恐万分。

original: Tyrion: It sounded like something between a rabid fox and a screeching baby.
translation: Tyrion: 那声音听起来像是发狂的狐狸或者惊啼的婴儿。

original: Mosourika: A-[p/][s/]Ah, yes.[p/] My battle cry alone was enough to end battles before they started.
translation: Mosourika: 呃、[p/][s/]嗯，没错。[p/]吾之战吼足以令战争在开始前就终结。

original: Mosourika: ...It drew the attention of law enforcement.[p/] They thought a monster had broken into the city.
translation: Mosourika: .……那声音吸引了安保的注意。[p/]他们还以为是怪物闯入城市里了。

original: Tyrion: I think that's when I became your "apprentice".[p/] We'd always go on adventures together through the city.
translation: Tyrion: 自那以后，我就成了你的“徒弟”。[p/]后来我们经常一同穿越整座城市探险。

original: Mosourika: Yes,[p/] and look how much you've grown![p/] I'm glad I put you on the path to greatness!
translation: Mosourika: 是啊，[p/]看看如今你都成长成什么样了！[p/]真高兴本人将你引上这条伟大的道路！

original: Mosourika: ...
translation: Mosourika: ……

original: Mosourika: ...I really miss those days.
translation: Mosourika: ……我真的很怀念那些日子。

original: Tyrion: ...Me too.
translation: Tyrion: ……我也是。

original: Mosourika: ...After all this is over,[p/] let's go on another adventure.
translation: Mosourika: ……把这一切处理好后，[p/]我们来一场新的冒险吧。

original: Mosourika: You should come with us, Celeste.
translation: Mosourika: 你该加入我们一起，塞莱斯特。

original: Celeste: Yeah![p/][s/] I'm always up for an adventure!
translation: Celeste: 好啊！[p/][s/]我总是乐意冒险的！

original: Mosourika: Celeste,[p/] I love your sword!
translation: Mosourika: 塞莱斯特，[p/]你这把剑真不错啊！

original: Mosourika: Is that [i]bone[/i]?
translation: Mosourika: 是[i]骨头[/i]做的吗？

original: Celeste: Yeah![p/][s/] How did you know?
translation: Celeste: 对啊！[p/][s/]你怎么知道的？

original: Mosourika: I could tell by the texture.[p/] I've held some really exotic blades being sold by some of the travelling merchants here.
translation: Mosourika: 我是从纹理上看出来的。[p/]我又从旅行商人那里得到一些奇特的异国制刀。

original: Celeste: Yeah,[p/] it was carved from the bones of a Purple Worm.[p/] It's unbreakable.
translation: Celeste: 是的，[p/]这把剑是用紫色蠕虫的骨骼打造的。[p/]可以说是坚不可摧。

original: Mosourika: ...I want one.
translation: Mosourika: ……我也想要一把。

original: Celeste: I'm sure you can find your own sword from those travelling merchants.
translation: Celeste: 我相信你能再旅行商人手上找到属于自己的那把剑。

original: Mosourika: ...I said I [i]held[/i] those blades.[p/] Affording them is another matter.
translation: Mosourika: ……我刚说了，我是[i]持有[/i]这种刀剑的。[p/]不过买下它们就是另一回事了……

original: Mosourika: ...How [i]was[/i] living with Ruby Tymora?
translation: Mosourika: 与鲁比·泰摩拉一起生活是[i]什么[/i]感觉？

original: Mosourika: From the way the papers wrote about her,[p/] she doesn't sound like the kind of person that could raise a ten-year-old.
translation: Mosourika: 从报纸上的报道来看，[p/]她不像是那种会去养育一个十岁小孩子的人啊。

original: Tyrion: ...Those are just baseless rumors being spread by the nobility.
translation: Tyrion: ……那些都只是贵族刻意散播，毫无根据的谣言。

original: Tyrion: They're just trying to discredit her in the public eye.
translation: Tyrion: 他们就是想在公众认知中诋毁她的名声。

original: Mosourika: Oh, okay.[p/] That makes sense.
translation: Mosourika: 噢，好吧。[p/]这确实有道理。

original: Mosourika: They made her sound like some ruthless maniac who'll do whatever it takes to win.
translation: Mosourika: 他们将她描绘成一个铁石心肠，为了胜诉不择手段的疯子。

original: ...I wanted to deny that,[p/] so why didn't I?
translation: ……我是想要否定这个说法的，[p/]但为什么说不出口呢？

original: Tyrion: Do you recognize this ring?[p/] Justin was wearing it on the day of the accident.
translation: Tyrion: 你还记得这个指环吗？[p/]贾斯汀在事故发生的当天戴着它。

original: Mosourika: ...Really?[p/] I don't remember ever seeing him wear a ring.
translation: Mosourika: ……这样吗？[p/]我不记得他有佩戴指环啊。

original: Tyrion: It's not that noticeable.[p/] Maybe you just didn't notice it.
translation: Tyrion: 确实不太显眼，[p/]可能你只是没注意到。

original: Mosourika: No...[p/] I was seeing him every day.[p/] I feel like I would've noticed something like that.
translation: Mosourika: 不对……[p/]我每天都见到他。[p/]我觉得自己应该是会注意到他戴没戴指环的。

original: Tyrion: That's strange...[p/] There's something special about this ring, too.[p/] It wasn't damaged by the chemicals at all.
translation: Tyrion: 那就奇怪了……[p/]这个指环本身也比较特别。[p/]它没有被容器里的物质损伤。

original: Mosourika: Is that really so important?
translation: Mosourika: 这件事有这么重要吗？

original: Tyrion: Insignificant details like this tend to be relevant more often than you'd think.
translation: Tyrion: 像这样看似无关紧要的细节与真相的联系往往比你所想的要更紧密。

original: Tyrion: What [i]is[/i] this strap?
translation: Tyrion: 这条皮带[i]是[/i]什么？

original: Mosourika: ...It might just be nothing.[p/] Maybe he found it on the street or something.
translation: Mosourika: ……可能什么也不是。[p/]他可能就是在街上还是哪里捡到的。

original: It [i]was[/i] dirty and reeked of grass.
translation: 它[i]沾满[/i]脏污，还散发出青草的气味。

original: Tyrion: I'll have to keep it in mind just in case.
translation: Tyrion: 以防万一，我还是得好好记住它。

original: Tyrion: There [i]has[/i] to be a reason why Justin was holding this.
translation: Tyrion: 贾斯汀拿着这个东西[i]一定[/i]有其原因。

original: Player: Mosourika
Tyrion: You've really grown up.[p/] I can't believe it's been ten whole years.
translation: Tyrion: 你也长大了不少。[p/]已经过去十年了，真是难以置信。

original: Mosourika: I kind of feel like not much has changed, though,[p/] and I mean that in a good way.
translation: Mosourika: 我自己其实觉得变化并不大。[p/]我的意思是，这是好事。

original: Mosourika: I'm glad you never lost your spirit, Tyrion.
translation: Mosourika: 而我也很高兴，你没有舍弃自己的精神，提利昂。

original: Mosourika: You're taking on nobles now![p/] I should be [i]your[/i] apprentice.
translation: Mosourika: 你可是在与贵族们作对！[p/]我应该成为[i]你的[/i]徒弟。

original: Tyrion: I can make sure no one else ever loses their life to injustice.
translation: Tyrion: 我有能力让人们不再冤死于不公。

original: Mosourika: Oh...[p/] That's good...
translation: Mosourika: 嗯……[p/]这很好……

original: Tyrion: ...What's wrong?
translation: Tyrion: ……怎么了？

original: Mosourika: N-[p/][s/]No...[p/] It's nothing. [h="Is he doing this|because of his mom?" e="sf"/]
translation: Mosourika: 没、[p/][s/]没有……[p/]没什么的。 [h="他做到这个份上，|是因为母亲的事吗？" e="sf"/]

original: Player: Justin|Autopsy
Tyrion: I'm really sorry about what happened to Justin.
translation: Tyrion: 我为贾斯汀的遭遇感到遗憾。

original: Mosourika: It just seems so unfair.[p/] He just got his freedom back a few months ago. [h="Something happened to him|when he was locked up..." e=""/]
translation: Mosourika: 太不公平了。[p/]他才重获自由几个月啊。 [h="他在被关押的期间|肯定是发生了什么……" e=""/]

original: Tyrion: Rika,[p/] was Justin convicted of a crime?
translation: Tyrion: 里卡，[p/]贾斯汀有被判犯罪吗？

original: Mosourika: S-[p/][s/]Sorry.[p/] Forget I said that.
translation: Mosourika: 抱、[p/][s/]抱歉，[p/]当我没说过。

original: Tyrion: If he has a criminal history,[p/] that may point to who may have done this.
translation: Tyrion: 如果他确实有犯罪经历，[p/]这可能会引向真凶身份的。

original: Mosourika: ...He doesn't have a criminal history.[p/] He just made a mistake.
translation: Mosourika: ……他并不是做下什么罪行，[p/]只是翻了个错误。

original: Tyrion: Okay,[p/] but—
translation: Tyrion: 那好，[p/]不过——

original: Mosourika: Tyrion.[p/] I [i]don't[/i] want to talk about it.
translation: Mosourika: 提利昂。[p/]我[i]不想[/i]谈论这件事。

original: I paused.[p/] That seemed like a sore subject for her.
translation: 我住口了。[p/]看起来那对她是个敏感话题。

original: It might be best to drop it for now and take her word for it.
translation: 目前最好还是停止这个话题，相信她的说法。

original: Player: Ring
Player: Phantom
Tyrion: What do you know about the "Mistweaving Phantom"?
translation: Tyrion: 你对““织雾魅影””知道些什么吗？

original: Mosourika: ...Oh,[p/] it's just some urban myth.
translation: Mosourika: ……哦，[p/]那就是个都市传说而已。

original: Tyrion: Really?[p/] Because it sounds like a name you'd come up with.
translation: Tyrion: 真的？[p/]因为这名字听起来很像你的品味啊。

original: Mosourika: Well,[p/] a [i]lot[/i] of my names catch on.[p/] I can't always remember which ones came from me.
translation: Mosourika: 这个嘛，[p/]我取的[i]很多[/i]好名字都流行了。[p/]我没法总是记得哪个是出自于我的。

original: Player: Strap
Player: RikaTest
Tyrion: Do you remember anything at all about the person who cast that spell?
translation: Tyrion: 你还记得关于施放那个法术的人的任何信息吗？

original: Mosourika: No,[p/] with the angle I was at,[p/] it was impossible to see them.
translation: Mosourika: 没有，[p/]以我当时的视角，[p/]没办法看到他。

original: We really needed a lead on the murderer,[p/] but it didn't seem like anyone even saw them.
translation: 我们急需真凶的线索，[p/]但似乎没有任何人目击到他。

original: Tyrion: What do you think about this, Rika?
translation: Tyrion: 里卡，你对这个怎么看？

original: Mosourika: Hmph...[p/] Something like that speaks for itself!
translation: Mosourika:嗯…….[p/]那样的事物本身就说明了一切！

original: In other words,[p/] she had nothing to say about it.
translation: 翻译一下，[p/]就是她对这个没什么好说的。

original: Mosourika: Ah, Lord of the Radiant Flame.[p/] You've returned!
translation: Mosourika: 啊，辉焰之主，[p/]你回来啦！

original: Mosourika: Did you get a chance to talk to Mr. Dracogen?
translation: Mosourika: 你有和德拉科根先生交谈过吗？

original: Tyrion: I just missed him, apparently.
translation: Tyrion: 我看起来是刚好错过他了。

original: Tyrion: I did talk to the prosecutor, though.
translation: Tyrion: 不过我和检察官谈了谈。

original: Mosourika: ...You mean Lady Steelwind?
translation: Mosourika: ……你是说斯蒂尔文德小姐？

original: Celeste: She's not that bad once you get to know her.
translation: Celeste: 你要是和她熟一点的话，就知道她不是什么坏人。

original: Tyrion: Anyways,[p/] I learned a bit more about what happened,[p/] but I think your testimony doesn't really fit in with the reports.
translation: Tyrion: 不管怎么说，[p/]我稍微多了解了一点案件情况。[p/]但我认为你的证词与报告的内容并不相符。

original: Tyrion: Can you tell me more about what you saw?
translation: Tyrion: 能更详细地说一说你目击的情况吗？

original: Mosourika: ...Okay.[p/] I'll do whatever I can to help.
translation: Mosourika: ……没问题。[p/]只要帮得上忙，我什么都会做的。

original: If what Rika saw was accurate,[p/] what kind of spell was Justin hit with?
translation: 如果里卡没有看错，[p/]贾斯汀究竟是被什么法术击中了？

original: It was strong enough to rip the guardrails apart,[p/] but it didn't leave any traces.
translation: 它的力量足以将护栏撕开，[p/]却又没留下任何痕迹。

original: Either way,[p/] I'd learned everything I could from her.[p/] It was time to MOVE somewhere else.
translation: 无论如何，[p/]我已经从她那里获取了可能得到的全部信息。[p/]是时候<size=1.5em>移动</size>到其他地方了。

original: Player: The Trial
Player: Mosourika's Past (ARGUMENT)
translation: Player: 莫苏里卡的过去（辩论）

original: Player: The Truth
Player: The Mistweaving Phantom
Tyrion: Wait,[p/] but from your story it sounds like—
translation: Tyrion: 等等，[p/]但你的说法就好像——

original: Mosourika: I think Justin is—[p/][i]was[/i][p/] the thief that everyone's talking about.
translation: Mosourika: 我认为贾斯汀就是——[p/][i]曾经是[/i][p/]那个每个人都在谈论的盗贼。

original: Mosourika: I told you, didn't I?[p/] The thief who broke into Mr. Dracogen's office didn't attack Justin.
translation: Mosourika: 我有跟你说过，对吧？[p/]闯入德拉科根先生办公室的盗贼没有攻击贾斯汀。

original: Mosourika: He [i]was[/i] Justin.
translation: Mosourika: 因为那个盗贼[i]就是[/i]贾斯汀本人。

original: Tyrion: ...But then,[p/] who attacked him?
translation: Tyrion: ……倘若如此，[p/]又是谁袭击了他？

original: Mosourika: I don't know...
translation: Mosourika: 我不知道……

original: The [i]victim[/i] was the Mistweaving Phantom this entire time?
translation: [i]受害者[/i]才是“织雾魅影”本人吗？

original: That was the only lead I had to identify the murderer...
translation: 那明明是我认为唯一可以确定真凶身份的线索……

original: But if Justin was the one who robbed the office that morning,[p/] why would someone attack him?
translation: 但如果贾斯汀是早上侵入办公室的那个人，[p/]为什么又会受到其他人的攻击呢？

original: Who else would be up on that catwalk?
translation: 还有什么在那个架空步道上？

original: Mosourika: ...I got him that job, you know?
translation: Mosourika: ……是我为他求来这份工作，你知道吧？

original: Mosourika: All those years ago,[p/] one of our heists didn't go as planned,[p/] and we were all arrested.
translation: Mosourika: 几年前，[p/]我们的一次抢劫没能按计划进行，[p/]我们所有人都被逮捕了。

original: Mosourika: Justin told me to take a plea deal by letting him take the fall.
translation: Mosourika: 贾斯汀让我接受认罪协定，他则承担了责任。

original: Mosourika: I was scared of losing everything,[p/] so I agreed.
translation: Mosourika: 我害怕变得一无所有，[p/]最后同意了。

original: Mosourika: When he finally got released from the dungeons,[p/] I begged Mr. Dracogen to hire him.
translation: Mosourika: 当他终于从地牢中被放出来后，[p/]我央求德拉科根先生雇下他。

original: Mosourika: I thought I could make it up to him.
translation: Mosourika: 我认为自己可以这样补偿他。

original: Mosourika: But then I started hearing about all the robberies happening in the harbor.
translation: Mosourika: 但正是那时起，我开始听到港口那些盗窃案的传闻。

original: Mosourika: It matched so closely to the reports back then,[p/] but I really didn't want to believe it was him.
translation: Mosourika: 那与我们过去的做法非常相符，[p/]但我实在不愿意相信那是他所为。

original: Mosourika: He had his job at the refinery.[p/] He didn't have to steal to survive anymore.
translation: Mosourika: 他已经在精炼厂有了工作，[p/]没有必要再靠偷窃为生。

original: Mosourika: ...But I guess he just couldn't help himself.
translation: Mosourika: ……但我猜他可能就是控制不住。

original: Tyrion: You were just trying to help him.
translation: Tyrion: 你只是试着帮助他罢了。

original: Mosourika: ...And now he's dead.
translation: Mosourika: ……而他现在已经死去了。

original: Player: False Reports
Celeste: But if Justin was the serial robber,[p/] why was he robbing the union offices?
translation: Celeste: 但如果贾斯汀就是那个连环盗窃犯，[p/]他为什么要抢劫工会的办公室？

original: Tyrion: ...!
translation: Tyrion: ……！

original: Tyrion: That's right!
translation: Tyrion: 对啊！

original: Mosourika: ...What?
translation: Mosourika: ……怎么了？

original: Tyrion: Justin wasn't just robbing the merchant ships this time.[p/] He also stole administrative documents from the union offices.
translation: Tyrion: 贾斯汀这次不只是偷窃货船。[p/]他还从工会办公室偷窃行政文件。

original: Mosourika: ...Why would he do that?
translation: Mosourika: ……他为什么要这么做？

original: Tyrion: I assumed that the Mistweaving Phantom was part of a larger plot,[p/] and that could still be true.
translation: Tyrion: 我曾假定“织雾魅影”只是一个大阴谋的一部分，[p/]而现在来看这仍然很有可能。

original: Tyrion: Justin wasn't working alone.[p/] He must have been stealing those documents for someone.
translation: Tyrion: 贾斯汀不是独自作案。[p/]他肯定是为了某个人偷窃这些文件。

original: Tyrion: And whoever that person was,[p/] [i]they've[/i] been filing these false reports of insurrection.
translation: Tyrion: 不论那个人具体是谁，[p/]是[i]他们[/i]一直在提交这些被伪造的报告。

original: Tyrion: Maybe his accomplice betrayed him to keep him quiet.[p/] He'd just robbed an imperial ship that morning.
translation: Tyrion: 或许是他的合作对象杀人灭口。[p/]正是在那个早上，他刚刚偷盗了王家的船只。

original: Tyrion: Rika,[p/] do you know who he was working for?[p/] Did he say anything to you?
translation: Tyrion: 里卡，[p/]你知道他在为谁做事吗？[p/]他有跟你提到过什么吗？

original: Mosourika: ...He didn't,[p/] but I know some people he might've talked to.
translation: Mosourika: ……他没说过，[p/]但我知道几个可能有和他交往的人。

original: Mosourika: It was some other kids from the orphanage we used to run our robberies with.[p/] They always hang around the beach area.
translation: Mosourika: 就是几个当时跟我们一起抢劫的孤儿。[p/]他们经常在海滩那边闲逛。

original: Mosourika: ...They like playing around the abandoned house there.
translation: Mosourika: ……他们喜欢在那幢废屋附近玩耍。

original: ...An abandoned house on the coastline.
translation: ……海边的一座废屋。

original: Mosourika: Are you going to be okay?[p/] I can go there with you if you'd like.
translation: Mosourika: 你还好吗？[p/]如果你希望的话，我可以陪你一起去。

original: Tyrion: No...[p/] It's okay.[p/] You've done more than enough.
translation: Tyrion: 不用了……[p/]没关系的。[p/]你已经做得足够多了。

original: Mosourika: ...Just be careful around them.[p/] They can get in your face sometimes.
translation: Mosourika: ……在他们那里要小心点。[p/]他们很可能会顶撞你。

original: I looked at my bodyguard.[p/] I wasn't too worried.
translation: 我看向自己的保镖，[p/]就不怎么担心了。

original: Tyrion: I'm sorry about what happened during the trial.[p/] I didn't know Steelwind would pull your record like that.
translation: Tyrion: 抱歉庭审时发生的事情，[p/]我并不知道斯蒂尔文德会那样公开你的记录。

original: Mosourika: [i]*sigh*[/i][p/] I came to help you and Mr. Dracogen.[p/] I would have done it again if I had to.
translation: Mosourika: [i]*叹气*[/i][p/]我是为了帮上你和德拉科根先生而站上法庭。[p/]如果有必要，我会再来一次。

original: Tyrion: I'm really sorry about this.
translation: Tyrion: 真的很对不起。

original: Tyrion: I know it's really none of my business,[p/] but I need to know this for the case.
translation: Tyrion: 我知道这真的不关我的事，[p/]但为了案件我必须得知道这个问题。

original: Tyrion: Was what Steelwind said about you true?
translation: Tyrion: 斯蒂尔文德关于你的说法是真的吗？

original: Tyrion: Rika,[p/] I think the Mistweaving Phantom is the person who hit Justin with that spell yesterday.
translation: Tyrion: 里卡，[p/]昨天的时候我认为“织雾魅影”就是施放法术攻击贾斯汀的人。

original: Tyrion: And it could be someone you used to...[p/] [i]work[/i] with.
translation: Tyrion: 而那个人可能与你曾……[p/][i]一同共事[/i]

original: Mosourika: ...That's impossible.
translation: Mosourika: ……那不可能。

original: Tyrion: How can you be so sure?
translation: Tyrion: 你为什么这么肯定？

original: Mosourika: It's just [i]not[/i].
translation: Mosourika: 就是[i]没有可能[/i]。

original: Tyrion: Rika,[p/] I—
translation: Tyrion: 里卡，[p/]我——

original: Mosourika: Tyrion![p/][s/] I'm not going to talk about this!
translation: Mosourika: 提利昂！[p/][s/]我不会谈论这个话题的！

original: ...I couldn't blame her for being so defensive.[p/] I'd be a hypocrite if I did.
translation: ……我无法因她的防备态度责备她。[p/]那样就太虚伪了。

original: But I needed to know more about these thieves she used to run with.
translation: 但我仍然需要知道更多她从前的盗贼同伙们的事情。

original: I would need to PERSUADE her to tell me the truth.
translation: 我需要<size=1.5em>说服</size>她告诉我真相。

original: Mosourika: Stories started spreading around after you went missing.
translation: Mosourika: 在你消失之后，许多说法蔓延开来。

original: Mosourika: People heard about how a single mother was executed while the City Watch forced her child to watch.
translation: Mosourika: 人们听说一个单亲母亲被处以极刑，而城市安保却强迫她的孩子观看。

original: Celeste: ...What?!
translation: Celeste: ……你说什么？！

original: Mosourika: Things already weren't great here,[p/] but I think that was the tipping point.
translation: Mosourika: 当时这座城市就已经不太妙了，[p/]但我认为那是个转折点。

original: Mosourika: No one trusted the City Watch after that,[p/] and the crime in the city slowly got worse and worse.
translation: Mosourika: 那之后没有人信任城市安保，[p/]城中的犯罪率慢慢变得高涨。

original: Mosourika: Merchants were constantly getting robbed and attacked.[p/] One by one,[p/] they started pulling out of the city.
translation: Mosourika: 商人们总是被抢劫袭击。[p/]而他们就一个又一个地远离这座城市。

original: Mosourika: It wasn't long before the only person who could do business here was the Duke of Commerce:[p/] the one merchant with enough armed forces to protect his goods.
translation: Mosourika: 没过多久，还能在这里维系商业的就只剩下那位商业公爵，[p/]只有他作为商人的同时还有足够的武装力量来保护自己的货物。

original: Mosourika: Jobs became scarce,[p/] and the ones that existed had terrible conditions.
translation: Mosourika: 工作变得稀缺，[p/]而且劳动条件还十分恶劣。

original: Mosourika: A lot of people turned to crime to survive.[p/] So a bunch of us at the orphanage decided we might as well ride the wave.
translation: Mosourika: 许多人为了谋生只能走上犯罪道路，[p/]而我们这一帮子孤儿院的同道也决定顺应潮流。

original: Tyrion: You started robbing von Sanctus's ships.
translation: Tyrion: 你们就开始抢劫冯·桑克图斯家的货船。

original: Mosourika: Honestly,[p/] it was all Justin.[p/] I was just the distraction.
translation: Mosourika: 老实说，[p/]基本上是贾斯汀干的。[p/]我只是进行干扰。

original: Mosourika: With some help from the other orphans,[p/] I'd use my [b]evocation[/b] magic and put on an act to spook the guards.
translation: Mosourika: 在其他孤儿的帮助下，[p/]我使用[b]塑能术[/b]惊扰守卫。

original: Mosourika: While they were chasing us around,[p/] Justin would slip onto the merchant ships to take what we needed.
translation: Mosourika: 当他们追击我们的时候，[p/]贾斯汀就会潜入船舱，取走我们需要的东西。

original: Mosourika: At first,[p/] we only took the food and clothes we needed to survive.
translation: Mosourika: 起初，[p/]我们只拿走生存需要的衣食。

original: Mosourika: But we realized we could actually make a lot of gold by stealing von Sanctus's goods and selling them on the black market.
translation: Mosourika: 后来我们意识到可以偷走冯·桑克图斯的货物，在黑市上出手来赚很多钱。

original: Mosourika: Justin had a real talent for breaking into the more guarded ships.
translation: Mosourika: 贾斯汀在潜入那些被看守的货船方面颇具天赋。

original: Mosourika: He'd learned a lot about artificery from some of the books we stole,[p/] and he learned how to bypass von Sanctus's security.
translation: Mosourika: 他在我们偷来的书籍里学会了很多奥术装置的事情，[p/]也学会了如何绕过冯·桑克图斯的安保系统。

original: Mosourika: He'd slip in and out of the ships without being seen or triggering any alarms.
translation: Mosourika: 他出入船只，却能避免触发任何警报或者监视。

original: Mosourika: They called him the Mistweaving Phantom.
translation: Mosourika: 于是他才被称之为“织雾魅影”

original: Tyrion: ...Did [i]they[/i] call him that or just you?
translation: Tyrion: ……是[i]他们[/i]这么称呼他，还是你？

original: Mosourika: Hey,[p/] the titles I come up with are catchy.
translation: Mosourika: 嘿，[p/]我创作的那些头衔是很受欢迎的。

original: Mosourika: Do you remember that name I came up with when we were kids?
translation: Mosourika: 记得小时候我想出来的那个台词吗？

original: Tyrion: ...Yeah,[p/] I remember.
translation: Tyrion: ……是啊，[p/]我还记得。

original: Mosourika: "Naught can remain concealed from the Eye of Horus."
translation: Mosourika: “荷鲁斯之眼底，万物无所遁形。”

original: Mosourika: You really know how to command a presence in the courtroom.
translation: Mosourika: 你其实很懂得如何在法庭上展现存在感。

original: Tyrion: I kind of have to if I want to get anywhere.
translation: Tyrion: 为了达成目的，我也不得不那么做。

original: Tyrion: Each session starts with the entire room convinced that the defendant is guilty.
translation: Tyrion: 每一次的庭审都是在所有人都认为被告有罪的前提下开始的。

original: Mosourika: I'm glad there are people out there who will do what it takes to deliver justice.
translation: Mosourika: 而我非常高兴，终究有人愿意为伸张正义竭尽全力。

original: Mosourika: I think you and Mr. Dracogen have something in common there.
translation: Mosourika: 在这个方面，我想你和德拉科根先生有相通之处。

original: Tyrion: Do you know anything about the Duke of Commerce?
translation: Tyrion: 能说说那个商业公爵的事情吗？

original: Mosourika: Not anything outside of the papers.[p/] We've never even met.
translation: Mosourika: 除了报纸上的那些内容我也不知道更多了。[p/]我们都没见过面。

original: Mosourika: All I know is that I'm paying him a [i]lot[/i] of taxes.
translation: Mosourika: 我只知道自己给他交了[i]好多[/i]税。

original: Player: Noah
Mosourika: I hope Noah is okay...
translation: Mosourika: 希望诺亚老伯没事……

original: Tyrion: Yeah,[p/] those knights were a little rough with him.
translation: Tyrion: 我也是，[p/]那些骑士对他有点粗鲁。

original: Tyrion: Is he okay?
translation: Tyrion: 他还好吧？

original: Mosourika: Yeah,[p/] he's just a little shaken up.
translation: Mosourika: 还好，[p/]只是有点受惊吓。

original: Mosourika: ...He's been trying to get the Kingsguard to reveal where his friends were taken.
translation: Mosourika: ……他一直想要让国王卫队坦白他那些朋友被带到哪里去了。

original: Tyrion: Right...[p/] I suppose Lucio Steelwind is the [i]last[/i] person I'd trust with my friends' lives.
translation: Tyrion: 对啊……[p/]我想卢西奥·斯蒂尔文德大概是[i]最不可以[/i]把朋友的性命交在他手上的那个人。

original: Player: Stefanic
Mosourika: I really owe a lot to Mr. Dracogen.
translation: Mosourika: 我亏欠德拉科根先生许多。

original: Tyrion: He invested in you despite your brushes with the law.
translation: Tyrion: 虽然你一度触犯法律，但他还是愿意投资你的事业。

original: Tyrion: He must have a lot of faith in you.
translation: Tyrion: 他一定对你有所信任。

original: Mosourika: ...You think so?
translation: Mosourika: ……你是这么认为吗？

original: Celeste: Well, your cooking [i]is[/i] amazing.
translation: Celeste: 这个嘛，你的厨艺[i]相当[/i]精湛。

original: Celeste: I [i]love[/i] your breakfast wraps!
translation: Celeste: 我[i]爱[/i]你的早餐卷饼！

original: Mosourika: Yeah,[p/] I'm really proud of how those turned out.
translation: Mosourika: 也是，[p/]我对现在的成果也相当自豪。

original: Mosourika: ...I really hope he gets out of this.
translation: Mosourika: ……真希望他能挺过这道难关。

original: Player: Autopsy|Justin
Mosourika: ...He's really gone, isn't he?
translation: Mosourika: 他真的就这么逝去了……是不是？

original: Tyrion: ...Sorry,[p/] I shouldn't have—
translation: Tyrion: ……真对不起，[p/]我不应该——

original: Mosourika: It's okay.[p/] I know you're doing your best to help Mr. Dracogen.
translation: Mosourika: 没事的。[p/]我知道你只是为了救助德拉科根先生尽力而为。

original: Mosourika: It's just hard to accept, you know?
translation: Mosourika: 但这确实仍然难以接受，你知道的吧？

original: Mosourika: A part of me wishes this really was all an accident.
translation: Mosourika: 我内心的一角希望那真的只是一起意外。

original: Mosourika: But someone attacked,[p/] and I don't even know why.
translation: Mosourika: 但肯定有人实施了攻击，[p/]但我却根本不知道为什么。

original: Tyrion: I can't believe [i]Justin[/i] was the Phantom this entire time.
translation: Tyrion: 我想不到一直以来[i]贾斯汀[/i]就是那个“魅影”。

original: Mosourika: ...Which means he also robbed Mr. Dracogen.
translation: Mosourika: ……也就是说他还偷了德拉科根先生的东西。

original: Tyrion: I'm sorry, Rika...
translation: Tyrion: 抱歉，里卡……

original: Mosourika: It's for the best...[p/] I think I've been trying so hard to ignore the truth,[p/] but it was sitting right in front of me.
translation: Mosourika: 这样也是最好的……[p/]我一直以来都努力不去直视真相，[p/]但它就摆在我的眼前。

original: Mosourika: It feels like there's a small weight off my shoulders at least.
translation: Mosourika: 承认下来，感觉自己的肩头反而稍微轻松了一点。

original: She knew [i]something[/i] about the Mistweaving Phantom,[p/] but she obviously wasn't keen on sharing.
translation: 她知道“织雾魅影”的[i]一些内情[/i]，[p/]但她并不乐于表露出来。

original: I'd need to persuade her in an ARGUMENT if I wanted to get anywhere.
translation: 我要想取得进展，就需要在<size=1.5em>辩论</size>中说服她。

original: Player: Mosourika|RikaPast
Tyrion: Thanks for telling me about what happened, Rika.
translation: Tyrion: 里卡，谢谢你告诉我这些发生的事情。

original: Tyrion: I know that must've been difficult.
translation: Tyrion: 我知道你肯定很难过。

original: Mosourika: Yeah,[p/] I really [i]do[/i] hope it helps.
translation: Mosourika: 是的，[p/]我[i]真的[/i]很希望能帮得上忙。

original: Mosourika: It would've been nice if you told us you were safe in Ratholme.
translation: Mosourika: 如果你能告诉我们，你已经在瑞思霍姆安顿下来，那会好很多的。

original: Tyrion: ...Sorry.[p/] I was too focused on getting revenge on the nobility.
translation: Tyrion: ……对不起。[p/]我当时太过于专注在向贵族复仇了。

original: Tyrion: And after a while,[p/] it just felt like too much time had passed.
translation: Tyrion: 在那之后，[p/]感觉好像已经过去了太久。

original: Mosourika: Yeah, well.
translation: Mosourika: 是啊，但都没关系啦。

original: Mosourika: You're here now.[p/] We should make the most of it.
translation: Mosourika: 你现在不就回来这里了吗。[p/]我们该好好珍惜这一点。

original: Mosourika: ...I'm holding you two to that adventure after all this is over.
translation: Mosourika: ……等这件事有了结果，我得把你们拖去那场冒险。

original: Mosourika: Sorry,[p/] I can't say much about that.
translation: Mosourika: 对不起，[p/]对此我不能再多说了。

original: I arrived at Rika's café and found it completely empty.[p/] The entrance was locked too.
translation: 我抵达了里卡的咖啡馆，[p/]但店门已经上了锁。

original: There was a note on the door.
translation: 门上挂着一张字条。

original: "I am on a hunt to slay a fearsome demon! The café will be open later today unless I am tragically slain in my quest! >_<"
translation: “吾正在狩猎一些骇人的恶魔！咖啡馆将在今日稍晚恢复营业，除非本大人在任务中悲惨落败了！ >_<”

original: ...It sounded like I would need to return later.
translation: ……看起来我得稍晚点回来。

original: I stepped through the doors of the café and found it completely empty.
translation: 我穿过咖啡店大门，但里面没有顾客。

original: Rika was sitting near the kitchen,[p/] somberly looking out the window.
translation: 里卡就坐在厨房边上，[p/]神情忧愁得看向窗外。

original: Tyrion: ...Hi, Rika.
translation: Tyrion: ……你好啊，里卡。

original: Mosourika: Oh...[p/] Hey, Tyrion.
translation: Mosourika: 啊……[p/]嘿，提利昂。

original: Tyrion: What?[p/] No grand declarations from the Dark Lord of Aurinax?
translation: Tyrion: 怎么了？[p/]欧奥耐克斯的暗黑领主没有什么壮大的宣言吗？

original: Mosourika: ...I'm not really in the mood for that today.
translation: Mosourika: ……我今天没有那个心情。

original: I scratched my head and scanned the empty restaurant.[p/] I never knew what to say in these situations.
translation: 我挠了挠头，环视空荡荡的餐厅。[p/]我真不知道这种情景下该说什么。

original: Tyrion: Can we talk?[p/] I still need help with the case.
translation: Tyrion: 能谈一谈吗？[p/]我仍然需要一点帮助来打赢官司。

original: Mosourika: ...Sure.
translation: Mosourika: ……好的。

original: Tyrion: Thanks for being honest with me, Rika.
translation: Tyrion: 里卡，谢谢你对我直言不讳。

original: Mosourika: Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?
translation: Mosourika: 别太勉强自己，好吗？

original: Celeste: Hey, is what she said true?[p/] Did the City Watch really—
translation: Celeste: 嘿，她说的是真的？[p/]城市安保真的——

original: Celeste: ...Did all of that really happen to you?
translation: Celeste: ……你真的经历了那些事情？

original: Tyrion: ...Yeah.
translation: Tyrion: ……是的。

original: Celeste: I know I've been really pushy lately.
translation: Celeste: 我知道最近我可能有点急躁。

original: Tyrion: N-[p/][s/]No...![p/] You've been nothing but kind and patient with me.
translation: Tyrion: 没、[p/][s/]没有啊……！[p/]你对我一直都很温柔耐心的。

original: Tyrion: ...I'm really sorry I snapped at you yesterday.
translation: Tyrion: ……昨天对你发脾气，我才是真的很对不起。

original: Tyrion: You were looking out for me.[p/] You didn't deserve that.
translation: Tyrion: 你是在照顾我的情绪。[p/]不应该受到那样的对待。

original: Celeste: I've just never seen you like this before.[p/] I've been really worried.
translation: Celeste: 之前从来没看到过你像那个样子。[p/]我真的好担心。

original: Tyrion: ...I really thought I moved past all of this,[p/] but it's like everything that happened is replaying in my head.
translation: Tyrion: ……我原以为自己早就对过去的经历释怀了，[p/]但一回到这里，那些发生过的所有事情就在我的脑海里不停回放。

original: Celeste: Do you want to talk about it?
translation: Celeste: 你愿意跟我说说那些事情吗？

original: Tyrion: ...I think I just want to focus on the case.
translation: Tyrion: ……我想我们还是集中在案件上吧。

original: Celeste: Tyrion, you're [i]not[/i] okay.
translation: Celeste: 提利昂，你状态[i]并不[/i]好。

original: Tyrion: I know,[p/] but I have a job to do.[p/] I can't afford to fall apart now.
translation: Tyrion: 我明白，[p/]但我还有该做的工作。[p/]我现在是不会就这么崩溃的。

original: Tyrion: We can talk about everything once this is all over.[p/] I can handle this until then.
translation: Tyrion: 等这个案子结束了， 我们可以好好聊一聊。[p/]我能撑到那个时候的。

original: Celeste: [i]*sigh*[/i][p/] Okay.
translation: Celeste: [i]*叹气*[/i][p/]那行。

original: Celeste: But I'm always here if you need to talk.
translation: Celeste: 但只要你需要说出来的时候，我一直都会在的。

original: Tyrion: Thanks...
translation: Tyrion: 谢谢你……

original: Tyrion: ...I'm really glad I get to work with you.[p/] These cases wouldn't be nearly as bearable if you weren't here with me.
translation: Tyrion: ……能同你一起工作，我真的很高兴。[p/]如果没有你的陪伴，这些案件简直让人难以忍受。

original: Celeste: ...Of course!
translation: Celeste: ……那是当然！

original: Celeste: I love doing this job with you.[p/] I really hope you know that.
translation: Celeste: 我很喜欢这份与你一起的工作。[p/]我希望你知道这一点。

original: For the first time in the last few days,[p/] I cracked a smile.
translation: 几天以来，[p/]我第一次露出微笑。

original: Tyrion: Okay, let's get going.
translation: Tyrion: 好啊，我们出发吧。

original: ...It was time to MOVE to the old abandoned house.
translation: ……是时候<size=1.5em>移动</size>到那栋废弃的旧屋了。

original: Player: Celeste McCoy
Player: Tyrion Cuthbert
Player: Rika's Café
Tyrion: ...Are you the owner of this café, Rika?
translation: Tyrion: ……里卡，你是这间咖啡馆的店主吗？

original: Tyrion: You always dreamed of opening one up when we were kids.
translation: Tyrion: 我们还小的时候，你就一直有个开咖啡店的梦想。

original: Mosourika: The source of my strength is the everlasting financial support of the Dracogen Trading Company.
translation: Mosourika: 吾力量的源泉正是德拉科根贸易公司永恒的资金支持。

original: Mosourika: Its owner was rendered powerless when he tried confections.[p/] He had no choice but to fund my war path.
translation: Mosourika: 当它的主人尝试进军甜点业时，他发现自己的弱小无力。[p/]他别无选择，只能追随吾的脚步。

original: Celeste: "Dracogen Trading Company"?[p/] I don't think I've heard of them.
translation: Celeste: “德拉科根贸易公司”？[p/]我还从没听说过他们。

original: Mosourika: They're pretty small.[p/] They're only operating in Aurinax right now.
translation: Mosourika: 他们还是个小公司，[p/]而且现在只在欧奥耐克斯运营。

original: Mosourika: But I hear that they're planning to expand their operations throughout Wyverngarde.
translation: Mosourika: 不过我听说他们准备将经营范围拓展到维文加德全境。

original: Tyrion: I'm surprised the Duke of Commerce is letting that slide.
translation: Tyrion: 那个商业公爵竟然对其视而不见，我还挺惊讶的。

original: Celeste: Isn't he the guy you beat in the chess tournament this morning?
translation: Celeste: 你说的不就是上午你在棋赛打败的那个家伙吗？

original: Mosourika: Wait...[p/][s/] That was you?!
translation: Mosourika: 什么……[p/][s/]是你打败的？！

original: Tyrion: House von Sanctus is one of the Four Pillar families.[p/] They manage mercantile operations throughout Wyverngarde.
translation: Tyrion: 冯·桑克图斯家是四大支柱家族之一。[p/]他们负责管理整个维文加德王国的商贸运营。

original: Celeste: So House Steelwind controls the military,[p/] and House von Sanctus controls the businesses.
translation: Celeste: 所以说斯蒂尔文德家掌管军事，[p/]冯·桑克图斯家掌管商业。

original: Tyrion: House Frega controls the banking houses and the exchange of currency.
translation: Tyrion: 弗雷加家掌管着银行业与汇率。

original: Tyrion: ...And House Sibyl controls the judicial and legislative branches of our kingdom.
translation: Tyrion: ……而希比尔家掌控着王国的立法与司法机构。

original: Player: Aurinax City
Tyrion: Is it just me,[p/] or does the city look a lot cleaner than before?
translation: Tyrion: 这座城市看起来比以前更整洁了，[p/]还是说这只是我的个人感受？

original: Mosourika: Oh, right.[p/] You left [i]before[/i] all those new merchants appeared.
translation: Mosourika: 噢，对哦。[p/]你在那些新的商人到来[i]之前[/i]就离开了。

original: Tyrion: "New merchants"?[p/] Did they come from a merchants' guild?
translation: Tyrion: “新的商人”？[p/]他们从商人公会来的吗？

original: Mosourika: Not exactly.[p/] The Dracogen Trading Company was one of the first merchants that came.
translation: Mosourika: 并非如此。[p/]德拉科根贸易公司是最先到来的。

original: Mosourika: They bought some of the Arcane Manufacturies a few years ago.
translation: Mosourika: 几年前他们购置了一批奥术工坊。

original: Mosourika: They transformed it into the heart of artificery production within Aurinax.
translation: Mosourika: 然后将其改建为了整个欧奥耐克斯的奥术能源供给核心。

original: Mosourika: Other merchants felt the way of the wind and followed them here.
translation: Mosourika: 其他商人嗅到了机会，纷纷追随他们来到这里。

original: Celeste: Being based in a port city would definitely give them an edge.
translation: Celeste: 在港口城市设立基地肯定有优势。

original: Celeste: And Aurinax is one of the few trading hubs that sends and receives exports from the other kingdoms.
translation: Celeste: 而且欧奥耐克斯是少有的几座与其他国家有货物来往的贸易港之一。

original: I just looked at her, surprised.
translation: 我有些惊讶地看着她。

original: Celeste: ...Hey,[p/] I'm a businesswoman.[p/] I [i]know[/i] about economics.
translation: Celeste: ……嘿，[p/]我可是个商务人士。[p/]我[i]懂[/i]经济。

original: Mosourika: Their presence lit a flame in the city's economy.
translation: Mosourika: 他们的出现为城市的经济引擎点上了火。

original: Mosourika: They aren't owned by the nobility,[p/] [i]and[/i] they pay their employees a lot more than von Sanctus does.
translation: Mosourika: 他们并非隶属于贵族，[p/][i]而且[/i]他们还为旗下雇员提供比冯·桑克图斯家多得多的酬劳。

original: Mosourika: It's really opened a lot more opportunities for the people here.
translation: Mosourika: 这真的为本地居民带来了许多新机会。

original: Celeste: I doubt the Duke appreciates the competition, though...
translation: Celeste: 不过，我想那个商业公爵不会欢迎这种竞争吧……

original: Mosourika: They're even talking about forming employee-run unions.
translation: Mosourika: 他们甚至谈论起组建由雇员独立运营的工会。

original: Celeste: Oh...[p/] the Duke definitely won't appreciate [i]that[/i].
translation: Celeste: 哎呀……[p/]公爵绝对不会喜欢[i]这个[/i]。

original: Player: The Chess Tournament
Mosourika: So...[p/] You still play chess?
translation: Mosourika: 所以……[p/]你还下棋吗？

original: Tyrion: Yeah,[p/] I'm nationally ranked too.
translation: Tyrion: 是，[p/]我在国内榜上有名。

original: Mosourika: I heard that some "upstart commoner" defeated von Sanctus at a tournament this morning.
translation: Mosourika: 我听说某位“平民新星”在今早的比赛中击败了冯·桑克图斯。

original: Mosourika: I should have known it was the Lightsworn Monarch.
translation: Mosourika: 我当时就该知道那就是“光道君主”本人。

original: Tyrion: ..."U-[p/]Upstart commoner"?
translation: Tyrion: ……“平、[p/]平民新星”？

original: Celeste: "Lightsworn Monarch"?
translation: Celeste: “光道君主”？

original: Mosourika: ...Hey,[p/] do you still do that thing when you play?
translation: Mosourika: ……嘿，[p/]你下棋时还会那么做吗？

original: Tyrion: ...No.
translation: Tyrion: ……才不会。

original: Celeste: What "thing"?
translation: Celeste: 做“什么”？

original: Tyrion: Nothing...[p/] She's not talking about anything.
translation: Tyrion: 没什么……[p/]她没特指任何事。

original: Mosourika: Wait...[p/] You're [i]actually[/i] embarrassed about it?
translation: Mosourika: 等等……[p/]你[i]其实[/i]会因此感到害羞？

original: Mosourika: When we were kids,[p/] you did it even more than [i]I[/i] did!
translation: Mosourika: 我们小时候，[p/]你这么干的时间可比[i]我[/]i还多！

original: Celeste: What?![p/][s/] What did he use to do?!
translation: Celeste: 什么？！[p/][s/]他以前都干什么？！

original: Mosourika: Why don't you show her, Tyrion?
translation: Mosourika: 让她看看呗，提利昂？

original: Tyrion: I refuse.
translation: Tyrion: 我拒绝。

original: Celeste: Come on![p/][s/] Show us, Tyrion!
translation: Celeste: 拜托！[p/][s/]给我们看看嘛，提利昂！

original: Player: The "Thing"
translation: Player: “那个东西”

original: Tyrion: I think I'm a little too old for this...
translation: Tyrion: 我都这么大了……

original: Mosourika: I am [i]insulted[/i] that you think age has anything to do with it!
translation: Mosourika: 你觉得这是年龄的问题吗？我感觉受到[i]冒犯[/i]！

original: Mosourika: You need to feed it, Tyrion—[p/]lest your radiant light be smothered into a flickering ember!
translation: Mosourika: 你需要补偿它，提利昂——[p/]否则你璀璨的光辉只会消逝为闪烁的余烬！

original: Celeste: Do it, Tyrion!
translation: Celeste: 上吧，提利昂！

original: Mosourika: Yeah![p/][s/] Do it, Tyrion!
translation: Mosourika: 没错！[p/][s/]上吧，提利昂！

original: The two of them began chanting,[p/] drawing the attention of the other patrons in the café.
translation: 这两个家伙一唱一和，[p/]把店里所有客人的注意力都吸引过来了。

original: I took in a deep breath.
translation: 我深呼吸了一下。

original: Tyrion: Those who stand in the shadows![p/][s/] Those who fear the light of divinity!
translation: Tyrion: 那些隐藏在阴影中的人！[p/][s/]那些畏惧神圣光辉的人！

original: Tyrion: Your imperials will fall,[p/] and your armies will perish!
translation: Tyrion: 你的帝国将崩塌，[p/]你的军队将覆灭！

original: Tyrion: Kneel and cower before the divine gaze of the Eye of Horus!
