translation: Tyrion: 在荷鲁斯之眼的神圣凝视下，跪下颤抖吧！

original: Tyrion: I am Tyrion Cuthbert: [p/][s/]Emperor of Light and the sworn enemy of Darkness itself!
translation: Tyrion: 我是提利昂·卡斯伯特：[p/][s/]既是光明与誓言的帝王，也是黑暗的永恒之敌！

original: Celeste: Pffft...
translation: Celeste: 噗……

original: Mosourika: [i]*snicker*[/i]
translation: Mosourika: [i]*窃笑*[/i]

original: They were trying really hard to contain their laughter.
translation: 她们竭尽全力地压抑笑声。

original: Tyrion: …W-[p/]Well,[p/][s/] [i]that's[/i] why I don't do it anymore!
translation: Tyrion: …呃、[p/]嗯，[p/][s/][i]这就是[/i]i我不这么做了的原因！

original: Celeste: N-[p/]No...[p/] T-[p/]That was...[p/] great.[p/]
translation: Celeste: 不、[p/]不……[p/]这、[p/]这真的……[p/]很棒。[p/]

original: Celeste: It was [i]really[/i] cool, Tyrion.
translation: Celeste: 这真的[i]太[/i]酷了，提利昂。

original: Her poorly contained laughs puffed out between each word.
translation: 她说出的每个词之间都夹杂着笑声。

original: Tyrion: And why are [i]you[/i] laughing?![p/][s/] You were [i]just[/i] doing it a moment ago!
translation: Tyrion: [i[你[/i]为什么要笑？！[p/][s/][i]仅仅[/]i几分钟前你也在干这种事！

original: Celeste: Yeah,[p/] but she owns it.
translation: Celeste: 是……[p/]但她演得很好。

original: Tyrion: Ugh...
translation: Tyrion: 唔哦……

original: Mosourika: You used to say something else...[p/] What was it?
translation: Mosourika: 你以前还有几句常用台词……[p/]是什么来着？

original: Mosourika: Oh, yeah!
translation: Mosourika: 啊，想起来了！

original: Mosourika: "It doesn't matter who stands in my way—"
translation: Mosourika: “不论是谁要阻挡我的脚步——”

original: Celeste: Man,[p/] king,[p/] or god?
translation: Celeste: 人、[p/]王、[p/]亦或是神？

original: Mosourika: Yeah![p/] [i]That's[/i] it!
translation: Mosourika: 是的！[p/]就是[i]这个[/i]！

original: Celeste: He still says that sometimes!
translation: Celeste: 他现在有时也这么说！

original: Mosourika: Your...[p/] bodyguard really eats a lot.
translation: Mosourika: 你的……[p/]保镖确实胃口不小。

original: Celeste looked up from her plate,[p/] making eye contact with the two of us.
translation: 塞莱斯特抬头看看自己的盘子，[p/]又与我们两个视线相接。

original: She paused for a moment before going back to her meals.
translation: 她在继续进餐前停顿了一下子。

original: Tyrion: ...She's really good at her job.
translation: Tyrion: ……她的工作做得非常棒。

original: She must've been burning all those calories somehow.
translation: 她肯定是用什么方法消耗了所有摄入的热量。

original: Mosourika: ...I heard you've been fighting the nobility.[p/] Is that why you need her?
translation: Mosourika: ……我听说了，你在和贵族战斗。[p/]这就是你需要她的原因？

original: Tyrion: You know about that?
translation: Tyrion: 你也知道了？

original: Mosourika: The papers won't stop talking about you.
translation: Mosourika: 报纸上总是有你的报道。

original: Mosourika: I couldn't believe it when I saw your picture in the Aurinax Post after all these years.
translation: Mosourika: 这么多年之后，在《欧奥耐克斯邮报》上看到你的照片简直令人难以置信。

original: Tyrion: ...I'm sorry.
translation: Tyrion: ……抱歉啦。

original: Mosourika: I'm just glad you're safe, Tyrion.
translation: Mosourika: 我只是很高兴你还平安，提利昂。

original: Mosourika: Look at you.[p/] I never expected the Lightsworn Monarch to start wearing a suit.
translation: Mosourika: 看看你。[p/]我从没想过“光道君主”现在穿上西装了。

original: Celeste: What's this Lightsworn Monarch I keep hearing about?
translation: Celeste: 你刚说的这个“光道君主”是什么东西？

original: Tyrion: Ugh...[p/] It's something I used to call myself when I was a kid.
translation: Tyrion: 呃……[p/]这就是我还小的时候常用的自称。

original: Celeste: Wait, really?![p/][s/] That's adorable!
translation: Celeste: 诶，真的啊？[p/][s/]挺可爱的！

original: Mosourika: It pales in comparison to the "Ashen Lord of Aurinax".
translation: Mosourika: 但与“欧奥耐克斯的灰烬之主”相比就苍白无力了。

original: Mosourika: But just as I'd expect from my apprentice![p/][s/] You're practically famous now!
translation: Mosourika: 但正如我对徒弟的期盼一样！[p/][s/]你现在几乎可以称得上一位名人了！

original: Mosourika: Not even the headmaster of the Imperial Academy could stand against you!
translation: Mosourika: 连帝国学院的校长都无法与你匹敌！

original: I winced at being reminded about Redmond.[p/] I still didn't feel great about what happened.
translation: 一想起雷德蒙，我不由得皱起眉头。[p/]我仍然无法为那起事件释怀。

original: Mosourika: ...What's wrong?
translation: Mosourika: ……怎么了呢？

original: Tyrion: ...Theodore Redmond wasn't a bad person.[p/] He just made a really terrible mistake.
translation: Tyrion: ……西奥多·雷德蒙并不是什么坏人。[p/]他只是犯下了严重的错误。

original: Tyrion: I'm not happy about indicting him.
translation: Tyrion: 我并不因为他定罪而感到喜悦。

original: Mosourika: Oh...
translation: Mosourika: 啊……

original: Mosourika: A gem with a strange carvings?[p/] Is it cursed?
translation: Mosourika: 刻有奇异纹路的一颗宝石？[p/]它遭到诅咒了吗？

original: Mosourika: I want one.
translation: Mosourika: 我也想要一个。

original: Tyrion: You have to be an attorney to receive one.
translation: Tyrion: 你得成为律师才能得到这个。

original: Tyrion: You've really made a life for yourself here.
translation: Tyrion: 你在这里也是成功自食其力了。

original: Tyrion: I'm glad that you were able to realize your dreams and open a café.
translation: Tyrion: 我很高兴你实现了自己开咖啡馆的梦想。

original: Mosourika: Hehe.[p/] But of course.
translation: Mosourika: 嘿嘿，[p/]那当然。

original: Mosourika: Once the Dark Lord sets her sights on a quarry,[p/] it's only a matter of time before she obtains it.
translation: Mosourika: 一旦黑暗领主锁定了猎物，[p/]抓住对手就只是时间问题了。

original: Mosourika: I've grown up since you last saw me.
translation: Mosourika: 和上一次见面比，我已经长大了。

original: Tyrion: Yeah...[p/] Let's not go [i]that[/i] far.
translation: Tyrion: 是啊……[p/]我觉得没长大[i]那么[/i]多。

original: Mosourika: What's [i]that[/i] supposed to mean?!
translation: Mosourika: [i]这话[/i]是什么意思？！

original: Mosourika: The scary lady...[p/] She's your mother now?
translation: Mosourika: 那个可怕的女士……[p/]她现在是你的母亲吗？

original: Tyrion: …She's my guardian, yes.
translation: Tyrion: ……是，她是我的监护人。

original: Mosourika: ...Is she nice?
translation: Mosourika: ……她人怎么样？好相处吗？

original: Tyrion: "Nice" isn't the [i]first[/i] word I'd use to describe Ms. Tymora,[p/] but she's always taken care of me.
translation: Tyrion: 虽然我不会用“好相处”描述泰摩拉女士，[p/]但她总是很照顾我。

original: Tyrion: She taught me everything I know about being a defense attorney.
translation: Tyrion: 她教给了我成为辩护律师所需的一切知识。

original: Tyrion: I don't think I'd be the person that I am today without her.
translation: Tyrion: 若不是她，我也不会有今天。

original: Mosourika: That's good.
translation: Mosourika: 那很好。

original: Mosourika: I'm just glad that she treats you well.
translation: Mosourika: 我很高兴她对你不错。

original: Tyrion: Well…[p/] It's been nice catching up with you, Rika.
translation: Tyrion: 嗯……[p/]很高兴和你见面，里卡。

original: Tyrion: ...But, I think it's time for us to get going.
translation: Tyrion: ……但是，我想我们得走了。

original: Celeste: What?![p/][s/] But we just got here!
translation: Celeste: 什么？！[p/][s/]我们俩才刚到！

original: Mosourika: Hmph...[p/] I'll let you go this time, Lightsworn Monarch.
translation: Mosourika: 哼……[p/]这次我就放你一马，“光道君主”啊。

original: Mosourika: But by partaking of the food within my realm,[p/] you've fallen under its curse.
translation: Mosourika: 但既然在我的领地享用食物，[p/]你们就已经身负诅咒。

original: Tyrion: ...Curse?
translation: Tyrion: ……诅咒？

original: Mosourika: You are now bound to my domain for eternity!
translation: Mosourika: 你们将永远被束缚在我的支配之下！

original: Mosourika: But I'm a benevolent lord.[p/] Your only charge as my servant is to write to me at least once a fortnight!
translation: Mosourika: 但我是个仁慈的领主。[p/]你作为仆人唯一的职责就是每逢弦月要给我写封信！

original: Celeste: ...How long is a fortnight again?
translation: Celeste: ……那是多久？

original: Tyrion: Two weeks.
translation: Tyrion: 两周。

original: Tyrion: I'll stay in touch, Rika.
translation: Tyrion: 我会保持联系的，里卡。

original: Mosourika: You'd better.
translation: Mosourika: 你最好是。

original: Mosourika: Don't just disappear like last time.
translation: Mosourika: 别跟上次一样消失不见了。

original: We left the café and made our way to the local merchant's guild to rent a carriage.
translation: 我们从咖啡馆离开，前往当地的商人工会租马车。

original: The city streets seemed a bit more crowded than before.[p/] There must have been some kind of event going on.
translation: 街道比之前更为拥挤，[p/]肯定发生了什么事情。

original: Celeste: Hey,[p/] Tyrion?
translation: Celeste: 喂，[p/]提利昂？

original: Tyrion: ...Yeah?
translation: Tyrion: ……怎么了？

original: Celeste: Um...
translation: Celeste: 呃……

original: She fidgeted with her hands and seemed unable to make eye contact with me.
translation: 她摆弄着自己的双手，似乎不敢与我眼神接触。

original: She looked like she wanted to say something,[p/] but she couldn't find the right words.
translation: 看起来她想说些什么，[p/]但找不到合适的言辞。

original: Celeste: ...Never mind,[p/] it's nothing.
translation: Celeste: ……算了，[p/]没什么。

original: Tyrion: ...Okay?
translation: Tyrion: ……好吧？

original: We made our way to the merchant's guild in silence.
translation: 我们默默地走向商人公会。

original: With each step,[p/] we found the streets becoming more and more crowded.
translation: 每走一步，[p/]都感觉街道变得愈发拥挤。

original: I really hoped that this traffic wouldn't interfere with the ride home.
translation: 我真希望着交通状况不会影响我们回家。

original: Celeste: Hi,[p/] could we rent a carriage for travel to Ratholme?
translation: Celeste: 你好，[p/]我们能租一辆到瑞思霍姆的马车吗？

original: Peasant: Sorry,[p/] but travel outside of the city is temporarily closed.
translation: Peasant: 对不起，[p/]出城的道路都被暂时拦住了。

original: Tyrion: What?[p/] Why?
translation: Tyrion: 什么？[p/]为什么？

original: Peasant: Haven't you heard?[p/] Steelwind's soldiers have locked down the city.
translation: Peasant: 你们没听说吗？[p/]斯蒂尔文德的士兵封锁了整座城市。

original: Peasant: They set up a blockade and everything.
translation: Peasant: 他们设置了路障，还有一整套的封锁措施。

original: A chill ran up my spine.
translation: 我的背脊窜上一阵寒意。

original: Tyrion: ...What are you talking about?
translation: Tyrion: ……你在说什么？

original: Peasant: Check the city gates if you don't believe me.
translation: Peasant: 不信我的话就去城门看看吧。

original: We arrived at the city gates.[p/] Like the man had said,[p/] there was a division of knights blockading the exit to the city.
translation: 我们赶到城门下，[p/]正如他所说，[p/]一大队骑士封锁了出城的道路。

original: There was an entire legion of them.[p/] Their flags bore the colours of the Kingsguard.
translation: 那是一整个师团的人数。[p/]他们的旗帜上是国王卫队的彩饰。

original: Celeste: What are [i]they[/i] doing here?
translation: Celeste: [i]他们[/i]在这里要干什么？

original: The Kingsguard was a military force that responded to matters of national importance.
translation: 国王卫队是应对国家要务的重要兵力。

original: ...They worked directly under Grand General Steelwind.
translation: ……他们直接听命于斯蒂尔文德大将军。

original: The townsfolk kept their distance,[p/] but several aristocrats were making their objections known.
translation: 市民们与他们保持距离，[p/]但几个贵族已经公开表达反对意见。

original: Nobleman: This is outrageous!
translation: Nobleman: 太离谱了！

original: Noblewoman: How long do you plan on keeping us here?!
translation: Noblewoman: 你们打算把我们关在这儿多久？！

original: Knight: Sorry,[p/] but we have our orders.
translation: Knight: 不好意思，[p/]但我们必须遵守命令。

original: Knight: We can't let [i]anyone[/i] outside of the city until our investigation is complete.
translation: Knight: 调查结束前我们不能让[i]任何人[/i]出城。

original: An "investigation"?
translation: “调查”？

original: Tyrion: We should keep our distance.[p/] I wouldn't want to—
translation: Tyrion: 我们该离远点。[p/]我可不想——

original: Celeste: Oh, screw that.
translation: Celeste: 哼，去他的。

original: Before I knew what was going on,[p/] Celeste marched towards the knight stationed there.
translation: 在我反应过来之前，[p/]塞莱斯特已经走向驻扎在那里的骑士。

original: Tyrion: W-[p/][s/]Wait![p/][s/] Celeste!
translation: Tyrion: 等、[p/][s/]等一下！[p/][s/]塞莱斯特！

original: Celeste: At least tell us what's going on?[p/] Why is the entire city being blockaded?
translation: Celeste: 至少能告诉我们发生了什么事吧？[p/]为什么整座城都被封锁了？

original: Knight: Sorry, ma'am.[p/] We're not allowed to release that information.
translation: Knight: 抱歉，女士。[p/]我们无权透露相关信息。

original: Knight: You'll just have to make other arrangements while we sort this out.
translation: Knight: 在我们调查清楚前，你得另做打算了。

original: Knight: ...Actually,[p/] I haven't seen you two around before.
translation: Knight: ……实际上，[p/]我之前没在这儿见过你俩。

original: Knight: I'll need to take down your names and occupations for our records.
translation: Knight: 我需要记录下你们的姓名和职业。

original: Celeste: What?[p/][s/] Why?!
translation: Celeste: 不是吧？[p/][s/]为什么？！

original: Tyrion: I-[p/][s/]It's fine, Celeste...[p/] We're better off just cooperating with them.
translation: Tyrion: 没、[p/][s/]没事的，塞莱斯特……[p/]我们还是听从他们安排吧。

original: We needed to avoid any kind of conflict with them.
translation: 我们需要避免与他们起任何形式的冲突。

original: Tyrion: I'm Tyrion Cuthbert.[p/] I'm a defense attorney.
translation: Tyrion: 我是提利昂·卡斯伯特，[p/]一名辩护律师。

original: Celeste: Ugh...[p/] fine.
translation: Celeste: 呃啊……[p/]好吧。

original: Celeste: I'm Celeste McCoy:[p/] bodyguard.
translation: Celeste: 我是塞莱斯特·麦考伊：[p/]贴身护卫。

original: Knight: ...
translation: Knight: ……

original: Knight: Oh...
translation: Knight: 噢……

original: He suddenly recognized us.[p/] Our reputation did more harm than good most of the time.
translation: 他突然认出了我们。[p/]我们的名声带来的坏处大多数时候比好处多。

original: I looked over to the other knights.[p/] They seemed to be taking notes of the people here, too.
translation: 我看向其他骑士，[p/]他们看起来也在给其他人做登记。

original: They seemed to be compiling a list of everyone inside the city,[p/] but for what?
translation: 他们似乎是在制作城里所有人的名单，[p/]但这是有什么用？

original: Nobleman: I have an important engagement tomorrow!
translation: Nobleman: 我明天有个重要的约会！

original: Nobleman: What am I supposed to do now?!
translation: Nobleman: 我现在该怎么办啊？！

original: Noblewoman: This can't possibly be legal![p/][s/] The Minister of Justice [i]will[/i] be hearing of this!
translation: Noblewoman: 这不可能合法！[p/][s/]司法部长[i]会[/i]知晓这件事的！

original: The nobles continued shouting at the knights.[p/] It was clear they wouldn't be budging any time soon.
translation: 那个贵族还在向骑士们大吼大叫。[p/]但显然他们不吃这一套。

original: As soon as the knights were finished speaking to us,[p/] I quickly backed away.[p/] Celeste followed closely behind me.
translation: 面前的骑士结束与我们的谈话后，[p/]我赶快离开了。[p/]塞莱斯特紧紧地跟着我。

original: Celeste: Tyrion![p/][s/] Wait!
translation: Celeste: 提利昂！[p/][s/]等等我！

original: She said that,[p/] but it took very little effort for her to keep pace with me.
translation: 她虽然这么说，[p/]但毫不费力地就跟上了我。

original: My breathing was getting faster,[p/] and my head was aching.
translation: 我的呼吸变得急促，[p/]头也开始痛了起来。

original: Tyrion: Scaled Lord...[p/] It's happening here.
translation: Tyrion: 鳞主在上……[p/]要开始了。

original: Celeste: ...What?
translation: Celeste: ……什么东西？

original: Tyrion: It's exactly like what's been happening in the countryside!
translation: Tyrion: 就和在那些乡村发生的事情一模一样！

original: Tyrion: Lucio Steelwind sent his men to "keep the peace" here!
translation: Tyrion: 卢西奥·斯蒂尔文德派他的人“维持和平”！

original: Celeste: Oh, [i]that's[/i] why you're so freaked out.
translation: Celeste: 哦，[i]难怪[/i]你这么紧张兮兮的。

original: Tyrion: How are you so calm right now?!
translation: Tyrion: 你现在怎么还能这么冷静？！

original: Celeste: ...I'd probably win if they tried to attack us.
translation: Celeste: ……如果他们要攻击我们，我会赢的。

original: Tyrion: Well, [i]I'm[/i] not some super-warrior who can fight a legion of knights by myself!
translation: Tyrion: 行啊，但[i]我又[/i]不是能独自与一个兵团作战的超级战士！

original: Celeste: Tyrion, relax.[p/] They said they're just investigating something.
translation: Celeste: 放松点，提利昂。[p/]他们说了只是在调查什么事情。

original: Celeste: There are no riots going on here,[p/] and we're in the heart of the Duke of Commerce's territory.
translation: Celeste: 这类并没有发生暴动，[p/]我们可是在商业公爵的核心领地。

original: Celeste: Do you seriously think von Sanctus would let another Pillar Family march onto his land and kill his people?
translation: Celeste: 你真的觉得冯·桑克图斯会放任另一个支柱家族在他的地盘行军杀人？

original: She had a point,[p/] but this uneasiness wasn't going away.
translation: 她说得有道理，[p/]但我的焦虑感并没有因此消失。

original: Celeste: It'll be fine.[p/] Let's just find a place to stay the night and wait for all of this to blow over.
translation: Celeste: 没事的。[p/]我们就找个地方过一夜，等着这起风波过去就好了。

original: We walked to a nearby tavern and found it absolutely crowded with patrons.
translation: 我们走进附近一家旅馆，里面已经挤满了客人。

original: Celeste: ...Everyone else had the same idea.
translation: Celeste: ……每个人都是这么想的。

original: Peasant: Hey,[p/] welcome to the Aegwyn Tavern.
translation: Peasant: 您好，[p/]欢迎来到艾格文旅馆。

original: Peasant: What can I do for you?
translation: Peasant: 如何为您效劳？

original: Tyrion: Could we get two rooms for the night?
translation: Tyrion: 我们能要两间过夜的房吗？

original: Peasant: ...Sorry,[p/] we're fully booked with the blockade and all.
translation: Peasant: ……真不好意思，[p/]因为封城，我们的客房都订满了。

original: Celeste: Wait...[p/] Let me take care of this.
translation: Celeste: 等等……[p/]让我来搞定。

original: Celeste took out a large pouch of gold and dropped it on the innkeeper's desk.
translation: 塞莱斯特拿出一大袋黄金，“咚”的一声放在客栈老板的桌上。

original: Peasant: ...
translation: Peasant: ……

original: Peasant: Well, would you look at that!
translation: Peasant: 那好吧，您看这么安排如何！

original: Peasant: One of our rooms just opened up!
translation: Peasant: 我们有间房刚刚正好空出来了！

original: Tyrion: Only one?
translation: Tyrion: 就一个？

original: Peasant: The entire city's locked down.
translation: Peasant: 整座城市都被封锁了。

original: Peasant: Even [i]with[/i] this gratuity,[p/] that's the best I can do for you.
translation: Peasant: 即使[i]有[/i]您的慷慨手笔，[p/]我也只能做到这个地步了。

original: Celeste: What?[p/] Embarrassed to share a room with me, Tyrion?
translation: Celeste: 怎么？[p/]跟我住一间房就害羞了，提利昂？

original: Tyrion: N-[p/][s/]No![p/][s/] I just—
translation: Tyrion: 才、[p/][s/]才不是！[p/][s/]我就是——

original: I briefly glanced at the innkeeper.[p/] He chuckled at my reaction.
translation: 我瞟了老板一眼，[p/]他因我的反应轻轻笑了出来。

original: Tyrion: Fine...[p/] Let's just go.
translation: Tyrion: 算了……[p/]我们进去吧。

original: We walked into the room they had prepared for us.
translation: 我们走进为我们安排的那间客房。

original: ...There was one bed.
translation: ……里面只有一张床。

original: Tyrion: S-[p/][s/]So...[p/][s/] How should we—?
translation: Tyrion: 这、[p/][s/]这个……[p/][s/]我们该怎么——？

original: Celeste: Oh.[p/] I was just kidding before.
translation: Celeste: 噢，[p/]我就是开个玩笑。

original: Celeste: You can have the bed.[p/] I'll just sleep on the floor.
translation: Celeste: 你可以睡床，[p/]我睡地上就行。

original: Tyrion: W-[p/][s/]What?![p/][s/] I can't just let you—!
translation: Tyrion: 那、[p/][s/]那怎么行？！[p/][s/]我不能让你就这么——！

original: Celeste: Please,[p/] we're both commoners,[p/] but [i]you[/i] live a cushy life in the city.
translation: Celeste: 拜托啦，[p/]我们都是平民而已，[p/]但[i]你[/i]在城里过惯了安逸日子。

original: Celeste: I'm a mercenary.[p/] I've lived on the road for years.
translation: Celeste: 我是雇佣兵。[p/]我已在路上生活了多年了。

original: Celeste: I've slept like this plenty of times.
translation: Celeste: 我都这么睡觉很多次了。

original: I couldn't argue against that,[p/] but I still felt uneasy.
translation: 我无法反驳她，[p/]但仍然感到不自在。

original: Tyrion: Alright...[p/] Just let me know if you change your mind.
translation: Tyrion: 好吧……[p/]如果你改了念头要告诉我。

original: Celeste: Yeah, yeah...
translation: Celeste: 好的，好的……

original: I let myself fall onto the bed.[p/] Celeste started checking the room for anything suspicious.
translation: 我让自己倒在床上，[p/]塞莱斯特则开始检查房间里有没有可疑的地方。

original: I tried to relax,[p/] but Lucio Steelwind was in my hometown.[p/] I just took deep breaths.
translation: 我想要放松下来，[p/]但又想起那个卢西奥·斯蒂尔文德来到我的故乡了。[p/]我只得做了几次深呼吸。

original: Celeste was right.[p/] The Grand General wasn't insane enough to try anything in the heart of Lloyd von Sanctus's territory.
translation: 塞莱斯特说得没错。[p/]大将军不会疯狂到在洛伊德·冯·桑克图斯的领地肆意妄为。

original: ...I really hoped that was true.
translation: ……我真希望这个推测是对的。

original: Lloyd: We had an arrangement![p/][s/] What are you doing?!
translation: Lloyd: 我们约好了的！[p/][s/]你要干什么？！

original: Justin: I don't know.[p/] I guess I'm goin' back to do my actual job.
translation: Justin: 我也不知道。[p/]我想自己该回去做本职工作了。

original: Lloyd: You little rat![p/][s/] Do you think you can get away with crossing [i]me[/i]?!
translation: Lloyd: 你这小混蛋！[p/][s/]你以为还能从[i]我[/i]手上逃走吗？！

original: Lloyd: You've already come this far![p/][s/] You are far from blameless!
translation: Lloyd: 你都做下了这么多事情！[p/][s/]你可一点都不无辜啊！

original: Lloyd: Now get back in that office and activate the device!
translation: Lloyd: 现在给我返回办公室，启动装置！

original: Justin: ...
translation: Justin: ……

original: Justin: I thought you wanted me to rob the place.
translation: Justin: 我以为你是要我偷那里面的东西。

original: Justin: What's so special about this thing,[p/] and why the office?
translation: Justin: 这个物品为什么那么特别？[p/]为什么偏偏是这间办公室？

original: Lloyd: I-[p/][s/]I—
translation: Lloyd: 这、[p/][s/]这个——

original: Justin: How about I activate it right now?
translation: Justin: 我现在就启动怎么样？

original: Lloyd: D-[p/][s/]Do [i]not[/i] do that?!
translation: Lloyd: 住、[p/][s/][i]住手[/i]！！

original: Justin: I knew it.[p/] There's been something more to these jobs, ain't it?
translation: Justin: 我就知道。[p/]这次的活计背后有问题，对不对？

original: Justin: This ain't just robbery.[p/] You're using me for something else.
translation: Justin: 这次不只是要偷东西。[p/]你要利用我达成其他目的。

original: Lloyd: As if [i]you[/i] ever cared.
translation: Lloyd: 说得[i]你[/i]多在乎一样。

original: Lloyd: I know about your debts![p/][s/] You [i]need[/i] me!
translation: Lloyd: 我知道你欠的债！[p/][s/]你[i]需要[/i]我！

original: Justin: You know what?[p/] I'm done with this.
translation: Justin: 你知道吗？[p/]我受够了。

original: Justin: I quit.
translation: Justin: 我不干了。

original: Lloyd: What do you think this is?!
translation: Lloyd: 你以为这是什么儿戏吗？！

original: Cat: [i]*MROOOOOOOW*[/i]
translation: Cat: <size=1.5em>[i]*喵呜呜呜呜呜呜*[/i]</size>

original: Justin: You got cotton in your ears or something?
translation: Justin: 你是聋了还是怎么的？

original: Justin: I said.[p/] I.[p/] QUIT.
translation: Justin:我说了。[p/]<size=1.5em>我[p/]不[p/]干[p/]了</size>。

original: Justin: Consider this my resignation.
translation: Justin: 就把这个当做我的辞呈吧。

original: Lloyd: Wait![p/][s/] Stop!
translation: Lloyd: 停停！[p/][s/]住手啊！

original: Justin: W-[p/][s/]Wha—?!
translation: Justin: 什、[p/][s/]什——？！

original: Justin: AGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGH!
translation: Justin: <size=1.5em>啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！</size>

original: Lloyd: ...Damn it all!
translation: Lloyd: ……真是该死！

original: Lloyd: Violetta![p/][s/] Get out of there now!
translation: Lloyd: 薇欧蕾塔！[p/][s/]马上离开那里！

original: As the night went on,[p/] I found myself falling into a terrible nightmare.
translation: 夜色渐深，[p/]我陷入了可怖的噩梦。

original: ...How long had I been walking through this forest?
translation: ……我在这森林里走了多久了？

original: It had probably been days at this point.[p/] I was getting tired.
translation: 感觉已经过去了好几天。[p/]我已疲惫不堪。

original: But I had to get to Ratholme.[p/] I had to find Ms. Tymora again.
translation: 但我需要走到瑞思霍姆。[p/]我需要再找到泰摩拉女士。

original: I needed to find her.[p/] I needed her to teach me.[p/] I needed [i]revenge[/i].
translation: 我要找到她。[p/]我要让她教我。[p/]我要[i]复仇[/i]。

original: I needed...
translation: 我要……

original: I [i]really[/i] needed some food.[p/] I'd already gone through all of the dried fish that I'd packed for the journey.
translation: 我[i]真的[/i]要吃东西了。[p/]我已经吃完了上路时打包的所有鱼干。

original: The compass told me that I was still heading west,[p/] but I didn't realize how long it would take to get to Ratholme on foot.
translation: 罗盘显示我仍在向西方前进，[p/]但我并不明白光凭双腿走到瑞思霍姆究竟需要多久。

original: I suddenly heard the sound of a distant carriage coming from behind me.
translation: 我突然听到背后远远传来马车的声音。

original: It wasn't long before the cart passed by me.[p/] The carriage driver glanced at me before doing a double take and yanking at the reins.
translation: 很快它超过了我。[p/]马车夫看瞥了我一眼，又仔细看了两下，猛地拉起缰绳。

original: Peasant: Hey...[p/] What are you doing all the way out here?
translation: Peasant: 喂……[p/]你在这里做什么？

original: I said nothing.[p/] I just stared blankly at him.
translation: 我什么都没说，[p/]茫然地盯着他。

original: Peasant: ...Are you okay?[p/] Where are your parents?
translation: Peasant: ……你还好吗？[p/]你的父母呢？

original: Tyrion: ...They're gone.
translation: Tyrion: ……他们都死了。

original: The man scratched his head and scanned the surrounding forest.
translation: 他挠了挠头发，扫视周围的森林。

original: Tyrion: ...I need to go to Ratholme.[p/] I need to find Ruby Tymora.
translation: Tyrion: ……我得到瑞思霍姆去。[p/]我要找到鲁比·泰摩拉。

original: Peasant: Wait,[p/] that criminal lawyer?
translation: Peasant: 嗯？[p/]你是说那个刑事律师？

original: Tyrion: She's my family's lawyer.
translation: Tyrion: 她也是我家的律师。

original: Peasant: Oh...[p/] Uh—
translation: Peasant: 噢……[p/]呃——

original: Peasant: I'm going to be passing by Ratholme.[p/] You should probably come with me.
translation: Peasant: 我正好要经过瑞思霍姆。[p/]你该和我一起走。

original: Peasant: We can get you to the City Watch.[p/] They probably know how to help a kid like you.
translation: Peasant: 我可以把你带给城市安保。[p/]他们应该知道怎么帮上你这样的小孩子。

original: I wasn't interested in meeting more knights,[p/] but at this rate,[p/] I was going to starve.
translation: 我并不怎么想再和那些骑士打交道，[p/]但再这么下去，[p/]我会饿死。

original: Without a word,[p/] I climbed into the back of his carriage.
translation: 我一言不发， [p/]爬上了马车的车厢。

original: Peasant: Kid looks like he's half dead.
translation: Peasant: 这孩子看着去了半条命了。

original: I was startled awake.[p/] My face was covered in sweat.
translation: 我惊醒了。[p/]脸上满是冷汗。

original: It took me a while before I realized that it had just been a nightmare.
translation: 过了好一会儿我才反应过来自己刚刚做了噩梦。

original: I rubbed my eyes.[p/] There were dried tears crusted into them.
translation: 我揉了揉眼睛，[p/]眼眶上结着干涸的泪痕。

original: Tyrion: Damn it all...
translation: Tyrion: 糟透了……

original: It had been a long time since I'd stopped having those nightmares.
translation: 我已经很久没做过这个噩梦了。

original: Being in this city was digging up memories that I'd moved on from.[p/] All the more reason to leave as soon as possible.
translation: 待在这座城市，我那些一度抛诸脑后的回忆都被翻了出来。[p/]更有理由要尽快离开了。

original: Tyrion: Celeste,[p/] are you up?
translation: Tyrion: 塞莱斯特？[p/]你起来了吗？

original: Celeste: H-[p/][s/]Huh?!
translation: Celeste: 呜、[p/][s/]呜哦？！

original: She'd been wistfully staring outside the tavern window,[p/] but her body twitched the moment I called out to her.
translation: 她一直在若有所思地盯着窗外，[p/]我一叫她，她身体就抖了一下。

original: Tyrion: ...Are you okay?
translation: Tyrion: ……你没事吧？

original: Celeste: Y-[p/][s/]Yeah...
translation: Celeste: 没、[p/][s/]没事……

original: Celeste: You just startled me... [h="He wasn't awake.|...Was he?" e="hf" /]
translation: Celeste: 被你吓了一跳…… [h="他刚刚还没醒吧|……是没醒吧？" e="hf" /]

original: There was clearly something else,[p/] but she didn't seem keen on sharing.
translation: 肯定有什么，[p/]但她看起来不太想说。

original: Tyrion: ...Do you know if the city is still on lockdown?
translation: Tyrion: ……你知道封城有没有解除吗？

original: Celeste: I-[p/]I haven't checked yet.[p/] I was waiting for you.
translation: Celeste: 我、[p/]我还没有去查看。[p/]我一直在等你起来。

original: We arrived at the city gates.[p/] It was still being blocked by the Kingsguard.
translation: 我们抵达城门下，[p/]国王卫队仍然在封锁出入。

original: If anything,[p/] it looked like they'd doubled the number of knights there.
translation: 要说有什么变化的话，[p/]看起来布放的骑士增加了有一倍。

original: I really didn't like where this was going...
translation: 这个走向真的很讨厌……

original: Celeste: [i]*sigh*[/i][p/] Do you want to head to the Café again?
translation: Celeste: [i]*叹气*[/i][p/]你觉得我们再去一趟那个咖啡馆怎么样？

original: Tyrion: Yeah...[p/] We'll just have to wait this out.
translation: Tyrion: 行啊……[p/]我们也只能等了。

original: ...And just as we turned around,[p/] we saw Rika running towards us from a block away.
translation: ……我们转过身来，[p/]看到远在一个街区外的里卡正冲着我们跑过来。

original: Mosourika: T-[p/][s/]Tyrion!
translation: Mosourika: 提、[p/][s/]提利昂！

original: She broke out into a sprint,[p/] nearly tripping over as she slipped on the wet city streets.
translation: 她突然冲刺起来，[p/]在湿滑的街道上滑了一下，几乎摔倒。

original: She looked exhausted,[p/] and her clothes were drenched.[p/] She'd been out in the rain for a while.
translation: 她看起来相当劳累，[p/]衣服都湿透了，[p/]肯定已经在雨中待了很久。

original: Mosourika: Tyrion![p/][s/] It's terrible!
translation: Mosourika: 提利昂！[p/][s/]大事不好了！

original: Mosourika: T-[p/][s/]There was an accident at the Arcane Refinery last night!
translation: Mosourika: 昨、[p/][s/]昨晚奥术精炼厂发生了一起事故！

original: Mosourika: One of my friends who worked there...[p/] He fell into a vat of chemicals.
translation: Mosourika: 我的一个朋友在那儿工作……[p/]他掉进了装满化学品的容器里。

original: Mosourika: He's...[p/] dead.
translation: Mosourika: 他……[p/]死了。

original: Tyrion: Oh, Rika...[p/] I'm so sorry.
translation: Tyrion: 噢，里卡……[p/]我很遗憾。

original: Tyrion: If there's anything I can do—
translation: Tyrion: 有什么我能帮忙的吗——

original: Mosourika: The Duke is blaming the Dracogen Trading Company!
translation: Mosourika: 公爵将其归咎于德拉科根贸易公司！

original: Mosourika: He's trying to charge the owner with criminal negligence!
translation: Mosourika: 他试图指控公司的所有者犯有刑事过失罪！

original: As the lord of this region,[p/] it was House von Sanctus's responsibility to carry out the law.
translation: 作为本地区的领主，[p/]执行法律正是冯·桑克图斯家的责任。

original: But the Duke was obviously just taking this opportunity to attack one of his rivals.
translation: 但是公爵显然只是抓住机会攻讦竞争对手。

original: Mosourika: Tyrion...[p/] You're a famous lawyer, right?
translation: Mosourika: 提利昂，[p/]你是个有名的律师，对吧？

original: Mosourika: Can you help them?
translation: Mosourika: 你能帮帮他们吗？

original: Tyrion: I...[p/] don't think I can.
translation: Tyrion: 我……[p/]不觉得我可以。

original: Mosourika: W-[p/][s/]What?![p/] B-[p/]But—
translation: Mosourika: 为、[p/][s/]为什么？！[p/]但、[p/]但是——

original: Tyrion: Rika,[p/] I specialize in homicides,[p/] and most of my clients are [i]mages[/i] who've been charged with murder.
translation: Tyrion: 里卡，[p/]我专精凶杀案。[p/]我绝大部分客户都是被控谋杀罪的[i]法师[/i]。

original: Tyrion: There isn't any magic involved in what happened.[p/] There isn't even a killer.
translation: Tyrion: 并没有什么法术在案件里产生影响，[p/]甚至没有特定的凶手。

original: Mosourika: T-[p/][s/]That's not true![p/][s/] I saw it happen!
translation: Mosourika: 不、[p/][s/]不是这样！[p/][s/]我看到了！

original: Mosourika: I didn't see who did it,[p/] but I saw someone cast a spell at him!
translation: Mosourika: 我没有看到是谁干的，[p/]但我看到有人向他施放了法术！

original: Mosourika: It pushed him into the vat!
translation: Mosourika: 他是被推到容器里的！

original: Celeste: What?!
translation: Celeste: 你说什么？！

original: Tyrion: ...How sure are you of this?
translation: Tyrion: ……你对此有多确定？

original: Mosourika: I-[p/][s/]I don't know...[p/] It all happened really fast.
translation: Mosourika: 我、[p/][s/]我也说不上来……[p/]发生得太快了。

original: I took a deep breath.[p/] Even [i]she[/i] didn't seem that sure of what she saw.
translation: 我深吸一口气。[p/]即使是[i]她[/i]都对自己的目击内容不太确定。

original: Tyrion: Do you know what kind of spell it was?
translation: Tyrion: 你知道那是什么法术吗？

original: Mosourika: I-[p/][s/]I don't know![p/][s/] But it was powerful enough to break everything around it!
translation: Mosourika: 我、[p/][s/]我不知道！[p/][s/]但那个法术威力巨大，能把周围的东西都破坏了！

original: That definitely sounded too distinct.[p/] She must have seen [i]something[/i].
translation: 这听起来就很特别了。[p/]她一定是看到了[i]什么[/i]。

original: Tyrion: ...Okay.[p/] I'll head to the refinery and see what I can do.
translation: Tyrion: ……那好。[p/]我这就去精炼厂看看能做些什么。

original: Mosourika: Really?
translation: Mosourika: 真的？

original: Tyrion: But don't get your hopes up.[p/] I don't have a lot of information to work with.
translation: Tyrion: 也别抱太大希望。[p/]我还没多少可以着手的信息。

original: Mosourika: That's fine![p/][s/] I'll let Dracogen know that you're on your way.
translation: Mosourika: 没关系！[p/][s/]我这就告诉德拉科根，你已经在去的路上了。

original: ...This week was just getting worse by the minute.
translation: ……这一周真是每一刻都在变得更糟糕。

original: Tyrion: Rika, are you okay?
translation: Tyrion: 里卡，你没事吧？

original: Mosourika: Ha![p/][s/] Do you even need to ask?!
translation: Mosourika: 哈！[p/][s/]这还要问吗？！

original: Mosourika: Of course I'm not okay!
translation: Mosourika: 当然不是没事了！

original: Mosourika: This place is crawling with knights and nobles!
translation: Mosourika: 这里到处都是骑士和贵族！

original: Tyrion: I understand your reservations,[p/] but there's nothing to worry about.
translation: Tyrion: 我理解你的顾虑，[p/]但没什么需要担心的。

original: Tyrion: They're just here to watch the trial.
translation: Tyrion: 他们只是来旁观庭审的。

original: Stefanic: I really appreciate you coming to testify, Ms. Tudor.
translation: Stefanic: 真的很感激你前来作证，都铎女士。

original: Stefanic: I can imagine it's difficult for you to return here again.
translation: Stefanic: 我想你回到这里，一定十分难过。

original: Stefanic: ...
translation: Stefanic: ……

original: Stefanic: My apologies.[p/] Perhaps I've said too much.
translation: Stefanic: 非常抱歉。[p/]我或许多嘴了。

original: Mosourika: [i]*sigh*[/i][p/] Let's just get this over with...
translation: Mosourika: [i]*叹气*[/i][p/]我们还是赶紧把眼前的事情了结了吧……

original: JUDGE: Court is now in session for the trial of Stefanic Dracogen.
translation: Judge: 法庭现在开庭，审理斯蒂芬尼克·德拉科根案。

original: AriaC: The prosecution is ready, Your Honor.
translation: AriaC: 检方已准备就绪，法官阁下。

original: TYRION: The defense is also ready.
translation: Tyrion: 辩方也准备完毕。

original: JUDGE: Very well.[p/] Prosecutor Steelwind,[p/] could you please list the charges?
translation: JUDGE: 很好。[p/]检察官斯蒂尔文德，[p/]能请你列出指控吗？

original: AriaC: Stefanic Dracogen is the owner of the Dracogen Trading Company,[p/] located in the city of Aurinax.
translation: AriaC: 斯蒂芬尼克·德拉科根系德拉科根贸易公司的所有人，[p/]公司位于欧奥耐克斯城内。

original: AriaC: His company has many business ventures in Aurinax and Ratholme,[p/] but his business is most known for the production of artificery devices.
translation: AriaC: 他的公司在欧奥耐克斯和瑞思霍姆都有多项商业投资，[p/]其中最为人所知的是奥术能源装置生产事业。

original: Judge: Ah,[p/] I thought I recognized the name.
translation: Judge: 啊，[p/]我想起来这个名字了。

original: Judge: I'm quite pleased with my Dracogen brand dishwasher.
translation: Judge: 我还挺喜欢德拉科根牌的洗碗机的。

original: AriaC: ...Be that as it may, Your Honor,[p/] Mr. Dracogen is charged with criminal negligence resulting in death.
translation: AriaC: ……尽管如此，法官阁下，[p/]德拉科根先生正被指控过失杀人。

original: AriaC: The accident occurred within the Aurinax Arcane Refinery owned by his company.
translation: AriaC: 这起事故发生在他公司名下的欧奥耐克斯奥术精炼厂内。

original: AriaC: The victim: Justin Waye,[p/] leaned against a damaged guardrail,[p/] causing it to break.
translation: AriaC: 被害人贾斯汀·维耶，[p/]倚靠在受损的护栏上，[p/]致使其断裂。

original: AriaC: As a result,[p/] he fell into a vat of volatile chemicals.
translation: AriaC: 结果就是，[p/]他坠入了装有烈性化学物质的容器里。

original: AriaC: Attempts were made to save him,[p/] but by the time they could neutralize the vat,[p/] he was already dead.
translation: AriaC: 尽管工人们有尝试救他，[p/]但还没来得及中和容器里的物质，[p/]他就已经死去了。

original: Judge: That's certainly a very gruesome way to go.
translation: Judge: 那确实是非常惨烈的死亡方式。

original: AriaC: The defendant displayed clear negligence in maintaining the refinery's facilities.
translation: AriaC: 被告在维持精炼厂设施功能完备方面存在明显的过失。

original: AriaC: As such,[p/] the responsibility for Mr. Waye's death falls squarely on his shoulders.
translation: AriaC: 因此，[p/]维耶先生之死毫无疑问应由他承担责任。

original: Tyrion: Your Honor.[p/] This case isn't nearly as mundane as the prosecution is making it out to be.
translation: Tyrion: 法官阁下。[p/]这个案件远不如检方宣称的那样平淡无奇。

original: Tyrion: Justin Waye didn't fall into that vat because of a faulty guardrail.
translation: Tyrion: 贾斯汀·维耶并非是因为护栏失修而坠落的。

original: Tyrion: He fell because he was pushed off the catwalk by an arcane spell!
translation: Tyrion: 他是被某种奥术魔法推下架空步道的！

original: Judge: Mr. Cuthbert,[p/] are you trying to say that the victim was murdered?!
translation: Judge: 卡斯伯特先生，[p/]你是想说被害人是遭到杀害的吗？！

original: AriaC: ...One of the witnesses claims that they saw a spell hit Mr. Waye before he fell into the vat.
translation: AriaC: ……有一位证人宣称她目击到维耶先生在坠落前遭到一道法术的攻击。

original: AriaC: However,[p/] that testimony is completely contradicted by the lack of magic traces found anywhere near the catwalk.
translation: AriaC: 然而，[p/]她的证词与我们在步道周围未检测出任何法术痕迹的事实相矛盾。

original: Tyrion: If you're so confident, Steelwind,[p/] why don't we bring said witness onto the stand so she can testify herself?
translation: Tyrion: 既然你这么自信，斯蒂尔文德，[p/]那么我们为何不请这位证人亲自出庭作证呢？

original: AriaC: ...Fine.[p/] Let's hear what she has to say.[p/] But I'm sure you know that even [i]she[/i] has no idea what she saw.
translation: AriaC: ……好。[p/]那我们一起听听她的说法。[p/]但我肯定，你也已经知道[i]她[/i]其实并不清楚自己看到了什么。

original: AriaC: Witness.[p/] Please state your name and occupation for the courtroom.
translation: AriaC: 证人，[p/]请向法庭告知你的姓名与职业。

original: She seemed to be okay,[p/] but she looked pretty nervous in the lobby.
translation: 她看起来状态尚可，[p/]但刚刚在大厅里的时候看起来还挺紧张的。

original: I only hoped that this wouldn't be too much for her.
translation: 我只能希望作证对她的负担不会太重。

original: Mosourika: Fufufu...[p/] So you seek the title of the death-bringer songstress.
translation: Mosourika: 哼哼哼……[p/]你们现在来谋求“死亡颂歌者”的名号了。

original: Scaled Lord...[p/][s/] Was she seriously going to do that [i]here[/i]?!
translation: 鳞主在上啊……[p/][s/]她真的要在[i]这里[/i]演那一套吗？！

original: AriaC: ...What?
translation: AriaC: ……这是什么？

original: Mosourika: I lie between life and death—[p/]heaven and hell.[p/] None are worthy of my name,[p/] so consider this a courtesy.
translation: Mosourika: 吾身横亘于生死之界，[p/]徘徊于天堂与地狱的夹缝。[p/]没有什么配得上成为我的名字，[p/]所以请将之视为礼节。

original: Mosourika: I am Mosourika Tudor![p/][s/] Mage of [b]Evocation[/b] and the Ashen Lord of Aurinax!
translation: Mosourika: 吾即为莫苏里卡·都铎！[p/][s/][b]塑能术[/b]的大法师，欧奥耐克斯的灰烬之主！

original: Judge: I wasn't aware that our kingdom had a title like that.
translation: Judge: 我还真不知道王国有这么个头衔。

original: Judge: The world has really changed a lot in recent years.
translation: Judge: 近几年世界变化可真是快啊。

original: Tyrion: Y-[p/][s/]Your Honor...[p/] The witness is a business owner in Aurinax.[p/] She runs a café.
translation: Tyrion: 法、[p/][s/]法官阁下……[p/]证人是欧奥耐克斯的一名店主。[p/]她经营咖啡店。

original: Judge: Why would the Ashen Lord of Aurinax run a café?
translation: Judge: 欧奥耐克斯的灰烬之主为什么要经营咖啡店呢？

original: Mosourika: Ah,[p/] I ask myself that same question every day.
translation: Mosourika: 啊，[p/]我每天也这么问自己。

original: Tyrion: ...Rika, could you please not do this right now?
translation: Tyrion: ……里卡，至少现在能请你不要玩“这个”吗？

original: Mosourika: It helps me cope, okay?!
translation: Mosourika: 这能帮我处理压力，好吗？！

original: AriaC: [i]*ahem*[/i][p/] Ms. Tudor, can you please testify about what you saw at the refinery that morning?
translation: AriaC: [i]*清嗓子*[/i][p/]都铎女士，能请你就在那天早上于精炼厂目击的情况作证吗？

original: AriaC: And I think we could [i]all[/i] do without the verbal flourishes.
translation: AriaC: 而且我认为我们应该省去[i]所有[/i]的华丽辞藻。

original: Mosourika: Ugh...[p/] Fine.
translation: Mosourika: 呃……[p/]好。

original: Mosourika: I was delivering food to Justin that morning,[p/] but I didn't see him anywhere in the freight area.
translation: Mosourika: 我早上去给贾斯汀送吃的，[p/]但货运区里哪儿都找不到他。

original: Mosourika: I went looking for him and spotted him on the catwalk.[p/] He looked like he was talking to someone.
translation: Mosourika: 我在找他的时候发现他在架空步道上，[p/]看起来在与某人说话。

original: Mosourika: That's when I saw a flash of magical light.[p/] Justin got blasted with a spell.
translation: Mosourika: 就在那时我看到一道魔法的闪光。[p/]贾斯汀被法术击中了。

original: Mosourika: It ripped apart the guardrail he was leaning on,[p/] and he fell into that vat of chemicals.
translation: Mosourika: 那法术撕掉了他靠着的护栏，[p/]然后他就掉进装有化学物质的那个容器里了。

original: Mosourika: I told one of the workers what happened.[p/] They tried to save him,[p/] but I guess it was too late.
translation: Mosourika: 我赶紧告诉了工人们，[p/]他们有试着救他出来，[p/]但实在来不及。

original: AriaC: I'm sure Mr. Cuthbert has told you this, witness,[p/] but we didn't find any traces of magic near the catwalk.
translation: AriaC: 证人， 我相信卡斯伯特先生也有告诉你，[p/]我们在步道周围没有发现任何法术痕迹。

original: Mosourika: I [i]know[/i] what I saw![p/] Someone definitely used magic on him.
translation: Mosourika: 我[i]知道[/i]自己看见了什么！[p/]一定有人对他施放了魔法。

original: She seemed very sure of that.[p/] She definitely wasn't lying.
translation: 她看起来十分确信，[p/]也肯定没有说谎。

original: But I still couldn't figure out why there weren't any traces of magic there.
translation: 但我还是想不明白为什么那里没有法术痕迹。

original: And there was something...[p/] [i]off[/i] about something she said,[p/] but I wasn't sure what.
translation: 而且还有一点……[p/]与她的表述[i]有出入[/i]，[p/]只是我还不确定具体是哪里。

original: Judge: Mr. Cuthbert,[p/] you may begin your cross-examination.
translation: Judge: 卡斯伯特先生，[p/]你可以开始交叉询问了。

original: Tyrion: Is he normally in the freight area when you make your deliveries?
translation: Tyrion: 你给他送早餐的时候，他通常都在货运区吗？

original: Mosourika: Yeah,[p/] but I guess he was doing something in the refinery.
translation: Mosourika: 没错，[p/]不过我想他那天可能是在精炼厂有事。

original: Tyrion: According to Dracogen,[p/] the victim only worked in the freight department.
translation: Tyrion: 根据德拉科根的说法，[p/]被害人只在货运区工作。

original: Tyrion: He definitely wasn't doing his job when he was in the refinery building.
translation: Tyrion: 因此他肯定不是出于工作才去精炼厂。

original: Tyrion: Do you have any idea why he was there?
translation: Tyrion: 你知道他为什么要去那里吗？

original: Mosourika: I-[p/][s/]I don't know.
translation: Mosourika: 我、[p/][s/]我不知道。

original: Mosourika: He didn't talk much about what he did,[p/] so I just assumed he was [i]supposed[/i] to be there.
translation: Mosourika: 他很少谈及自己的工作，[p/]所以我当时还以为他出现在那里是[i]应该[/i]的。

original: Tyrion: Did you see who he was talking to?
translation: Tyrion: 你有看到他在和谁交谈吗？

original: Mosourika: No, they were too high up,[p/] and the catwalk was blocking them.
translation: Mosourika: 没有，那里太高了，[p/]步道本身挡住了他们。

original: Mosourika: But he looked kind of angry.[p/] He also looked a little scared.
translation: Mosourika: 但他看起来有些生气，[p/]好像还有一点点害怕。

original: Tyrion: What?
translation: Tyrion: 是这样？

original: Tyrion: Do you think he was talking to the thief?!
translation: Tyrion: 那你认为他是在和那个窃贼交谈吗？！

original: Tyrion: He might have spotted them robbing my client's office.
translation: Tyrion: 他可能目击到窃贼在我委托人的办公室实施盗窃。

original: AriaC: That is purely speculation on your part, Mr. Cuthbert.
translation: AriaC: 这纯粹是你的个人猜测，卡斯伯特先生。

original: AriaC: At the very least,[p/] you'd need a witness to even entertain that theory.
translation: AriaC: 最起码，[p/]你需要目击证人来支持你的推论。

original: AriaC: And the current witness didn't see who the victim was talking to.
translation: AriaC: 而证人没有看到被害人在和谁交谈。

original: Judge: I'm compelled to agree, Ms. Steelwind.
translation: Judge: 我不得不赞同斯蒂尔文德女士。

original: Tyrion: Have you been able to figure out what kind of spell he got hit with?
translation: Tyrion: 你是否能分辨出他被什么法术击中了？

original: Mosourika: No...[p/] I've been thinking,[p/] but I've never seen a spell like that.
translation: Mosourika: 不能……[p/]我一直在想这件事，[p/]但我从没见过那样的法术。

original: Mosourika: My expertise is in [b]evocation[/b] magic,[p/] and that spell looked completely different from the spells I can cast.
translation: Mosourika: 我是[b]塑能术[/b]专精的，[p/]至少那种法术与我能施放的法术完全不一样。

original: AriaC: May I remind the court that the Inquisition found no traces of [b]evocation[/b] magic at the scene of Mr. Waye's death?
translation: AriaC: 我提醒出庭的各位，裁判所没有在维耶先生的死亡现场找到任何[b]塑能术[/b]的痕迹。

original: AriaC: An [b]evocation[b/] couldn't have ripped that guardrail apart.
translation: AriaC: 不可能是[b]塑能术[b/]把那个护栏破坏掉的。

original: Tyrion: Which can only a mean that a spell from a [i]different[/i] school of magic broke it.
translation: Tyrion: 也就意味着是[i]其他[/i]学派的法术造成了破坏。

original: AriaC: [i]Or[/i] the witness is simply grieving and doesn't remember what happened.
translation: AriaC: [i]或者[/i]意味着证人只是因为悲伤，记不清发生的事情。

original: AriaC: We have records that show that the guardrail was damaged and in need of repair.
translation: AriaC: 我们找到了一份记录，显示护栏在之前已经受损，需要维修。

original: Tyrion: My client's contractors assured him that the damage wasn't severe.
translation: Tyrion: 我的委托人得到供应商的承诺，那个损伤并不严重。

original: AriaC: Yet, the guardrail broke apart anyway.
translation: AriaC: 然而护栏最终还是断裂了。

original: AriaC: If you want to posit that a spell broke the guardrail,[p/] you'll have to prove it.
translation: AriaC: 如果你要主张是某种法术破坏了护栏，[p/]你就需要证明它。

original: Mosourika: It ripped apart the guardrail he was leaning on, and he fell into that vat of chemicals.
translation: Mosourika: 那法术撕掉了他靠着的护栏，然后他就掉进装有化学物质的那个容器里了。

original: Mosourika: A magical expanding prism ripped apart the guardrail he was leaning on, and he fell into that vat of chemicals.
translation: Mosourika: 一个棱柱状的魔力体迅速膨胀，撑裂了他倚靠的护栏，他才掉进了那个化学容器。

original: Mosourika: It ripped apart the guardrail he was leaning on.[p/] After that,[p/] he tried to catch himself on it and fell into that vat of chemicals.
translation: Mosourika: 它撕裂了他倚靠的护栏。[p/]然后，[p/]他试图抓住护栏，却掉进装有化学物质的那个容器里了。

original: Mosourika: It violently and instantly ripped apart the guardrail he was leaning on.[p/] He fell into that vat of chemicals.
translation: Mosourika: 它瞬间猛地一下撕裂了他倚靠的护栏。[p/]然后他就掉进装有化学物质的那个容器里了。

original: Tyrion: How did they try to save him?
translation: Tyrion: 他们如何救助贾斯汀的？

original: AriaC: The chemicals that the victim fell into were extremely volatile and corrosive.
translation: AriaC: 被害人坠入那个容器里的化学物质极度烈性且有腐蚀性。

original: AriaC: They poured a neutralizing solution into the vat to keep it from eating away at any implement they used to fish him out.
translation: AriaC: 他们向容器里倒入中和剂，防止它溶化用于打捞的工具。

original: AriaC: The downside of this process was that it took far too long before they could remove the victim.
translation: AriaC: 但这个中和反应耗时太长，来不及让他们救出被害人。

original: Mosourika: ...I thought those chemicals were just toxic.
translation: Mosourika: ……我以为那些化学物质只是有毒而已。

original: Mosourika: Are you telling me those dissolved him while he was still alive?
translation: Mosourika: 你是要告诉我他是活生生被溶解的吗？

original: I winced.[p/] I really wanted to avoid letting her find out about that.
translation: 我眉头紧皱。[p/]我真的很想避免她知道这一点。

original: Judge: ...Perhaps, we should move on.
translation: Judge: ……或许，我们该讨论下一个问题了。

original: Player: Overflow
Celeste: Her testimony is the best piece of evidence we have.
translation: Celeste: 她的证词对我们来说是最棒的证据。

original: Celeste: Is it really a good idea to find a contradiction in it?
translation: Celeste: 指出其中的破绽真的好吗？

original: Tyrion: Even [i]she[/i] doesn't know what happened,[p] and there's something nagging at me.
translation: Tyrion: 即使是[i]她[/i]也不知道到底发生了什么，[p]而我心里总有一点不安。

original: Tyrion: If I can find it,[p/] it will put us one step closer to the truth.
translation: Tyrion: 如果我们能找出那个问题，[p/]就能让我们更接近真相一步。

original: Celeste: If you say so...
translation: Celeste: 既然你这么说的话……

original: I would just need to look at the details she's testifying about and find out what doesn't fit.
translation: 我需要仔细查看她证词的细节，找出有问题的地方。

original: Player: Objection
Tyrion: Your Honor![p/][s/] It's clear that the witness's testimony is contradictory!
translation: Tyrion: 法官阁下！[p/][s/]证人的证言明显存在矛盾！

original: Tyrion: And this piece of evidence proves it!
translation: Tyrion: 而这件证据证明了这点！

original: Judge: I fail to see how that proves anything, Mr. Cuthbert...
translation: Judge: 卡斯伯特先生……我没看出来这两者有什么关系。

original: Tyrion: O-[p/][s/]Oh...[p/] I guess you're right.
translation: Tyrion: 噢、[p/][s/]哦……[p/]我想您说得对。

original: Tyrion: I know this must be difficult for you,[p/] but can you remember any more details about the moment Justin fell?
translation: Tyrion: 我明白这会让你很难过，[p/]你能否回忆起贾斯汀坠落时更多的细节？

original: Mosourika: I guess I'd need to know what details you want.
translation: Mosourika: 我想，你得告诉我你要知道的是哪方面的细节。

original: What did the spell look like?
translation: 那个法术看起来是什么样子？

original: Tyrion: What did this spell look like?[p/] Any detail might help us identify it.
translation: Tyrion: 那个法术看起来是什么样子？[p/]任何细节都可能让我们确定它。

original: Mosourika: I don't know.[p/] I only saw it for a second.
translation: Mosourika: 我也不太清楚。[p/]我只看到了一瞬间。

original: Mosourika: It didn't look like an explosion or anything.
translation: Mosourika: 它看起来不像是爆炸之类的效应。

original: AriaC: A prism?
translation: AriaC: 一个棱柱？

original: Mosourika: Yeah, it had really sharp edges like a cube.
translation: Mosourika: 对啊，它有尖锐的边角，向长方体那样。

original: Mosourika: But it was wider than it was tall.
translation: Mosourika: 但它的宽比高要长不少。

original: Tyrion: Witness, could you add this detail to your testimony?
translation: Tyrion: 证人，你能将这个细节添加到证词中吗？

original: Mosourika: Okay...
translation: Mosourika: 好……

original: How did the spell affect Justin?
translation: 法术对贾斯汀造成了什么影响？

original: Tyrion: What did the spell do to Justin?[p/] How did it affect him?
translation: Tyrion: 法术对贾斯汀造成了什么影响？[p/]产生了什么样的效应？

original: Mosourika: Um...[p/] After that flash of light,[p/] it looked like he lost his balance.
translation: Mosourika: 嗯……[p/]那道闪光发生后，[p/]看起来他失去了平衡。

original: Mosourika: He tried to catch himself on the guardrail,[p/] but it was already broken apart.
translation: Mosourika: 他想抓住护栏，[p/]但护栏已经断裂了。

original: Mosourika: He fell right into the vat of chemicals.
translation: Mosourika: 然后他就落入了那个化学容器里。

original: AriaC: ...
translation: AriaC: ……

original: How did the spell affect the guardrail?
translation: 法术对护栏造成了什么影响？

original: Tyrion: What did the spell do to the guardrail?
translation: 法术对护栏造成了什么影响？

original: Mosourika: Like I said,[p/] it ripped apart the guardrail.
translation: Mosourika: 我说过的，[p/]它撕开了护栏。

original: Tyrion: How did it do that, though?[p/] Did the spell slowly break it apart?
translation: Tyrion: 具体是什么情况呢？[p/]它是将护栏渐渐撕开的吗？

original: Mosourika: No,[p/] it happened instantly.[p/] It was kind of like what happens when you pull a rubber band so hard that it snaps.
translation: Mosourika: 不对，[p/]一下子就扯开了。[p/]有点像你用力拉橡皮筋拉断时的样子。

original: So the spell broke the guardrail instantly?[p/] It must have been some kind of instantaneous effect.
translation: 那个法术一瞬间就把护栏撕裂了？[p/]也就是说法术的效应是即时生效的。

original: But we already knew that there weren't any traces of [b]evocation[/b] on the catwalk.[p/] So what kind of spell did the mage use?
translation: 但我们都知道步道上没有[b]塑能术[/b]的痕迹。[p/]到底是用了什么法术呢？

original: Tyrion: Rika, there's something off about your testimony.
translation: Tyrion: 里卡，你的证词里有个小问题。

original: Mosourika: Really?[p/] It's the same as what I told you before.
translation: Mosourika: 是吗？[p/]这跟我之前告诉你的一模一样啊。

original: Tyrion: The mistake was mine.
translation: Tyrion: 是我的疏忽。

original: Tyrion: I was so focused on trying to figure out [i]what[/i] that spell was and who cast it.
translation: Tyrion: 我之前太拘泥于找出是[i]哪个[/i]法术，还有是谁施放。

original: Tyrion: I didn't even think about what it actually did to Justin.
translation: Tyrion: 我根本没考虑过它到底对贾斯汀做了什么。

original: Tyrion: This whole time,[p/] we assumed that the spell pushed him into the vat.
translation: Tyrion: 从一开始，[p/]我们就假定那个法术将他推进了容器。

original: Tyrion: But how could it have pushed him into the vat if he only fell [i]after[/i] the guardrails had been ripped apart?
translation: Tyrion: 但如果他是在护栏断裂[i]之后[/i]才掉下去的，怎么会是那个法术推他下去的呢？

original: Mosourika: What?
translation: Mosourika: 什么意思？

original: Tyrion: Rika, you said that Justin fell because he tried to catch himself on the guardrail.
translation: Tyrion: 里卡，你说了贾斯汀是因为想抓住护栏才掉下去的。

original: Tyrion: I thought the spell had pushed Justin while simultaneously ripping the guardrails apart.
translation: Tyrion: 我之前以为是那个法术在推动贾斯汀的同时压坏了护栏。

original: Tyrion: But it didn't push Justin at all!
translation: Tyrion: 但它根本就没对贾斯汀有什么影响！

original: Mosourika: I guess that makes sense,[p/] but does that really change anything?
translation: Mosourika: 这也说得通，[p/]但有什么区别呢？

original: Tyrion: It does![p/][s/] Because it raises another question:
translation: Tyrion: 有啊！[p/][s/]这就造成另一个问题：

original: Tyrion: If the spell produced enough force to rip the guardrails apart,[p/] why didn't it appear to affect Justin at all?
translation: Tyrion: 如果这个法术强力到撕裂护栏，[p/]那为什么对贾斯汀没造成任何影响？

original: AriaC: It didn't appear to affect the victim because there [i]was[/i] no spell.
translation: AriaC: 没有造成影响，那是[i]因为[/i]根本没有什么法术。

original: AriaC: Justin Waye broke the guardrail because it was faulty.
translation: AriaC: 贾斯汀·维耶只是因为护栏早已受损才破坏了它。

original: Mosourika: No![p/][s/] I saw it!
translation: Mosourika: 不对！[p/][s/]我都看到了！

original: Mosourika: He only fell in because the guardrail was already destroyed!
translation: Mosourika: 他是因为那个护栏当时先被外力破坏，才掉下去的！

original: AriaC: Your Honor,[p/][s/] the defense brought this witness to testify,[p/] only to contradict it during their own cross-examination.
translation: AriaC: 法官阁下，[p/][s/]辩方申请这位证人出席作证，[p/]结果只在他自己的询问中找出了矛盾。

original: AriaC: They [i]have[/i] no case.
translation: AriaC: 他们[i]没有[/i]任何推翻立证的结论。

original: Tyrion: My witness is certain that she saw a spell destroy the guardrail!
translation: Tyrion: 我的证人很确信有看到某个法术破坏了护栏！

original: AriaC: Your witness is a business associate of the defendant![p/][s/] She clearly has every reason to lie in her testimony!
translation: AriaC: 你的证人与被告人有商业往来！[p/][s/]她显然有在证言里说谎的动机！

original: Tyrion: So are you baselessly accusing my witness of perjury, Steelwind?!
translation: Tyrion: 那你是要毫无根据地指控我的证人伪证吗，斯蒂尔文德？！

original: AriaC: I am.[p/] It's not as if this is her first time breaking the law.
translation: AriaC: 没错。[p/]而且她也不是第一次违反法律了。

original: Mosourika: U-[p/][s/]Uh...
translation: Mosourika: 呃、[p/][s/]呃……

original: AriaC: Ms. Tudor,[p/] I understand that you run a café in the food district.
translation: AriaC: 都铎女士。[p/]我知道你在餐饮区有运营一家咖啡店。

original: AriaC: This café would not exist without the generous patronage of the defendant.
translation: AriaC: 如果没有被告慷慨的赞助，这家店根本无法启动。

original: Mosourika: Yeah,[p/] but—
translation: Mosourika: 没错，[p/]可是——

original: AriaC: You must feel quite indebted to him.[p/] After all,[p/] he saved you from the kind of life you lived before.
translation: AriaC: 你一定认为自己亏欠他很多。[p/]毕竟，[p/]是他将你从之前的那种生活中拯救出来的。

original: Tyrion: ...Rika, what is she talking about?
translation: Tyrion: ……里卡，她在说什么？

original: AriaC: You truly didn't know, Mr. Cuthbert?
translation: AriaC: 你真的不知道吗，卡斯伯特先生？

original: AriaC: Before your witness ran her café,[p/] she had another vocation.
translation: AriaC: 在你的证人经营咖啡馆之前，[p/]她有其他的谋生方式。

original: AriaC: She survived by robbing the shipments coming into Aurinax Harbor.
translation: AriaC: 她依靠盗窃来到欧奥耐克斯港口的那些货船为生。

original: Tyrion: Rika...[p/] T-[p/][s/]That's not true, is it?
translation: Tyrion: 里卡……[p/]这、[p/][s/]这不是真的吧？

original: Mosourika: ...So many things changed after you left, Tyrion.
translation: Mosourika: ……你离开后很多事情都发生了变化，提利昂。

original: AriaC: Several years ago,[p/] Ms. Tudor was a part of a band of thieves who would frequently rob shipments addressed to Von Sanctus Industries.
translation: AriaC: 几年以前，[p/]都铎女士曾是某个盗贼团的一员，他们经常劫掠冯·桑克图斯名下的货物。

original: AriaC: Her group was eventually arrested,[p/] and she only avoided a sentence to the dungeons by taking a plea deal.
translation: AriaC: 他们的团伙最终落网了，[p/]而她接受了认罪协议，从而避免入狱。

original: Celeste: Oh my god...
translation: Celeste: 天哪……

original: Did she seriously do all of that in the years I was gone?
translation: 她真的在我离开的这些年犯下这些罪行？

original: I knew her.[p/] I grew up with her.[p/] Had things really changed that much?
translation: 我很了解她。[p/]我与她一同长大。[p/]真的会发生这么大的变化吗？

original: Tyrion: ...Even so,[p/] the defense still maintains trust in the witness's testimony.
translation: Tyrion: ……即便如此，[p/]辩方依然坚持相信证人的证词。

original: Tyrion: I believe the Mistweaving Phantom struck the refinery that morning.[p/] They attacked Justin Waye with magic.
translation: Tyrion: 我认为“织雾魅影”在那个早上闯入精炼厂，[p/]并且用法术攻击了贾斯汀·维耶。

original: Mosourika: That's—!
translation: Mosourika: 那是——！

original: AriaC: Is that so?[p/] And how do you know that the [i]current witness[/i] isn't this Phantom?
translation: AriaC: 真的吗？[p/]你怎么就知道[i]这位证人[/i]不是你说的这个“魅影”呢？

original: Mosourika: What?!
translation: Mosourika: 什么？！

original: AriaC: She was coincidentally present when the robbery occurred,[p/] [i]and[/i] she's a registered mage.
translation: AriaC: 她正巧在盗窃发生时在场，[p/][i]并且[/i]是一名注册在案的法师。

original: AriaC: Not to mention that her little gang all those years ago used that same name.
translation: AriaC: 更不用提她之前所在的团伙几年前正是使用的这个名号。

original: Tyrion: ...What?!
translation: Tyrion: ……怎么会这样？！

original: ...I'd always thought that nickname sounded too much like something she'd come up with.
translation: ……我就一直觉得那个诨号听起来太像她会想出来的东西了。

original: Was she seriously involved with them?!
translation: 她真的与此有牵连吗？！

original: AriaC: I thought you never backed down from a foe, Mr. Cuthbert.
translation: AriaC: 卡斯伯特先生，我还以为你从不在敌人面前退缩呢。

original: AriaC: You could make a great case for your client by indicting Ms. Tudor in the robberies and subsequently the victim's death.
translation: AriaC: 你可以通过指控都铎女士实施盗窃，并致使受害人死亡来让你的委托人顺利脱罪啊。

original: AriaC: What will you do?
translation: AriaC: 你要怎么做呢？

original: No...[p/] There could be any number of explanations for what was happening.
translation: 不对……[p/]案发情况肯定有好几个合理的解释。

original: Urban myths tended to be distorted by the public.
translation: 都市传说往往被公众误解。

original: It's possible people have just been calling this thief the Mistweaving Phantom because of the similarities between the robberies.
translation: 很有可能是人们因为这次的盗贼与他们之前情况类似，就将这次的也称作“织雾魅影”。

original: Tyrion: The defense has no further questions for the witness.[p/] She is dismissed.
translation: Tyrion: 辩方没有更多要问证人的问题了。[p/]她可以退庭了。

original: AriaC: Hmph...[p/] I'd thought you were more objective than that.
translation: AriaC: 嗯……[p/]我以为你会提出更强烈的异议呢。

original: Tyrion: I don't care what she's done in the past.
translation: Tyrion: 我不在乎她过去做了什么。

original: Tyrion: I know my friend,[p/] and I know she's not a murderer.
translation: Tyrion: 我很了解自己的友人，[p/]而且我知道她不会是凶手。

original: AriaC: Clearly.[p/] What happened that morning was the result of simple negligence.
translation: AriaC: 当然。[p/]那天早上发生的只是一起事故而已。

original: AriaC: Your Honor.[p/] For our next witness,[p/] the prosecution would like to call Orym White to the stand.
translation: AriaC: 法官阁下。[p/]检方申请传唤奥蒙·怀特作为下一位证人。

original: Judge: Very well.[p/] Bailiff,[p/] please call the Inquisition Commander to the stand.
translation: Judge: 很好。[p/]法警，[p/]请护送裁判所指挥官上证人席。

original: AriaC: Commander, as I'm sure you've heard,[p/] Mr. Cuthbert is trying to connect the accident to the robberies of the Mistweaving Phantom.
translation: AriaC: 指挥官，你肯定也听到了，[p/]卡斯伯特先生试图将这起事故与“织雾魅影”的盗窃行为联系起来。

original: AriaC: Please testify about the City Watch's findings regarding the robberies.
translation: AriaC: 请就城市安保就这些抢劫盗窃案件的调查结果进行作证。

original: Orym: Sure...
translation: Orym: 当然了……

original: Orym: So this Phantom's been hitting a lot of places—[p/]mostly shipments coming into the harbor.
translation: Orym: 结论是，这个所谓的“魅影”在许多地方都有作案——[p/]大多数是来到港口的货船。

original: Orym: Doesn't matter what kind of lock or security the place has,[p/] he can get in no problem.
translation: Orym: 不论被抢劫的地方使用了什么样的锁或者安保设施，[p/]他都能毫无阻碍地进入。

original: Orym: He's made off with a bunch of loot,[p/] and the City Watch has been scratching their heads looking for him.
translation: Orym: 他带着大量的赃物逃之夭夭，[p/]城市安保这边使尽浑身解数也没抓到他。

original: Orym: I know you think the guy hit the refinery too,[p/] but it doesn't match with what we know about him.
translation: Orym: 我知道你们认为这家伙也盯上了精炼厂，[p/]但这与我们对他的了解是不相符的。

original: Orym: The guy only stole some documents and left the defendant's gold.[p/] This guy never does that.
translation: Orym: 在精炼厂的这家伙只偷窃文档，但放着被告的钱一动不动。[p/]而那个“魅影”从不这么做。

original: The connection between the Mistweaving Phantom and Justin's death was already difficult to prove.
translation: “织雾魅影”与贾斯汀之死的联系已经很难证明了。

original: There was no evidence,[p/] but they [i]had[/i] to be related somehow.[p/] It would be too much of a coincidence otherwise.
translation: 并没有任何证据，[p/]但两者[i]必定[/i]以某种方式关联。[p/]否则巧合就太多了。

original: How could I prove that?
translation: 我能怎么证明呢？

original: JUDGE: Mr. Cuthbert.[p/] You may begin your cross-examination.
translation: Judge: 卡斯伯特先生，[p/]你可以开始交叉询问了。

original: Tyrion: What is usually stolen?
translation: Tyrion: 通常哪些东西被偷走？

original: Orym: All kinds of things:[p/] goods,[p/] appliances,[p/] weapons,[p/] even some artificery devices.
translation: Orym: 什么都有：[p/]货物、[p/]设备、[p/]武器，[p/]甚至还有一些奥术能源装置。

original: Orym: Not to mention there's that—
translation: Orym: 更不要提还有——

original: AriaC: To amend the commander's testimony,[p/] there was a sensitive shipment stolen from a kingdom ship.
translation: AriaC: 修正一下指挥官的证词，[p/]王家的属船也有一些敏感的货物失窃。

original: Judge: Is there any reason why you're being so vague, Ms. Steelwind?
translation: Judge: 你的表述如此模糊，有特别的理由吗，斯蒂尔文德女士？

original: AriaC: The gag order has come from the Grand General himself.[p/] The item in question is not relevant to this case.
translation: AriaC: 禁言令是由大将军本人亲自下达的。[p/]您问及的货物内容与本次案件没有关系。

original: Judge: I-[p/][s/]I see.
translation: Judge: 我、[p/][s/]我明白了。

original: Tyrion: Why are you referring to the Phantom as a "he"?[p/] I thought the City Watch didn't know anything about them.
translation: Tyrion: 你为何使用“他”代指“魅影”？[p/]我还以为城市安保对他们一无所知呢。

original: Orym: ...Are you seriously nitpicking me for that?
translation: Orym: ……你真的就为这个吹毛求疵？

original: Tyrion: I just think it would be in the court's interest not to have assumptions taken as fact.
translation: Tyrion: 我只是认为，避免将推测认定为事实，是符合法庭的利益的。

original: Orym: Scaled Lord,[p/] you kids these days and your pronouns.
translation: Orym: 鳞甲领主啊，[p/]你们这些小子如今对一个代词这么在乎。

original: Orym: Look...[p/] Chances are,[p/] that this guy's a guy.[p/] The stats back me up on that.
translation: Orym: 行吧……[p/]那家伙很有可能是男的。[p/]统计数据可以支持我的观点。

original: Celeste: Oh, yeah?[p/][s/] How many of your [i]men[/i] did it take to arrest me, Orym?
translation: Celeste: 哦，是这样吗？[p/][s/]逮捕我的时候你们动用了多少[i]男人[/i]才成功啊，奥蒙？

original: AriaC: ...Celeste,[p/] while I appreciate your sentiment,[p/] I wouldn't brag about that here.
translation: AriaC: ……塞拉斯特啊，[p/]虽然我欣赏你的观点，[p/]但如果是我就不会在这里吹嘘这个。

original: Orym: Fine![p/][s/] If it will get all of you off my back,[p/] I'll change my damned testimony!
translation: Orym: 够了！[p/][s/]如果这能让你们不再烦我，[p/]我就修正我的证词！

original: Orym: Doesn't matter what kind of lock or security the place has,[p/] [i]they[/i] can get in no problem.
translation: Orym: 不论被抢劫的地方使用了什么样的锁或者安保设施，[p/][i]他或她[/i]都能毫无阻碍地进入。

original: Celeste: See,[p/] was that so hard?
translation: Celeste: 是吧，[p/]这有什么难的？

original: Orym: Oh, bite me, mage girl.
translation: Orym: 哦，有种咬我啊，你这个法师女孩。

original: Tyrion: Anyways,[p/] how sophisticated were the locks and security on the places that were broken into?
translation: Tyrion: 不谈这个了，[p/]那些被闯入的场所，门锁和安保设施有多精密呢？

original: Orym: The places owned by the smaller merchants only had mundane locks.
translation: Orym: 小商贩用的都是普通的锁。

original: Orym: Those are hard to pick,[p/] but not impossible for someone who knows what they're doing.
translation: Orym: 那些锁要撬开是有难度的，[p/]但对于熟练的盗贼来说也并非不可能。

original: Orym: But they've also been hitting the ships owned by nobles—[p/]not to mention that other ship I'm not allowed to discuss.
translation: Orym: 但那家伙还能在贵族们拥有的船上作案——[p/]更不用说还有不准我提到的那艘船。

original: Orym: They've got magical locks and security.[p/] Picking those would be like performing surgery.
translation: Orym: 那些船上的锁和安保系统是有魔法加持的。[p/]想撬开跟做手术差不多。

original: Orym: That's not even mentioning all the armed guards they probably had to get past.
translation: Orym: 更不用提还有武装的守卫会在巡逻时随时经过。

original: Orym: Whoever they are,[p/] they're some kind of genius.
translation: Orym: 不论到底是谁做的，[p/]那家伙真可以说是个天才。

original: Orym: He's made off with a bunch of loot, and the City Watch has been scratching their heads looking for him.
translation: Orym: 他带着大量的赃物逃之夭夭，城市安保这边使尽浑身解数也没抓到他。

original: Orym: They made off with a bunch of loot, and the City Watch has been scratching their heads looking for them.
translation: Orym: 那个人带着大量的赃物逃之夭夭，[p/]城市安保这边使尽浑身解数也没抓到。

original: Orym: I know you think the... person hit the refinery too,[p/] but it doesn't match with what we know about them.
translation: Orym: 我知道你们认为他……那个家伙也盯上了精炼厂，[p/]但这与我们对这个人的了解是不相符的。

original: Orym: The thief who hit the refinery only stole some documents and left the defendant's gold.[p/] This guy never does that.
translation: Orym: 在精炼厂的这家伙只偷窃文档，但放着被告的钱一动不动。[p/]而那个“魅影”从不这么做。

original: Orym: The thief who hit the refinery only stole some documents and left the defendant's gold.[p/] This... person never does that.
translation: Orym: 在精炼厂的这家伙只偷窃文档，但放着被告的钱一动不动。[p/]而那个“魅影”从不这么做。

original: Tyrion: His argument is a little weak.[p/] I doubt the theft at the refinery was just a coincidence.
translation: Tyrion: 他的主张不够有力，[p/]我不太认为精炼厂发生的盗窃只是巧合。

original: Celeste: But he has a point.[p/] The serial robber never leaves any evidence.
translation: Celeste: 但他说的也不无道理。[p/]那个连环盗窃的犯人从不遗留证据。

original: Celeste: There's nothing to tie him to theft that morning.
translation: Celeste: 没有可以将“魅影”与那天的窃贼相关联的证据。

original: Tyrion: Are they really having that much trouble identifying the thief?
translation: Tyrion: 他们真的那么难以确定窃贼的身份吗？

original: Orym: They're good at covering their tracks.[p/] They don't leave any evidence,[p/] and they never trip any alarms.
translation: Orym: 那个盗贼非常善于掩盖踪迹。[p/]从不留下证据，[p/]也从不触发警报。

original: Orym: Half the time,[p/] it's like they're disappearing into thin air.
translation: Orym: 很多时候，[p/]就好像那个人是凭空消失的。

original: Orym: He's good at covering his tracks.[p/] He doesn't leave any evidence,[p/] and he never trips any alarms.
translation: Orym: 他非常善于掩盖踪迹。[p/]从不留下证据，[p/]也从不触发警报。

original: Orym: Half the time,[p/] it's like he's disappearing into thin air.
translation: Orym: 很多时候，[p/]就好像他是凭空消失的。

original: Tyrion: ...Could the Phantom be a mage proficient in [b]conjuration[/b] magic?
translation: Tyrion: ……那个“魅影”是否可能是相当擅长[b]召唤术[/b]的法师呢？

original: Tyrion: They could be teleporting to bypass any security altogether.
translation: Tyrion: 这样的话就很可能是通过传送越过安保设施的。

original: Orym: ...Maybe,[p/] but most security systems are designed to detect and block teleportation inside.
translation: Orym: ……是有可能，[p/]但绝大部分的安保设施都有在内侧探测并阻止传送法术的功能。

original: Orym: You can't teleport inside unless you already have some kind of magical beacon already in the place.
translation: Orym: 除非你事先在里面设置了魔法信标，你是无法传送进去的。

original: Orym: Not to mention that the locks leading inside were obviously picked and unlocked.
translation: Orym: 更不要提门锁都明显是被撬开过的。

original: Orym: If anything,[p/] these systems don't prevent teleportation [i]out[/i] of its field.
translation: Orym: 一定要说有什么可能的话，[p/]这类装置通常不阻止从里面传送[i]出去[/i]。

original: Orym: So maybe they're using [b]conjuration[/b] magic to get out.
translation: Orym: 所以可能确实是用[b]召唤术[/b]离开的。

original: Tyrion: But I doubt a place like the Arcane Refinery would have a system as sophisticated as that.
translation: Tyrion: 但我不认为像精炼厂这种地方会有如此精密的安保系统。

original: Tyrion: How so?
translation: Tyrion: 为什么呢？

original: Orym: The thief has been robbing a lot of merchant ships.[p/] Some of them even belong to Von Sanctus Industries.
translation: Orym: “魅影”已经抢劫了许多商船，[p/]有些甚至是冯·桑克图斯实业所属的。

original: Orym: Places like the Arcane Refinery probably have [i]some[/i] gold.[p/] The owner even mentioned he had some coins in the safe that got broken into.
translation: Orym: 像精炼厂这种地方很可能是有[i]一点[/i]金钱的。[p/]雇主本人也提到过他被撬开的保险箱里有一些金币。

original: Orym: But all that is below this Phantom's paygrade.
translation: Orym: 但对“魅影”来说价值不太够。

original: Orym: Some of the things the Phantom stole were worth ten times the amount of gold in that safe.
translation: Orym: “魅影”偷走的东西价值肯定远胜于保险箱里的金币。

original: Orym: That's not even mentioning the fact that—
translation: Orym: 更不用提——

original: Tyrion: Sometimes information can be more valuable than gold, Commander.
translation: Tyrion: 指挥官，有时候信息本身就比黄金更有价值。

original: Orym: Maybe,[p/] but I don't think our guy would risk so much for a couple of business documents.
translation: Orym: 是有可能，[p/]但我觉得没人会为了几份商业档案就冒这么大的险。

original: Orym: Your client might have some enemies,[p/] but the Phantom's good enough to hit the merchant ships guarded by armed soldiers.
translation: Orym: 你的委托人可能有敌人，[p/]但“魅影”可是能抢劫全副武装的士兵把守的货船。

original: Orym: Every time they hit a place,[p/] they run the risk of getting caught.
translation: Orym: 毕竟那家伙每次作案，[p/]同样都要承受遭到逮捕的风险。

original: Orym: The theft happened this morning when the refinery was already open.[p/] Employees were already on the ground, too.
translation: Orym: 今早盗窃案发生的时候，精炼厂已经开工了。[p/]工人们已都在一楼就位。

original: Orym: Anyone could have spotted him.[p/] It just doesn't make sense for the phantom to take a risk like that for so little gain.
translation: Orym: 任何人都可能看到她。[p/]“魅影”没道理冒这么大风险只为一点点的收益。

original: Tyrion: Commander,[p/] it's clear you think the Phantom wouldn't have gone to all that trouble to steal a few business records.
translation: Tyrion: 指挥官，[p/]显然你的观点是“魅影”不会为了几份商业文档给自己惹这么多麻烦。

original: Orym: Yeah,[p/] it doesn't make any sense.
translation: Orym: 没错，[p/]根本说不通。

original: Orym: This person has enough skills to break into heavily guarded buildings.
translation: Orym: 这个人有足够闯入重兵把守之地的能力。

original: Orym: Why would they bother with some business records?
translation: Orym: 干嘛非得只是要几份商业文件？

original: Orym: This guy has enough skills to break into heavily guarded buildings.
translation: Orym: 他有足够闯入重兵把守之地的能力。

original: Orym: Why would he bother with some business records?
translation: Orym: 他干嘛非得只是要几份商业文件？

original: Tyrion: That's where you're wrong, Orym.
translation: Tyrion: 这就是你犯错的地方了，奥蒙。

original: Orym: ...Kid,[p/] why do you always have to do this to me?
translation: Orym: ……小子，[p/]你干嘛老对我这么说？

original: Tyrion: There's another series of thefts where nothing inherently valuable was taken.
translation: Tyrion: 还有一系列盗窃案，案中并未窃取任何具有直接价值的东西。

original: Tyrion: The Mistweaving Phantom also broke into many of the offices owned by the workers' unions.
translation: Tyrion: “织雾魅影”同样也闯入了许多工会的办公室。

original: AriaC: Again,[p/] you're assuming that the Phantom broke into said offices.
translation: AriaC: 又来了，[p/]“魅影”有闯入这些办公室只是你的推测。

original: AriaC: It's entirely plausible that a refinery employee who was a part of the union stole from both of these offices.
translation: AriaC: 发生在工会和德拉科根的办公室的盗窃案实际上都是由一名属于工会成员的精炼厂工人所为，这种说法完全是合理的。

original: Tyrion: A union member may have been able to access my client's office,[p/] but they wouldn't have such an easy time entering the union offices.
translation: Tyrion: 工会成员或许是有办法进入我委托人的办公室，[p/]弹药进入工会的办公室就没那么简单了。

original: Tyrion: Many of the unions have anticipated sabotage and have invested in state-of-the-art security systems.
translation: Tyrion: 许多工会事先预料到有破坏活动，都投资了先进的安保装置。

original: Tyrion: They've taken precautions to make sure that only high-ranking officials have access to these documents.
translation: Tyrion: 而且也采取了预防制度，确保只有高位成员有权接触这些文件。

original: Tyrion: There's only one person with the skills to break into these locations.
translation: Tyrion: 只有一个人有能力进入这些地方。

original: Tyrion: And that's the [i]same[/i] thief who's been robbing those ships in the Aurinax Harbor!
translation: Tyrion: 而那人与抢劫了欧奥耐克斯港内货船的窃贼就是[i]同一人[/i]！

original: AriaC: And what possible motive would the Phantom have to steal these documents?
translation: AriaC: 那“魅影”又有什么理由非得去偷窃这些文件呢？

original: Tyrion: That's simple![p/][s/] They wanted detailed information on my client's company and the workers' unions!
translation: Tyrion: 很简单！[p/][s/]他们需要我委托人的公司与工会的详细情报！

original: AriaC: In all of your wild speculation,[p/] I think you haven't considered one possibility, Mr. Cuthbert.
translation: AriaC: 我认为你并没有把一种可能性包括在在你的胡猜乱测中，卡斯伯特先生。

original: Tyrion: ...And what's that?
translation: Tyrion: ……你说的是什么？

original: AriaC: That the unions themselves were the ones who robbed your client.
translation: AriaC: 工会本身就是偷窃你的委托人的元凶。

original: AriaC: You said it yourself:[p/] only high-ranking executives had access to the union documents that went missing.
translation: AriaC: 正如你已经说过的，[p/]只有高位成员有权接触工会失窃的文件。

original: AriaC: And none of those executives knew any spells that could rip apart the guardrail.[p/] None of them were even mages.
translation: AriaC: 而这些人中没有一个知晓撕裂那些护栏的法术。[p/]他们之中甚至一个法师都没有。

original: Tyrion: That's ridiculous.[p/] Why would the workers' unions rob themselves?
translation: Tyrion: 这太荒谬了。[p/]工会成员为什么要偷窃自己的东西？

original: AriaC: Simple,[p/] they wanted to cover their tracks and play the victim when [i]they[/i] were the true culprits.
translation: AriaC: 很简单，[p/]他们想掩盖自己的罪行，明明身为元凶却要扮演受害者。

original: AriaC: After all,[p/] we have several reports confirming hostility between your client and the workers' unions.
translation: AriaC: 毕竟，[p/]我们已经收到了多分报告，证实你的委托人与工会间存在敌意。

original: Tyrion: I think you'll find that those reports are exagerrated,[p/] if not entirely false.
translation: Tyrion: 我想你会发现那些报告即使不是完全错误，[p/]至少也是夸大其词。

original: Tyrion: My client and Noah Morrison can testify to that fact.
translation: Tyrion: 我的委托人与诺亚·莫里森都能证实这一点。

original: AriaC: They obviously would.[p/] An employee just died due to your client's negligence.
translation: AriaC: 他们当然会这么做。[p/]一个雇员因为你的委托人的过失死亡。

original: AriaC: Mr. Dracogen has every reason to feign amicability with the unions.[p/] It would avoid further outrage.
translation: AriaC: 德拉科根先生完全有理由与工会假装和睦，[p/]避免产生进一步的暴乱。

original: AriaC: And Noah Morrison has no choice but to do the same—[p/]lest he be incriminated in the thefts himself.
translation: AriaC: 而诺亚·莫里森别无选择，只能保持配合——[p/]除非他想曝光自己的罪行。

original: Tyrion: And what proof do you have that they aren't telling the truth?
translation: Tyrion: 那你又有什么证据证明他们说谎呢？

original: AriaC: As I've said,[p/] I have several reports from many different individuals.
translation: AriaC: 我已经说过了，[p/]我收到了来自几个线人的系列报告。

original: AriaC: They came from multiple, diverse sources,[p/] and they all paint a very vivid picture of aggression between your client and the unions.
translation: AriaC: 报告来自多个不同领域的信源，[p/]而它们都生动描绘了你的委托人与工会之间激烈冲突的局面。

original: AriaC: Furthermore,[p/] they are far less biased than Stefanic Dracogen or Noah Morrison.
translation: AriaC: 更进一步地说，[p/]信源的偏向性远低于斯蒂芬尼克·德拉科根和诺亚·莫里森这两个人。

original: She had a point,[p/] and I couldn't claim the reports were false without any proof.
translation: 她的逻辑是通顺的，[p/]我也不能在没有证据的情况下主张报告结论有误。

original: Tyrion: If you want to implicate Mr. Morrison,[p/] I think it's only fair that he be allowed to defend himself.
translation: Tyrion: 如果你认为莫里森先生牵涉其中，[p/]那我认为只有允许他为自己辩解以示公平。

original: AriaC: Fine.[p/] Let him testify.
translation: AriaC: 没问题，[p/]让他作证吧。

original: AriaC: But it will be his word against dozens.
translation: AriaC: 但那也只是他的单方面说辞，而与他相对的可是数十人的报告。

original: Judge: It appears that both counsels are in agreement.
translation: Judge: 看起来双方达成了一致。

original: Judge: Bailiff,[p/] please escort Mr. Morrison to the stand.
translation: Judge: 法警，[p/]请护送莫里森先生上证人席。

original: AriaC: Witness,[p/] please state your name and occupation for the court.
translation: AriaC: 证人，[p/]请向法庭告知你的姓名与职业。

original: Noah: Aye...[p/] My name's Noah Morrison.[p/] I'm the harbourmaster of Aurinax Harbor and Union Chief of the Aurinax Industrial Union.
translation: Noah: 哎、好……[p/]我的名字是诺亚·莫里森。[p/]我是欧奥耐克斯港的管理人，也是欧奥耐克斯工会的主席。

original: Tyrion: Thank you for taking the stand today, Mr. Morrison.
translation: Tyrion: 感谢你今天出庭作证，莫里森先生。

original: Tyrion: As you know,[p/] there was a theft that occurred at the refinery this morning.
translation: Tyrion: 如你所知，[p/]今早在精炼厂发生了一起盗窃案。

original: Tyrion: The prosecution is trying to imply that you may have been involved.
translation: Tyrion: 而检方试图宣称你参与其中。

original: Noah: Yeah...[p/] I heard.
translation: Noah: 是啊……[p/]我听说了。

original: Tyrion: Could you please testify about the thefts that occurred at the union offices?
translation: Tyrion: 能否请你就在工会办公室发生的几起盗窃案进行作证？

original: Tyrion: It's clear you also believe they're related to the theft at the refinery.
translation: Tyrion: 显然你也相信这些案件与精炼厂内发生的盗窃案有联系。

original: Tyrion: Any details that might help us prove that would help a lot.
translation: Tyrion: 任何能帮助我们证明此事的细节都将造成相当大的帮助。

original: Noah: Alright...
translation: Noah: 没问题……

original: Noah: I don't know where all these reports of "hostile tensions" came from,[p/] but everything's great between Dracogen and us.
translation: Noah: 我是不知道那些“冲突”的报告是从何而来，[p/]但德拉科根与我之间一直相处良好。

original: Noah: Whoever this Phantom is,[p/] they've got nothing to do with that nonsense.[p/] They've been hitting everyone.
translation: Noah: 无论那个“魅影”是什么人，[p/]他都与那些无稽之谈无关。[p/]谁都有可能成为他的目标。

original: Noah: It's not just our offices and the ships.[p/] They broke into some of the union members' homes, too.
translation: Noah: 不只是我们的办公室和货船。[p/]那家伙还闯进了一些工会成员的家里。

original: Noah: Those poor blokes had everything stolen from them.[p/] They even had to skip town because of it.
translation: Noah: 那些可怜的兄弟被那家伙洗劫一空。[p/]他们甚至不得不因此逃离了这座城镇。

original: Noah: They were good people too—[p/]solid,[p/] law-abiding citizens.
translation: Noah: 他们明明都是好人——[p/]都是可靠又守法的市民。

original: Tyrion: As you can see,[p/] Mr. Morrison had very little motive to break into my client's office.
translation: Tyrion: 如你所见，[p/]莫里森先生几乎没有闯入我委托人的办公室的动机。

original: Tyrion: The serial thief, meanwhile,[p/] has been robbing people all over the city.
translation: Tyrion: 与此同时，这个连续盗窃犯，[p/]已经洗劫了整座城市的居民。

original: AriaC: ...That's assuming the witness's testimony is true.
translation: AriaC: ……在假定证人发言都是真话的前提下。

original: Noah: Take a look at the crime reports!
translation: Noah: 看看之前的犯罪记录吧！

original: Noah: You'll see that a lot of the victims were members of the union!
translation: Noah: 你就会发现大多数的受害者都是工会成员！

original: AriaC: I unfortunately don't have access to the reports for those.
translation: AriaC: 不幸的是，我并没有权限接触那些记录。

original: Tyrion: ...What are you talking about?[p/] You're a prosecutor.
translation: Tyrion: ……说什么呢？[p/]你可是检察官啊。

original: Tyrion: Why wouldn't you have access to those reports?
translation: Tyrion: 你为什么无权阅读那些记录？

original: AriaC: ...I'm not certain.
translation: AriaC: ……我并不确定。

original: AriaC: I imagine it's related to the theft that occurred on the imperial ship this morning.
translation: AriaC: 我想应该是因为这些案件与今早王家船只失窃一事有关联。

original: That was strange...[p/] Who would have the authority to prevent a Steelwind from accessing those records?
translation: 这就奇怪了……[p/]谁还能有权力阻止斯蒂尔文德接触那些记录呢？

original: AriaC: In any case,[p/] Aurinax is a large city with an average rate of crime.
translation: AriaC: 无论如何，[p/]欧奥耐克斯是一座犯罪率处于平均水平的巨大都市。

original: AriaC: There's nothing to prove that any of [i]those[/i] thefts are related to this either.
translation: AriaC: 没有什么东西能证明[i]那些[/i]盗窃案与现在这起有关联。

original: AriaC: There isn't even anything that proves these thefts are related to [i]each other[/i].
translation: AriaC: 也没有证据证明这些案件里的窃贼间[i]彼此[/i]有关联。

original: We would see about that...
translation: 那我们就拭目以待好了……

original: AriaC: ...So you say.
translation: AriaC: ……只是你这么说而已。

original: Noah: Look, wherever you're getting these reports,[p/] they're completely wrong!
translation: Noah: 听着，不论你从哪里得到的这些报告，[p/]它们都是完全错误的！

original: AriaC: Witness,[p/] these reports came from multiple sources throughout the course of several months.
translation: AriaC: 证人，[p/]这些报告来自多个信源，并且经过了数月的调查与核实。

original: AriaC: For obvious reasons,[p/] the individuals who made them will remain anonymous.
translation: AriaC: 因为显而易见的原因，[p/]撰写这些报告的人都会保持匿名。

original: AriaC: But said reports came from multiple members of the commonfolk,[p/] aristocracy,[p/] [i]and[/i] law enforcement.
translation: AriaC: 但可以确认的是，这些报告的来源包括数位平民、[p/]贵族，[p/][i]还有[/i]执法人员。

original: AriaC: We also have several crime reports of violent encounters between your union members and the defendant's employees.
translation: AriaC: 我们还有一系列关于你的工会成员与被告的雇员产生暴力冲突的犯罪记录。

original: Noah: What?!
translation: Noah: 啥？！

original: What was going on here?!
translation: 这是怎么回事？！

original: Mr. Morrison seemed just as confused as I was.
translation: 莫里森先生看起来和我一样困惑。

original: Were these reports falsified,[p/] or were these encounters happening without his knowledge?
translation: 究竟是报告本身有问题，[p/]还是这些冲突没有让他知晓？

original: AriaC: ...Assuming that these aren't just a string of unrelated thefts.
translation: AriaC: 如果假设这一系列盗窃案并非没有关联……

original: Noah: I'll admit that Aurinax is a large city.[p/] Break-ins weren't exactly non-existent before this.
translation: Noah: 我承认欧奥耐克斯是一座巨大的城市。[p/]在之前入室盗窃的罪行也并非不存在。

original: Noah: But all of my colleagues started getting hit [i]after[/i] this Phantom showed up.
translation: Noah: 但我的兄弟们可都是在这个所谓的“魅影”出现[i]后[/i]遭到盗窃的。

original: Noah: That [i]can't[/i] be a coincidence.
translation: Noah: 这[i]不可能[/i]是巧合。

original: AriaC: It's entirely possible that availability bias is at work here.
translation: AriaC: 这很有可能只是一种可得性偏差。

original: AriaC: People will always try to draw trends between genuine coincidences.
translation: AriaC: 人们总是试图在巧合之中强加规律。

original: She was being annoyingly obtuse about this,[p/] but I wouldn't get anywhere until I could prove she was wrong.
translation: 她这种迟钝的态度令人恼火，[p/]但除非能证明她的错误，我无法取得任何进展。

original: Tyrion: Were these homes as secure as the union offices?
