translation: Tyrion: 遭到盗窃的家庭有设置与工会办公室一样的安保系统吗？

original: Noah: Not at all...[p/] We're all just industry workers at the end of the day.
translation: Noah: 完全没有……[p/]毕竟离开岗位，我们也都只是普通的工人而已。

original: Tyrion: How did you get such a sophisticated security system for the union offices then?
translation: Tyrion: 那你们怎么得到用于工会办公室的那些精密的安保装置呢？

original: Noah: Ah,[p/] it was a generous donation from some friends we have in the city banking house.
translation: Noah: 啊，[p/]那是由我们在本地银行业的一些朋友慷慨捐赠的。

original: AriaC: ...The banking house?
translation: AriaC: ……银行业？

original: Noah: I guess there are some folks there who believe in what we're doing.
translation: Noah: 我想那里的一些伙计是支持我们事业的。

original: AriaC: Regardless,[p/] that means [i]anyone[/i] could have broken into these houses.
translation: AriaC: 但除去工会这边，[p/]这就意味着[i]任何人[/i]都可以闯进那些人的家里。

original: AriaC: It wouldn't require an expert that's as adept at committing robberies as the Phantom is.
translation: AriaC: 并不需要像“魅影”那么高超的技术就能实施这些盗窃。

original: Tyrion: What would motivate them to leave?
translation: Tyrion: 为什么被盗窃的人都搬走了呢？

original: Noah: Aurinax is a hot spot for trade and industry.
translation: Noah: 欧奥耐克斯的交易与工业都相当繁荣。

original: Noah: There are lots of jobs here now,[p/] but housing's gotten expensive.
translation: Noah: 这里的工作机会很多，[p/]所以房屋价格也水涨船高。

original: Noah: I'm guessing they had to move somewhere cheaper in the countryside.
translation: Noah: 我想他们不得不搬到城郊那些更便宜的地方。

original: Tyrion: Wait, you're "guessing"?[p/] Did they tell you why they were leaving?
translation: Tyrion: 慢着，是你“想”？[p/]他们有亲口告诉你搬离的原因吗？

original: Noah: No,[p/] a lot of them were really down about it.[p/] They didn't seem too eager to say more.
translation: Noah: 没有。[p/]他们大多因此相当沮丧，[p/]似乎并不愿意多说。

original: Noah: They were good people too—[p/]solid, law-abiding citizens.
translation: Noah: 他们明明都是好人——[p/]都是可靠又守法的市民。

original: Tyrion: I'm sorry that happened.[p/] I'm sure they were great people.
translation: Tyrion: 很遗憾会发生这种事情。[p/]我相信他们都是很好的人。

original: Noah: It's a damned shame.[p/] They were good people,[p/] and they had families to feed.
translation: Noah: 真是太遗憾了。[p/]他们都是很好的人，[p/]而且还要养家糊口。

original: Noah: Aurinax has been going in such a good direction, too.[p/] Crime's been down,[p/] and employment's been up.
translation: Noah: 欧奥耐克斯明明在往好的方向发展。[p/]犯罪变少了，[p/]工作机会增加了。

original: Noah: I really wish we could've shared that with them.
translation: Noah: 我真希望能分担他们的不幸。

original: Celeste: I can understand robbing the nobility and even the merchant ships,[p/] but I can't believe they were robbing commoners too.
translation: Celeste: 我能理解他们以贵族甚至是商人为目标，[p/]但很难相信他们还对平民下手。

original: Tyrion: It's a little strange, honestly.[p/] If they were after valuables,[p/] why would they bother robbing them at all?
translation: Tyrion: 说实话是有点奇怪。[p/]如果“魅影”的行动是看价值的话，[p/]干嘛要盯上平民呢？

original: Tyrion: The house of an industrial worker wouldn't have that much to steal—[p/]at least not when compared to the merchant ships.
translation: Tyrion: 工人们的家里应该没什么可偷的——[p/]至少与商船相比不值一提。

original: Celeste: Maybe it was because it was easy?[p/] They probably wouldn't have any kind of magical security.
translation: Celeste: 可能只是因为很简单呢？[p/]他们家里基本上不会有什么魔法的保护装置。

original: Possibly,[p/] but that still felt strange to me.
translation: 是有可能，[p/]但我还是觉得奇怪。

original: I really didn't want to contradict Mr. Morrison,[p/] but this was the only piece I had left.
translation: 我真的不想指出莫里森先生的矛盾，[p/]但我也只有这一条路可走。

original: There was nothing else that tied the robberies together,[p/] and I still didn't have a full idea of what the Phantom's motive was.
translation: 没有其他的东西可以将这一系列盗窃案联系在一起了，[p/]而我仍然对“魅影”的动机没有全面的认知。

original: But I had to do this.[p/] It was the only way to find out what was really going on in my city.
translation: 不过不得不做了。[p/]这是唯一理清我的故乡究竟在发生什么事情的办法。

original: Tyrion: ...Mr. Morrison.[p/] You said that the targets of the thefts were law-abiding citizens.
translation: Tyrion: ……莫里森先生。[p/]你说过盗窃的目标都是守法的市民。

original: Tyrion: Unfortunately,[p/] that's not entirely true.
translation: Tyrion: 不幸的是，[p/]这不完全准确。

original: Noah: ...What are you talking about?
translation: Noah: ……你是什么意思呢？

original: Noah: I knew most of them.[p/] They were good people.
translation: Noah: 他们绝大多数我都认识。[p/]都是好人。

original: Tyrion: That may be,[p/] but there's one unfortunate fact that tied them all together.
translation: Tyrion: 可能是这样，[p/]但有一个事实很不幸地将他们联系在一起。

original: Tyrion: They were all later arrested for treason against the Crown!
translation: Tyrion: 他们近期都因叛国罪遭到逮捕了！

original: Noah: ...What?!
translation: Noah: ……你说什么？！

original: AriaC: That's ridiculous!
translation: AriaC: 无可理喻！

original: AriaC: There have been [i]no[/i] reports of that sort submitted to the City Watch!
translation: AriaC: 城市安保可[i]没有[/i]收到这些报告！

original: Noah: What you're saying is crazy, my boy!
translation: Noah: 你说的可太疯狂了，孩子！

original: Noah: I've known these people![p/][s/] Some of them were close friends of mine!
translation: Noah: 我认识这些人！[p/][s/]其中一些还是我的好友！

original: Noah: They would have never gotten mixed up in that kind of business!
translation: Noah: 他们根本不可能搅和这种事情！

original: Tyrion: I'm sorry, Mr. Morrison,[p/] but I've heard otherwise.
translation: Tyrion: 很抱歉，莫里森先生。[p/]但我听说情况并非如此。

original: Tyrion: The Mistweaving Phantom hasn't just been stealing valuable items.
translation: Tyrion: “织雾魅影”不只是盗窃有价值的货物。

original: Tyrion: They've been specifically targeting citizens who were secretly plotting against the kingdom!
translation: Tyrion: 那个人还特地以密谋反对国王的人为目标！

original: Tyrion: They're part of a larger plot that involves everyone in the city of Aurinax!
translation: Tyrion: 他们只是一个大阴谋的一部分，而那个阴谋将影响欧奥耐克斯的每一个人！

original: AriaC: What are you even basing this off of, anyways?!
translation: AriaC: 归根结底，你这个说法究竟有什么根据？！

original: Tyrion: This testimony came directly from Lloyd von Sanctus:[p/] the Duke of Commerce and the ruling lord of Aurinax!
translation: Tyrion: 这一证言由洛伊德·冯·桑克图斯亲口告知，[p/]也就是商业公爵与欧奥耐克斯的领主本人！

original: AriaC: Lloyd von Sanctus gave you this information.
translation: AriaC: 洛伊德·冯·桑克图斯告诉了你这个信息。

original: Tyrion: That's right, Steelwind.
translation: Tyrion: 没错，斯蒂尔文德。

original: AriaC: Lloyd von Sanctus:[p/] the plaintiff of this trial.
translation: AriaC: 洛伊德·冯·桑克图斯，[p/]本次案件的原告。

original: Tyrion: ...Uh—
translation: Tyrion: ……呃——

original: AriaC: Lloyd von Sanctus:[p/] the man who would have every reason to have you fail.
translation: AriaC: 洛伊德·冯·桑克图斯，[p/]那个完全有动机让你败北的人。

original: Celeste: ...Tyrion?
translation: Celeste: ……提利昂？

original: Tyrion: ...I-[p/][s/]I may have miscalculated.
translation: Tyrion: ……我、[p/][s/]我是可能想错了。

original: AriaC: But you seem to be so confident.
translation: AriaC: 但你看起来很自信啊。

original: AriaC: Perhaps we should have the plaintiff testify so we can know for sure.
translation: AriaC: 或许我们应该让原告本人作证，才能确定这一点。

original: ...Did von Sanctus really set me up?![p/] How could I fall for something like that?!
translation: ……是洛伊德·冯·桑克图斯暗算了我吗？！[p/]我怎么会在这种地方栽跟头？！

original: But it made so much sense![p/][s/] The Phantom's targets,[p/][s/] the false reports of hostilities—[p/][s/]all of it seemed to be tied together by some greater plot!
translation: 但这太有道理了！[p/][s/]“魅影”的目标、[p/][s/]关于冲突的错误报告——[p/][s/]无论怎么看都是被一个更大的阴谋联系在一起的！

original: There [i]had[/i] to be a kernel of truth to what he'd told us earlier!
translation: 他那时候告诉我的那些事情[i]一定[/i]有其道理！

original: Maybe he was telling the truth earlier...[p/] He might testify honestly if we called him.
translation: 他那时说的可能也是真话……[p/]如果法庭宣他作证，他或许能更诚实地发言。

original: No...[p/] These charges against Dracogen were laid by [i]him[/i].
translation: 不对……[p/]针对德拉科根的指控正是[i]他[/i]提出的。

original: Even if he [i]had[/i] told us the truth earlier,[p/] he'd never sabotage his own case by taking the stand now.
translation: 就算之前他跟我们[i]有[/i]说真话，[p/]他也不可能出庭作证来搞砸自己的案子。

original: Judge: We will contact the Duke of Commerce and ask if he's willing to testify.
translation: Judge: 我们将联系商业公爵，询问他是否愿意出庭作证。

original: Judge: ...Although,[p/] I can already imagine what his answer will be.
translation: Judge: ……虽说如此，[p/]我已经能想象他会如何回应。

original: Without warning,[p/] a large man pushed open the doors to the courtroom and marched towards the stand.
translation: 一位壮汉毫无征兆地打开法庭大门，直直走向证人席。

original: Mr. Morrison sputtered a grunt of confusion before he was quickly carried out of the room by two knights who had accompanied him.
translation: 莫里森先生将将发出一声困惑的咕哝声，就已经被两名骑士左右架住，强行带走了。

original: The man had a large figure that was only dwarfed by the gigantic battle axe he was holding in his hand.
translation: 来人身形高大，但在他手中更为巨大的战斧的对比下甚至相形见绌。

original: He was covered in scars,[p/] and he held the jaded expression of someone who lived in death and combat.
translation: 他满脸疤痕，[p/]脸上一副成天在尸山血海中奋战而来的疲惫神情。

original: His uniform was similar to the prosecutor's clothing...[p/] Could he be who I thought he was?
translation: 他的制服倒与对面的指挥官很相近……[p/]他的身份会是我猜测的那个人吗？

original: Lucio: Lloyd need not take the stand.[p/] My testimony will suffice.
translation: Lucio: 洛伊德无需出来作证。[p/]我的证词就足够了。

original: Tyrion: What?![p/][s/] Who are—?!
translation: Tyrion: 什么？！[p/][s/]你是——？！

original: AriaC: F-[p/][s/]Father?![p/][s/] What are you—?!
translation: AriaC: 父、[p/][s/]父亲？！[p/][s/]您为什么——？！

original: Tyrion: "Father"?!
translation: Tyrion: “父亲”？！

original: Celeste: [i]That's[/i] her dad?!
translation: Celeste: [i]那个人[/i]就是她的父亲？！

original: :[i]This[/i] was the Grand General of Wyverngarde:[p/] the man responsible for countless deaths in the countryside.
translation: ：[i]来人[/i]正是维文加德的大将军:[p/]那个在全国的乡村地区造成无数死亡的人。

original: Von Sanctus suspected that [i]he[/i] was involved in the thefts and false reports.
translation: 冯·桑克图斯怀疑[i]他[/i]参与了那些盗窃案和错误的报告。

original: Lucio: I've been watching.[p/] Neither of you will get anywhere at this rate.
translation: Lucio: 我一直在观察庭审。[p/]这样下去你们谁都取得不了进展。

original: Judge: G-[p/][s/]Grand General,[p/] t-[p/][s/]this is quite unprecedented!
translation: Judge: 大、[p/][s/]大将军，[p/]这、[p/][s/]这种做法前所未有啊！

original: Lucio: ...And?
translation: Lucio: ……那又如何？

original: Judge: ...
translation: Judge: ……

original: It looked like the judge ran through a thousand possible responses in his head before he simply swallowed his fear and stayed silent.
translation: 看起来法官有千言万语，但在恐惧面前只得忍气吞声。

original: AriaC: Father...[p/][s/] Why are you—?!
translation: AriaC: 父亲……[p/][s/]您为什么——？！

original: Lucio: Again with that?[p/][s/] I will not accept insubordination[p/]—even from you, Prosecutor.
translation: Lucio: 又问一遍？[p/][s/]我不接受不服从命令的行为[p/]——即使是你，检察官。

original: AriaC: ...Grand General Steelwind,[p/] why have you interrupted this trial?
translation: AriaC: ……斯蒂尔文德大将军，[p/]你为什么要打断庭审？

original: Lucio: To give testimony that will substantiate the defense's claims.
translation: Lucio: 为了提供证词以证实辩方的主张。

original: AriaC: ...What?!
translation: AriaC: ……你说什么？！

original: AriaC: You can't just—!
translation: AriaC: 你可不能——！

original: AriaC: Your Honor,[p/] do something!
translation: AriaC: 法官阁下，[p/]说些什么啊！

original: Judge: No...[p/] I think I'm okay.
translation: Judge: 不行……[p/]我想没关系。

original: What was he [i]doing[/i]?![p/][s/] None of this made any sense!
translation: 他到底在[i]做什么[/i]？！[p/][s/]这根本没有道理！

original: Lucio: I hear no objections.[p/] I'll be giving my testimony now.
translation: Lucio: 看起来没有反对意见了。[p/]那么我现在开始发表证言。

original: Tyrion: Wait,[p/] what—?!
translation: Tyrion: 等等，[p/]怎么——？！

original: Lucio: This thief has been striking the houses of multiple commoners,[p/] seemingly at random. [h="Or so it would seem..." /]
translation: Lucio: 这个窃贼已经洗劫了许多平民的家里，[p/]是随机选择的。 [h="或者只是看起来像这样……" /]

original: Lucio: And without fail,[p/] the City Watch was called to the scene of the crime. [h="Within hours of the|crime being discovered..." /]
translation: Lucio: 他从不失手，[p/]城市安保也会在事后被呼叫到案发现场。 [h="总是在发现被盗后|数小时之内……" /]

original: Lucio: As the prosecutor said,[p/] it was clear someone other than the victims was reporting these robberies. [h="Perhaps a bystander|truly did make the report." /]
translation: Lucio: 正如检察官所说，[p/]除了受害者本人，还有其他人在向安保报告这些案件。 [h="也许是旁观者|如实报告了案件。" /]

original: Lucio: And after searching each scene,[p/] the City Watch found evidence of treason within their homes. [h="The so-called evidence was poorly hidden,| if at all." /]
translation: Lucio: 而每次在搜查现场后，[p/]安保都会发现房屋内有叛国行为的证据。 [h="有一个算一个，|这些所谓的证据都藏得非常拙劣。" /]

original: Lucio: These individuals were arrested by my men,[p/] and placed into my custody in secret. [h="However...|They were clearly not guilty of treason." /]
translation: Lucio: 这些户主都被我的手下逮捕了，[p/]并带到我的地方秘密收监。 [h="然而……|这些人显然没有叛国罪行。" /]

original: ...Why was I seeing so many of his thoughts?!
translation: ……为何我能看到他这么多的想法？

original: The Eye of Horus only worked on targets who were unguarded or emotionally stressed,[p/][s/] and [i]he[/i] looked like the least stressed person in the room right now!
translation: 荷鲁斯之眼只能在目标没有防备，或者情绪紧张的时候才生效。[p/][s/]而[i]他[/i]看起来肯定是这件屋子里最不紧张的人了！

original: I guess it didn't matter [i]who[/i] the witness was.[p/] This was just another cross-examination.
translation: 但我想，不论证人是[i]什么人[/i]，[p/]接下来要做的也只能是交叉询问。

original: :I just needed to do what I've always done:[p/] pull the truth out of him.
translation: :我要做的就同往常一样:[p/]从他身上挖掘出真相。

original: ...I just hoped I could get through this without being charged with treason.
translation: ……我只希望我不会因为这个被指控叛国。

original: Tyrion: Or so it would seem, Grand General.
translation: Tyrion: 或者看起来是这样，大将军。

original: Lucio: ...
translation: Lucio: ……

original: Judge: Mr. Cuthbert![p/][s/] Please refrain from contradicting the witness without cause!
translation: Judge: 卡斯伯特先生！[p/][s/]请勿无根据地反驳证人！

original: Tyrion: I was just...[p/] interpreting the meaning behind his words.
translation: Tyrion: 我就是……[p/]解读他的言外之意。

original: Tyrion: It's clear he thinks there's some relation between the thefts.
translation: Tyrion: 显然他是认为这些盗窃案之间是有关联的。

original: Tyrion: Am I wrong, Grand General?
translation: Tyrion: 我说错了吗，大将军？

original: Lucio: Hm...[p/] I suppose not.
translation: Lucio: 嗯……[p/]我想没有。

original: Lucio: And without fail,[p/] the City Watch was called to the scene of the crime. [h="Within hours of the crime being discovered..." /]
translation: Lucio: 他从不失手，[p/]城市安保也会在事后被呼叫到案发现场。 [h="总是在发现被盗后|数小时之内……" /]

original: Tyrion: With the serial robber on the loose,[p/] the City Watch must have been getting a lot of these calls.
translation: Tyrion: 这个连环盗窃的犯人尚未落网，[p/]城市安保一定接到了大量的呼叫。

original: AriaC: ...Yes.[p/] The City Watch recognized a trend.
translation: AriaC: ……没错，[p/]他们也察觉了这股趋势。

original: AriaC: At some point,[p/] they arrived in anticipation of what they'd find.
translation: AriaC: 有些时候，[p/]他们都能预计到会找到什么东西。

original: Lucio: ...It was all so carefully orchestrated—[p/]each piece perfectly falling in succession.
translation: Lucio: ……这显然是精心布置——[p/]每一次都完美地实施。

original: AriaC: I'm not sure what you mean by that, Fa—[p/] Grand General.
translation: AriaC: 我不确定你是什么意思，父——[p/]大将军。

original: Lucio: You've never stopped to ask yourself why... [h="It was far too convenient..."/]
translation: Lucio: 你从来不停下来反思一下…… [h="实在是太省事了……"/]

original: Lucio: For one thing—
translation: Lucio: 一方面——

original: AriaC: ...The victim isn't always the one to report a crime like this.
translation: AriaC: ……这些案件不总是受害者本人报告的。

original: AriaC: More often than not,[p/] it's a passing neighbor that calls it in.
translation: AriaC: 相反，[p/]更多的时候是路过的邻里报案。

original: AriaC: A lot of the reports were made by people who spotted a suspicious person leaving the premises.
translation: AriaC: 许多报案都是来自有人看到可疑人物离开案发现场。

original: Lucio: And did these people make themselves known after the arrest?[p/][s/] Did they provide testimony beyond the original report?
translation: Lucio: 而这些报案的人在户主被逮捕后有确认身份吗？[p/][s/]他们除了最初的报案还有提供进一步证词吗？

original: AriaC: N-[p/][s/]No...[p/] But—
translation: AriaC: 没、[p/][s/]没有……[p/]但是——

original: Lucio: These reports were made in-person,[p/] yet each time,[p/] the City Watch was unable to find the individual who made the report.
translation: Lucio: 这些报告都是当面提交，[p/]然而每一次，[p/]城市安保都无法再找到报案的那个人。

original: Lucio: Is [i]that[/i] normal, Prosecutor?
translation: Lucio: [i]这[/i]正常吗，检察官？

original: Lucio: And after searching each scene,[p/] the City Watch found evidence of treason within their homes. [h="The so-called evidence was poorly hidden,|if at all." /]
translation: Lucio: 而每次在搜查现场后，[p/]安保都会发现房屋内有叛国行为的证据。 [h="有一个算一个，|这些所谓的证据都藏得非常拙劣。" /]

original: Tyrion: And that was conveniently discovered each and every time.
translation: Tyrion: 而那些证据每次都被轻易地找到了。

original: Lucio: Yes.[p/] Very easily,[p/] might I add.
translation: Lucio: 没，[p/]及其轻易，[p/]容我补充。

original: Tyrion: Was it because the evidence was poorly hidden?
translation: Tyrion: 因为那些证据藏得不好吗？

original: Lucio: Yes,[p/] it's not uncommon for the disciplined to be so sloppy.
translation: Lucio: 没错。[p/]而本应遵守纪律的人如此随意，并不常见。

original: Lucio: Some are even arrogant enough to think they'd never be suspected.
translation: Lucio: 有些情况甚至像是自大到认为自己永远不会遭到怀疑。

original: Lucio: But the eye of the Crown sees more than you'd think.
translation: Lucio: 但是国王的[i]眼睛[/i]们可比你认为的[i]看得透[/i]。

original: AriaC: ...Is [i]that[/i] why I haven't had access to those reports?
translation: AriaC: ……[i]这[/i]就是不让我接触案件记录的原因吗？

original: Lucio: It was a precaution.[p/] I didn't want my enemies to see what moves I was making.
translation: Lucio: 只是预防措施。[p/]我可不想让敌人知晓我的动向。

original: Tyrion: Mr. Morrison testified that these individuals had simply moved out of town.
translation: Tyrion: 莫里森先生的证词提到，那些人只是搬到城外了。

original: Lucio: I'm sure it looked like that to him,[p/] and it wasn't too far from the truth.
translation: Lucio: 我确信他看起来就是这么回事，[p/]其实也与事实相去不远。

original: Lucio: But they were moved by my men to an undisclosed location.
translation: Lucio: 不过他们实际上是被我的手下转移到一处秘密地点。

original: But from what Mr. Morrison said,[p/] it sounded like he had a chance to say goodbye to them—[p/]Not to mention that their families left with them.
translation: 但根据莫里森先生的说法， [p/]听起来像是他还有机会与这些人道别——[p/]更不要提他们的家室也是随他们一同离开的。

original: That didn't sound like what would happen if you were arrested for treason.
translation: 这听起来可不像被以叛国罪嫌疑逮捕的人能有的待遇。

original: This was...[p/] strange.
translation: 这可就……[p/]很奇怪了。

original: The contradicting thought was staring me right in the face.
translation: 这个有矛盾的想法就摆在我的眼前。

original: There had to be something more to this—[p/]something I wasn't seeing.
translation: 在背后一定有什么——[p/]而且是我一直没发现的问题。

original: Was it really going to be that easy?
translation: 事情真的会这么简单吗？

original: Tyrion: Your Honor![p/][s/] The witness's testimony contradicts what he truly thinks!
translation: Tyrion: 法官阁下！[p/][s/]证人的发言与他的真实想法矛盾！

original: Judge: Mr. Cuthbert, please refrain from spouting nonsense in the presence of the Grand General and his giant axe!
translation: Judge: 卡斯伯特先生，请不要在大将军和他那大战斧的面前胡言乱语！

original: Tyrion: B-[p/][s/]But,[p/] I—
translation: Tyrion: 但、[p/][s/]但是，[p/]我——

original: Judge: Enough![p/][s/] I will not ask you again!
translation: Judge: 够了！[p/][s/]我不会再说第二遍！

original: Judge: M-[p/][s/]Mr. Cuthbert!
translation: Judge: 卡、[p/][s/]卡斯伯特先生！

original: Judge: I know you have a flair for the dramatic,[p/] but please don't shout such things at the man with the [i]giant axe[/i]!
translation: Judge: 我知道你总有戏剧性的设想，[p/]但请千万别在这位的巨斧面前这样大吼大叫啊！

original: Tyrion: Your Honor,[p/] I believe the witness knows more about the arrested individuals than he's letting on.
translation: Tyrion: 法官阁下，[p/]我确信证人对那些被捕人士的了解比他披露的还要更多。

original: Lucio: ...Oh?
translation: Lucio: ……哦？

original: Judge: Mr. Cuthbert.
translation: Judge: 卡斯伯特先生。

original: With the way the judge was looking at me,[p/] I'd have thought I was putting my head between the jaws of a lion.
translation: 法官看向我的眼神，[p/]让我觉得自己像是把脖子伸进狮子两排利齿之间。

original: ...But it didn't matter who stood in my way—[p/]a noble,[p/] the Grand General,[p/] or the King himself!
translation: ……但不论是谁挡在我的路上——[p/]不论是贵族、[p/]大将军，[p/]亦或是国王本人！

original: My mother may have been gone,[p/] but there were still people I cared about in Aurinax!
translation: 我的母亲逝世已久，[p/]但在欧奥耐克斯还有我牵挂的人们！

original: I wouldn't let the city I grew up in become the site of another one of his bloody massacres!
translation: 我不会让自己的故乡变成他手下又一处尸山血海的战场！

original: Tyrion: Lucio Steelwind![p/][s/] I think you know the individuals you arrested aren't what they were reported to be!
translation: Tyrion: 卢西奥·斯蒂尔文德！[p/][s/]我认为你很清楚，你逮捕的那些人和报告情况不一样！

original: Tyrion: You [i]know[/i] that they weren't guilty of treason!
translation: Tyrion: 你[i]明明知道[/i]他们并没有犯叛国罪！

original: Lucio: That's correct.
translation: Lucio: 正是如此。

original: Tyrion: I—
translation: Tyrion: 我——

original: AriaC: What?!
translation: AriaC: 什么？！

original: AriaC: Fa—[p/][s/] [i]Grand General[/i]!
translation: AriaC: 父——[p/][s/][i]大将军[/i]！

original: AriaC: Are you [i]admitting[/i] that you arrested these individuals with the knowledge that the charges were false?!
translation: AriaC: 你是要[i]承认[/i]自己在明知指控不实的情况下还逮捕了那些人吗？！

original: Lucio: I never said that I arrested them for treason.[p/] I said that I took them into custody.
translation: Lucio: 我可从没说过自己是因叛国罪逮捕他们的。[p/]我只说过自己将他们“收监”了。

original: Judge: B-[p/][s/]But for what reason, Grand General?
translation: Judge: 但、[p/][s/]但是为什么呢，将军阁下？

original: Lucio: This "Phantom" seems to be targeting certain individuals for some unknown reason.
translation: Lucio: 这个“魅影”看起来是因为某种未明原因把特定的对象作为目标。

original: Lucio: They seem to have targeted both Stefanic Dracogen and the Workers' Unions as well.
translation: Lucio: 而且窃贼还同时把斯蒂芬尼克·德拉科根同样工会作为目标。

original: AriaC: Grand General,[p/] there's no evidence that—
translation: AriaC: 大将军，[p/]没有证据证明——

original: Lucio: It is the truth,[p/] and the evidence must be found.
translation: Lucio: 这就是事实，[p/]而证据肯定会找得出来。

original: Lucio: Your Honor,[p/] suspend this trial to give the defense and prosecution time to investigate the crime further.
translation: Lucio: 法官阁下，[p/]中止庭审，让辩方和检方有时间进一步调查案件。

original: Judge: O-[p/][s/]Of course, Grand General!
translation: Judge: 没、[p/][s/]没问题，将军阁下！

original: Judge: Um...[p/] As per the Grand General's request,[p/] I will be suspending this trial!
translation: Judge: 嗯……[p/]按照大将军的命令，[p/]我宣布庭审中止！

original: JUDGE: Court proceedings for this case will resume tomorrow morning.
translation: JUDGE: 此案的庭审程序将在明天一早继续进行。

original: Lucio: Make it the next day.
translation: Lucio: 再多给一天。

original: JUDGE: Court proceedings will resume [i]Wednesday[/i] morning!
translation: JUDGE: JUDGE: 此案的庭审程序将在[i]后天[/i]继续进行！

original: JUDGE: Court is adjourned.
translation: Judge: 休庭。

original: Lucio: So...?[p/] Out with it.
translation: Lucio: 所以……？[p/]说吧。

original: Lucio: You look like you want to say something.
translation: Lucio: 看起来你有话要说。

original: Tyrion: If I didn't know any better,[p/] I would think that you tried to help us back there.
translation: Tyrion: 如果不是我知道实情，[p/]我会以为你是来帮我们的。

original: Tyrion: I can't imagine you care all that much about workers' rights or my client.
translation: Tyrion: 但我不相信你会那么关心工人的权利和我的委托人。

original: Lucio: ...I have my reasons.
translation: Lucio: ……我有自己的原因。

original: Lucio: This thief stole something quite important from an imperial ship this morning.
translation: Lucio: 这个窃贼在今早从王家的船只上偷走了一件非常重要的东西。

original: Tyrion: Right...[p/] Your daughter mentioned that it was a threat to national security.
translation: Tyrion: 没错……[p/]而你的女儿有提到这个东西对国家安全有威胁。

original: Lucio: It is in my best interests for the item to be found and this "Mistweaving Phantom" brought to justice.
translation: Lucio: 对我来说，这个东西能被找回来，而且“织雾魅影”能被绳之以法，就是最符合我利益的事情。

original: Lucio: But most importantly...
translation: Lucio: 但最重要的……

original: Lucio: I want to know who they are working for.
translation: Lucio: 我要知道他是为谁做事。

original: Tyrion: ...Are you trying to insinuate that it isn't you?
translation: Tyrion: ……你是想暗示幕后那个人不是你吗？

original: Lucio: Is that what you think?
translation: Lucio: 你是这么认为的吗？

original: Honestly,[p/] I didn't know [i]what[/i] to think at this point.
translation: 说实话，[p/]我并不知道现在该怎么[i]思考[/i]。

original: Lucio: You always seem to arrive at the truth when no one else will.
translation: Lucio: 看起来你总是能抵达其他人都无法抵达的真相。

original: Lucio: I've read the court transcripts from your past cases,[p/] so I already had some suspicions.
translation: Lucio: 我有读你参与过的案件的法庭记录，[p/]所以我已经有所怀疑。

original: Lucio: And they were all but confirmed when you "cross-examined" me today.
translation: Lucio: 而在你今天对我“交叉询问”的时候，它都得到了证实。

original: Lucio: You will figure out what happened this morning,[p/] and you will use your [i]eye[/i] to do so.
translation: Lucio: 你会理清楚今早发生的事情，[p/]而且你会用自己的[i]眼睛[/i]做到这一点。

original: I tensed for a moment.[p/] Why did he phrase it like that?
translation: 我突然紧张了一下。[p/]他为什么要用这个表述？

original: His thoughts were so easy to read during his testimony...[p/] Was this some kind of test?
translation: 他的想法在作证时非常容易探测到……[p/]这是某种测试吗？

original: Tyrion: ...Well,[p/] I'm sure someone like you would have a great use for an eye like mine.
translation: Tyrion: ……好吧，,[p/]我想你这样的人总是能好好利用我这样的[i]眼睛[/i]。

original: Tyrion: I am [i]so[/i] sorry...[p/][s/] I did not mean it like—
translation: Tyrion: [i]真[/i]不好意思……[p/][s/]我并不是想说——

original: Lucio: I understood what you meant.
translation: Lucio: 我明白你什么意思。

original: Lucio: Well?[p/] Get to work then.[p/] I'll be waiting for your results.
translation: Lucio: 行了？[p/]干活去吧。[p/]我会等着你的结果。

original: Tyrion: ...I don't take orders from you, Grand General.
translation: Tyrion: ……我不会听你的命令，大将军。

original: Lucio: Yet you will still do what I have asked.[p/] It's in your nature.
translation: Lucio: 但你仍然会按我的要求行事。[p/]这是你的本能。

original: I exhaled heavily.[p/] The more this mystery unravelled,[p/] the more uncertain I became of everything.
translation: 我大叹一口气。[p/]这个谜团解开得越多，[p/]我就对一切感到愈发不确定。

original: I really wished Ms. Tymora was here to help me.[p/] I could feel a migraine coming on.
translation: 我真希望泰摩拉女士能在这里帮帮我，[p/]感觉自己的偏头痛似乎要发作了。

original: Celeste: Hey, are you okay?
translation: Celeste: 嘿，还好吗？

original: Tyrion: Yeah...[p/] I think I'm just a little exhausted.
translation: Tyrion: 还行……[p/]我想自己就是有点累了。

original: Celeste: It's pretty late.[p/] Should we just head back to the inn and continue the investigation tomorrow?
translation: Celeste: 今天已经很晚了，[p/]我们应该直接回酒馆休息，明天再调查吧？

original: Tyrion: N-[p/]No...[p/] I want to take another look at the refinery before the Inquisition gets there.
translation: Tyrion: 不、[p/]不行……[p/]我想在裁判所到达前再调查一下精炼厂。

original: The throbbing pain in my skull seemed to disagree with that course of action.
translation: 但我头顶传来的阵阵疼痛似乎在反对我的意图。

original: Celeste: Yeah,[p/] no.[p/] We're heading back to the inn.
translation: Celeste: 不，[p/]算了，[p/]我们回旅店。

original: Tyrion: I'm fine...[p/] Really.
translation: Tyrion: 我没事……[p/]真的。

original: Celeste: Tyrion, I know you're anxious about the trial,[p/] but you need to get some rest.
translation: Celeste: 提利昂，我知道你忧心审理的事，[p/]但你得休息一下。

original: I felt a tinge of irritation,[p/] but I knew she was just looking out for me.
translation: 我感到一丝恼怒，[p/]但又很清楚她只是担心我。

original: But I couldn't rest now—[p/]not with that serial thief on the loose.
translation: 但我现在不能休息——[p/]在那个窃贼落网前还不能。

original: Tyrion: Celeste.[p/] It's fine.
translation: Tyrion: 塞莱斯特，[p/]没事的。

original: Celeste: It's not.[p/] You're going to work yourself—
translation: Celeste: 并不是。[p/]你会把自己……

original: Tyrion: Would you just stay out of my way?!
translation: Tyrion: 你可以别碍事了吗？！

original: Once again,[p/] my voice came out louder than I'd meant for it to.
translation: 又一次，[p/]我的音量比我想要表达的大了很多。

original: Celeste: Fine.[p/] Whatever.[p/] Do what you want.
translation: Celeste: 行。[p/]无所谓。[p/]你想干嘛就干嘛吧。

original: It was all because I returned to Aurinax...[p/] It was just dredging up emotions that needed to stay buried.
translation: 就是因为我回到了欧奥耐克斯……[p/]我本应埋藏的那些情感都在被不停地挖掘出来。

original: That was all the more reason to get through this trial as soon as possible.
translation: 这更说明我们得尽快了结这个案件。

original: ...The soreness in my head didn't seem to be going away anytime soon.
translation: ……我脑袋的疼痛似乎一时半会儿好不了。

original: She was right.[p/] I'd be better off investigating the scene after some rest.
translation: 她是对的。[p/]我更应该先休息一下再去调查案发现场。

original: As the night went on,[p/] I found myself falling into another nightmare.
translation: 随着夜色渐深，[p/]我陷入了另一场噩梦。

original: Ruby: What the—?
translation: Ruby: 这是——？

original: A knock rang out on the door leading to Tymora Law Offices.
translation: 泰摩拉法律事务所的大门响起一阵敲门声。

original: Ruby Tymora let out an irritated grumble.[p/] Who the hell was bothering her after-hours?
translation: 鲁比·泰摩拉有些恼火地嘟囔一声。[p/]到底是哪个家伙在她下班几小时后来打扰她？

original: Ruby: I don't know who you think you are,[p/] but we—
translation: Ruby: 我才不管你有多了不起，[p/]但我这里——

original: She froze when she saw Frey's son standing at her door.
translation: 她看到芙蕾的儿子站在门口时僵住了。

original: His bright blond hair was covered in dirt and grime.[p/] The clothes that she'd seen Frey sew for him were tattered and torn.
translation: 他原本亮丽的金发上沾满了尘土与污垢。[p/]他身穿的衣服她也曾见过，是由芙蕾亲手织给他的，现在已经满是褶皱和裂口。

original: He looked like he hadn't eaten anything in days.[p/] He just stared blankly at her.
translation: 看起来他已经好几天没吃东西了。[p/]他两眼无神地看着她的方向。

original: Ruby: W-[p/][s/]What...?
translation: Ruby: 这、[p/][s/]这是……？

original: Ruby: What are you doing here?![p/][s/] How did you even [i]get[/i] here?!
translation: Ruby: 你在这里做什么？！[p/][s/]说到底你是怎么[i]来到[/i]这里的？！

original: Tyrion: ...I walked.
translation: Tyrion: ……我走来的。

original: Ruby: W-[p/][s/]What?!
translation: Ruby: 怎、[p/][s/]怎么可能？！

original: Ruby: W-[p/][s/]We need to call someone.[p/] We need to get you back home.
translation: Ruby: 我、[p/][s/]我得找人来。[p/]我们得把你送回家。

original: Tyrion: ...There's nothing there for me.
translation: Tyrion: ……我家已经什么都没有了。

original: Ruby: ...
translation: Ruby: ……

original: This was her fault.[p/] If she'd just taken that deal,[p/] his mother would still be alive.
translation: 这本就是她的过错。[p/]如果她赢下了官司，[p/]他的母亲就会活下来。

original: Tyrion: ...Are you going to keep fighting the nobility?
translation: Tyrion: ……你还要继续反抗贵族吗？

original: His words came out weakly.[p/] He sounded like a ghost.
translation: 他的声音很虚弱，[p/]听起来简直如同幽灵一般。

original: Ruby: ...What?[p/][s/] I—
translation: Ruby: ……你说什么？[p/][s/]我——

original: Tyrion: Ms. Tymora, are you going to keep fighting them?
translation: Tyrion: 泰摩拉女士，你会继续反抗他们吗？

original: Ruby: Look,[p/] that's not important.[p/] We need to get you some help.
translation: Ruby: 听着，[p/]这不重要。[p/]我会为你寻求帮助。

original: Tyrion: ...I want to help you fight them.
translation: Tyrion: ……我要帮你与他们斗争。

original: Ruby: Tyrion!
translation: Ruby: 提利昂！

original: Tyrion: Please...[p/] Just let me help you...
translation: Tyrion: 拜托你……[p/]让我帮你的忙……

original: Ruby: I—
translation: Ruby: 我——

original: Ruby: Look, just—[p/] Just come inside.
translation: Ruby: 好吧，你——[p/]进来吧。

original: Ruby: We need to get you something to eat.[p/] Then we can get you cleaned up.
translation: Ruby: 我得给你找点吃的。[p/]然后得让你好好洗个澡。

original: The boy said nothing as he clutched the final message that his mother had left him.
translation: 小男孩什么也没说，只是仅仅攥着母亲留给他最后的那张字条。

original: It was the last comforting memory I'd ever have of her.
translation: 那是我对她最后一丝温暖的记忆。

original: ...It was something that I'd never experience again.
translation: ……也是我再也无法体会的东西。

original: Tyrion: ...Mom.
translation: Tyrion: ……妈妈。

original: It was another nightmare.[p/] It'd been a while since I'd thought about that day.
translation: 又是一场噩梦。[p/]我已经很久没有回忆起那天的事情了。

original: The nightmares were getting worse and worse.[p/] I really needed to get this case done with as soon as I could.
translation: 噩梦变得愈发糟糕。[p/]我真的得尽可能早的了结这个案子。

original: Celeste: ...Hey, are you up?
translation: Celeste: ……嘿，你醒了吗？

original: Tyrion: Yeah...
translation: Tyrion: 醒了……

original: I felt like I should say something to her after what happened yesterday,[p/] but the words didn't come to me.
translation: 我感觉昨天那样之后我得对她说些什么，[p/]但我想不到合适的言辞。

original: Tyrion: ...Let's get to work.
translation: Tyrion: ……开工吧。

original: Celeste: Yeah...
translation: Celeste: 好吧……

original: Tyrion: We missed him yesterday,[p/] but Crown Prince Aster supposedly saw what happened to Justin during the accident.
translation: Tyrion: 我们昨天正好错过了他，[p/]但王储殿下，即阿斯特似乎看到了贾斯汀发生意外的那一幕。

original: Tyrion: He might have seen something that Rika missed.
translation: Tyrion: 他可能有看到里卡看漏了的地方。

original: I had no idea why the Crown Prince helped me back at Von Sanctus Manor,[p/] but he seemed more amicable to us than I'd have expected.
translation: 我是想不通为什么王储殿下在冯·桑克图斯家的前厅帮了我，[p/]但他对我们比我想象的要和蔼。

original: But [i]finding[/i] him in this large city was another matter.[p/] I was sure he was hidden away somewhere.
translation: 然而要在这个大城市[i]找到[/i]他可就是个大难题了。[p/]我想他肯定藏到什么地方去了。

original: Tyrion: There's also something else that Steelwind mentioned during the trial.
translation: Tyrion: 斯蒂尔文德在庭审中还提到一个信息。

original: Tyrion: Rika was supposedly a part of a band of thieves,[p/] and their thefts all those years ago seem to be similar to that of the Phantom.
translation: Tyrion: 里卡似乎曾经在一个盗贼团待过，[p/]而他们几年前的犯案方式与“魅影”很相似。

original: Celeste: ...Do you think one of them is involved in all of this?
translation: Celeste: ……你认为是那个盗贼团里的人参与了犯案？

original: Tyrion: I think so...[p/] But I don't know why she wouldn't speak up about it if it was related to the case.
translation: Tyrion: 我是这么觉得……[p/]但如果确实与案件有联系的话，我就不知道为什么她却闭口不提了。

original: Tyrion: We'll probably have to talk to her next.
translation: Tyrion: 我们接下来大概要找她谈一谈。

original: Tyrion: After all,[p/] I doubt it will be easy to get an audience with—
translation: Tyrion: 毕竟，[p/]我觉得想要觐见那位还是不——

original: Aster: ...!
translation: Aster: ……！

original: As we exited our room,[p/] we suddenly came face to face with the Crown Prince.
translation: 就在我们离开房间时，[p/]突然就与王储殿下对面而立了。

original: We all stood there, stunned.[p/] What was he doing staying at a tavern for commoners?
translation: 我们都震惊地杵在那里。[p/]他在这个平民们用的酒馆做什么？

original: Tyrion: A-[p/][s/]Aster—[p/][s/] Er—[p/][s/] I mean—
translation: Tyrion: 阿、[p/][s/]阿斯特——[p/][s/]呃——[p/][s/]我意思是——

original: Tyrion: Your Highness!
translation: Tyrion: 王储殿下！

original: Aster: Tyrion Cuthbert?!
translation: Aster: 提利昂·卡斯伯特？！

original: Tyrion: Y-[p/][s/]You know who I am?
translation: Tyrion: 您、[p/][s/]您知道我啊？

original: That wasn't usually a good sign.
translation: 这通常可不是好事。

original: Aster: I do...[p/] I know you [i]very[/i] well.
translation: Aster: 是的……[p/]我[i]非常[/]i了解你。

original: Aster: Tyrion Cuthbert:[p/] the protégé of the infamous Ruby Tymora.
translation: Aster: 提利昂·卡斯伯特……[p/]臭名昭著的鲁比·泰摩拉的徒弟。

original: Aster: I'm—
translation: Aster: 我——

original: Aster: —your biggest fan!
translation: Aster: ——是你的超级粉丝！

original: Aster: I can't believe it![p/][s/] The [i]infamous[/i] Tyrion Cuthbert is standing right in front of my tavern room!
translation: Aster: 难以置信！[p/][s/][i]臭名昭著[/]i的提利昂·卡斯伯特正站在我的酒馆房间前！

original: Aster: I've read [i]all[/i] about your feats, Mr. Cuthbert.
translation: Aster: 我读过关于你的[i]所有[/]i事迹，卡斯伯特先生。

original: Aster: You successfully indicted the head of House Pierce!
translation: Aster: 你成功起诉了皮尔斯家族的首脑！

original: Aster: You didn't think twice about confronting a member of House Frega!
translation: Aster: 面对弗雷加家族的成员，你毫不畏惧！

original: Aster: [i]And[/i] you even defeated the Duke of Commerce in the chess tournament yesterday!
translation: Aster: [i]而且[/i]你昨天甚至还在棋赛上击败了那个商业公爵！

original: Celeste: ...Is it bad that I've become numb to the surprises this week?
translation: Celeste: ……我这周都被各种惊吓搞得麻木了，这是坏事吗？

original: Aster: And [i]you[/i]![p/][s/] You must be Celeste McCoy.
translation: Aster: 还有[i]你[/i]！[p/][s/]你一定就是塞莱斯特·麦考伊。

original: Aster: You're Tyrion's first client,[p/] and the Crimson Demon of the Eastern Kingdoms!
translation: Aster: 你是提利昂的第一位委托人，[p/]东方古国的绯红恶魔！

original: Celeste: ...How did you find out about that name?!
translation: Celeste: ……你怎么挖出来那个名字的？！

original: Tyrion: ...The Crimson what?
translation: Tyrion: ……绯红什么？

original: Celeste: Ugh....
translation: Celeste: 唉……

original: Tyrion: A-[p/]Anyways,[p/] Your Highness.[p/][s/] Is it true that you witnessed the accident yesterday morning?
translation: Tyrion: 总、[p/]总而言之，[p/]王储殿下。[p/][s/]您昨天早上也有目击到事故发生，是这样吗？

original: Aster: Y-[p/][s/]Yes![p/][s/] I did!
translation: Aster: 是、[p/][s/]是的！[p/][s/]我目睹了！

original: Aster: Are you going to interrogate me about what I saw?!
translation: Aster: 你要盘问我我看到的情况吗？！

original: Aster: I'll answer whatever questions you have!
translation: Aster: 我会回答你的任何问题！

original: First Lucio Steelwind,[p/] and now the Crown Prince—[p/]why were so many of my supposed enemies being so agreeable this week?
translation: 先是卢西奥·斯蒂尔文德，[p/]现在又是王储殿下——[p/]为什么我那些本应是敌人的家伙这星期都这么好说话啊？

original: I just let out an exasperated sigh.[p/] I shouldn't look this gift horse in the mouth.
translation: 我只好无奈地叹了口气。[p/]我不应该挑剔这份礼物。

original: Tyrion: Hey.
translation: Tyrion: 喂。

original: Celeste: ...What's up?
translation: Celeste: ……怎么了？

original: Stefanic: ...Is something wrong?
translation: Stefanic: ……有什么不对劲吗？

original: Tyrion: No.[p/] Not at all.
translation: Tyrion: 没有。[p/]什么都没有。

original: Celeste: ...Yeah, why would anything be [i]wrong[/i]?
translation: Celeste: ……是啊，哪能到处都[i]不对劲[/i]呢？

original: It seemed we both silently agreed not to acknowledge what had happened.
translation: 貌似我们都默默达成一致，不要去提发生的那些事情。

original: ...That was probably making things worse in hindsight.
translation: ……事后看来，可能只是让事情变得更糟。

original: Stefanic: ...I see.
translation: Stefanic: ……我明白了。

original: Tyrion: Are [i]you[/i] okay?
translation: Tyrion: [i]你[/i]还好吗？

original: Stefanic: It's just a lot to take in.
translation: Stefanic: 要消化的信息太多了。

original: Stefanic: I would've never guessed that one simple accident would turn into some gigantic conspiracy.
translation: Stefanic: 我怎么都想不到一个单纯的事故会演变成一个巨大的阴谋。

original: Stefanic: And to think [i]Justin[/i] was the Mistweaving Phantom this entire time...
translation: Stefanic: 而且一想起[i]贾斯汀[/i]一直就是那个“织雾魅影”……

original: Tyrion: You know about that story?
translation: Tyrion: 你也知道那个都市传说吗？

original: Stefanic: I've picked up some bits and pieces from the residents here and there.
translation: Stefanic: 我在这里的居民那里听说了一些只言片语。

original: Stefanic: ...It was clearly a dark time for the city from the sounds of it.
translation: Stefanic: ……听起来那显然是这座城市的黑暗时期。

original: Tyrion: All the more reason to be grateful for your acquittal.
translation: Tyrion: 更说明你应该要为自己的无罪而感到庆幸。

original: Stefanic: ...Are you sure you're not getting ahead of yourself?
translation: Stefanic: ……你确定你没有想得太多？

original: Tyrion: I don't think so.[p/] We have proof that Justin destroyed the guardrail using his magic ring.
translation: Tyrion: 我认为没有。[p/]我们已经证明了贾斯汀是用自己那个魔法指环摧毁了护栏。

original: Tyrion: You had nothing to do with what happened.[p/] It was really just an accident in every sense.
translation: Tyrion: 你与发生的事故没有任何关系。[p/]从各方面来看，这真的只是一起意外。

original: Stefanic: Hm...
translation: Stefanic: 嗯……

original: I had to admit that I shared some of Dracogen's uneasiness.
translation: 我不得不承认，自己与德拉科根一样都感到一些不安。

original: The Inquisition and Kingsguard were moving frantically when we left the tavern this morning.
translation: 我们一早离开酒馆时，裁判所和国王卫队正忙得不可开交。

original: It surely had [i]something[/i] to do with the stolen cargo,[p/] but something seemed off about their movements.
translation: 他们忙的事情肯定与被盗的货物[i]有关[/i]，[p/]但他们的举措有些不对劲。

original: It seemed like they were mobilizing for more than just a retrieval.
translation: 看起来他们并非是仅仅在为找回什么东西而动员。

original: ...I suppose it didn't matter either way.
translation: ……我想这对我来说没什么区别。

original: No matter what they had in store,[p/] I would acquit Dracogen.
translation: 无论他们准备了什么，[p/]我都会让德拉科根取得无罪判决。

original: JUDGE: Court is now resumed for the trial of Stefanic Dracogen.
translation: Judge: 法庭现在开庭，继续审理斯蒂芬尼克·德拉科根案。

original: Judge: During our last proceedings,[p/] the defense argued that the victim's death was a result of murder,[p/] not simple negligence.
translation: Judge: 在之前的庭审中，[p/]辩方认为受害人的死因是遭到谋杀，[p/]而非单纯的事故。

original: Judge: This was supported by a witness who claimed to have seen a spell cast on the victim before his death.
translation: Judge: 这一观点受到一位证人支持，证人宣称曾在受害人死前目击到有被施放法术。

original: Tyrion: Your Honor.[p/] Over the last day,[p/] we've investigated the crime further,[p/] and new facts have come to light.
Tyrion: Nevertheless,[p/] I maintain that my client is not to blame for Justin's death.
Tyrion: Unfortunately,[p/] the blame lies with Justin himself.
Judge: ...Is that so?
Tyrion: Your Honor.[p/] The victim was wearing a magical ring that allowed him to cast [b]conjuration[/b] magic.
Tyrion: It seems that he entered the refinery in order to steal business documents from my client,[p/] and the ring was meant to aid in that.
Tyrion: After he had stolen the documents,[p/] he activated the ring on the refinery catwalk.
Tyrion: It malfunctioned in some way,[p/] causing an explosion of spatial energy.
Tyrion: [i]That[/i] energy is what broke apart the guardrail.
Judge: ...Are you trying to say that the [i]victim[/i] was the culprit behind the most recent string of robberies?
Tyrion: Unfortunately, I am, Your Honor.
AriaC: ...Is that it, Mr. Cuthbert?
Tyrion: What are you talking about, Steelwind?
Tyrion: It's obvious that my client didn't have any hand in Justin's death.
AriaC: ...And do you have any evidence of that?
Tyrion: Mosourika Tudor [i]saw[/i] a magical effect blast the guardrail apart.
AriaC: We've been over this.[p/] Ms. Tudor had every reason to lie in her testimony last session.
Tyrion: She didn't know about Justin's ring![p/][s/] How could she have known to lie about something like that?
AriaC: You're assuming that she [i]didn't[/i] know about it beforehand.
AriaC: The two of them were known friends.[p/] It's not implausible that he showed it to her.
Tyrion: Well, what about the Crown Prince?
Tyrion: He saw the magical effect as well!
AriaC: For obvious reasons,[p/] the Crown Prince can't be called to testify in a case of this magnitude.
AriaC: As far as the courts are concerned,[p/] you can't use his testimony as evidence.
She was being unreasonably obtuse,[p/] even more so than usual...
What was she doing?
AriaC: On the subject of the victim,[p/] we've also discovered new facts regarding his...[p/] [i]actions[/i] that morning.
AriaC: ...The prosecution would like to call Lucio Steelwind to the stand.
Judge: T-[p/][s/]The Grand General?!
AriaC: As many of you know,[p/] the serial robber stole cargo from an imperial ship on the morning of the accident.
AriaC: We've since located the cargo,[p/] and what we found paints quite the picture of the victim's intentions that day.
Judge: I-[p/][s/]I see...
Judge: Bailiff.[p/] Please escort the Grand General to the stand.
Tyrion: Okay, I guess [i]I'll[/i] just say it.
Tyrion: Witness,[p/] please state your name and—
Lucio: Are you really going to waste my time with that?
Lucio: We all know who I am.
Tyrion: Look,[p/] I just—
Lucio: Enough.[p/] I'm giving my testimony now.
Lucio: Justin Waye had been committing a string of robberies in Aurinax Harbor,[p/] the last of which included an imperial shipment of high-capacity energy cells.
Lucio: Waye was working with insurrectionists who provided him with an advanced magical ring.[p/] He used that ring during his robberies.
Lucio: One of the ring's functions allowed him to teleport himself.[p/] The other allowed him to summon an item to him.
Lucio: Waye had taken the stolen energy cells and placed a bomb within them.[p/] He was going to summon it into the refinery and detonate it.
Tyrion: What?!
Celeste: There was a [i]bomb[/i] inside that thing?!
AriaC: F-[p/][s/]Father![p/][s/] By the Scaled Lord,[p/] [i]why[/i] would you say that?!
Lucio: What are you on about?
Lucio: I gave the testimony as you asked.
AriaC: Yes,[p/] but I thought you had enough sense to leave [i]certain[/i] details out of it!
Lucio: What "details"?
Gallery: Insurrectionists were planning to [i]bomb[/i] the Industrial District?!
Gallery: How could a commoner brazenly rob an imperial ship?![p/][s/] Is the kingdom really so powerless?!
Gallery: That boy was a thief and a terrorist![p/][s/] He [i]deserved[/i] what happened to him!
AriaC: [i]Those[/i] "details"!
So they really [i]were[/i] planning to use those energy cells to make a bomb.
I can't believe Justin would agree to do something like this...[p/] He [i]worked[/i] with the people there...
Who would have anything to gain from doing something like this?
Was Lucio trying to manufacture a catastrophe so that he could march his soldiers into Aurinax?!
...No.[p/] I needed to think through this rationally.
[i]Both[/i] of the Steelwinds have been acting strangely lately.
There was something else happening here.
...I guess it didn't matter.
Tyrion: I've learned that Justin was quite skilled at breaking into secure places.
Tyrion: But I never imagined he'd be able to break into an imperial ship without being caught.
Lucio: ...He shouldn't have.
Lucio: The men stationed there were negligent.
Lucio: At least that's the most generous interpretation of what happened.
Tyrion: "Generous"...?
Lucio: Waye was working with insurrectionists who provided him with an advanced magical ring.[p/] He then used that ring during his robberies.
Tyrion: ...Do you have any proof to substantiate that claim?
Lucio: ...What other explanation is there?
Tyrion: Well,[p/] [i]you[/i] might want to stage a catastrophe in the heart of von Sanctus's territory.
Tyrion: That would let you march your soldiers right into the land of one of your rivals.
Tyrion: ...Just to name [i]one[/i] possible explanation.
AriaC: ...The prosecution does not refute the defense's statement.
AriaC: The prosecution also does not conclude that the victim was a part of [i]any[/i] insurrectionist group.
Tyrion: Could he summon [i]any[/i] item he wanted?
Lucio: He would need to affix a specific kind of energy crystal to the object he wanted to summon.
Lucio: We found such a crystal attached to the metal chest containing the bomb.
AriaC: There's no doubt that the ring was set to summon that chest.
Tyrion: How can you be so sure?[p/] I thought the ring was too damaged by the vat chemicals to identify that.
AriaC: Luckily,[p/] the crystal attached to the bomb was not.
AriaC: We were able to verify its connection to the ring,[p/] however disrupted it was.
Lucio: It was clear that he meant to summon that chest into the refinery.
Lucio: It was only out of sheer luck that he died before that could happen.
Lucio: We're lucky he never got the chance to summon that container.[p/] The results would have been catastrophic.
Celeste: Was Justin really planning to blow up the refinery?
Tyrion: ...I don't know,[p/] and it's not as if he can tell us.
Tyrion: Still...[p/] Lucio is making a lot of assumptions about what happened.
Celeste: Yeah...[p/] I guess he's the type of person to jump to conclusions.
